attributes.name: stowage_instruction
attributes.description: Special handling or stowage instructions for the container including segregation requirements, securing notes, or operational constraints.
attributes.references: SMDG BAPLIE 3.x Standard, IMDG Code Segregation Requirements

attributes.name: teu_count
attributes.description: Total TEU count for this vessel call bay plan representing standardized container volume measurement.

attributes.name: tier_number
attributes.description: Vertical position identifier on the vessel indicating the tier or stack level for container stowage.

attributes.name: total_discharge_moves
attributes.description: Total number of container discharge moves planned for this vessel call across all bays and hatches.

attributes.name: total_load_moves
attributes.description: Total number of container load moves planned for this vessel call across all bays and hatches.

attributes.name: transhipment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this container is transhipment cargo that will be transferred to another vessel at this port.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: United Nations number identifying hazardous substances and articles for dangerous goods. Null for non-hazardous cargo.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

products.name: terminal_berth_allocation
products.description: Transactional record of berth assignments for vessel calls at the terminal. Captures berth identifier, vessel visit reference, planned and actual berthing time (ETB/ATB), planned and actual departure time (ETD/ATD), berth window duration, allocated quay length, draft restrictions, crane allocation count, berth planner ID, and allocation status (planned, confirmed, active, completed). SSOT for berth planning in TOPS Expert and NAVIS N4.

attributes.name: terminal_berth_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the berth allocation record. Primary key for the berth allocation entity.

attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical berth location allocated for this vessel call. Links to port infrastructure master data.

attributes.name: commercial_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial agreement or contract governing the terms of this berth allocation. Links to contract domain for tariff and SLA details.

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Berth operations are cost centers in port management accounting. Each berth allocation must be costed to a specific cost center for operational budgeting, variance analysis, and berth productivity rep

attributes.name: dos_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.dos_record. Business justification: SOLAS/ISPS mandate Declaration of Security for ship-port interface. Each berth allocation for international vessels requires DOS completion before operations commence. Links allocation to security agr

attributes.name: inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_inspection. Business justification: Berth operations require pre-arrival safety inspections per ISPS, port state control, and terminal safety protocols. Documented inspections tied to specific berth allocations are mandatory before vess

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Berth allocation is primary revenue source (berth hire charges based on LOA, duration, GRT). Link enables berth occupancy charge validation, SLA-based billing, and berth productivity reconciliation -

attributes.name: isps_facility_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.isps_facility_record. Business justification: Berth operations must comply with current facility ISPS security level. Vessel-shore interface security procedures depend on facility security status. Operational requirement for Declaration of Securi

attributes.name: port_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel visit for which this berth is allocated. Links to the vessel operations domain.

attributes.name: port_dues_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.port_dues_schedule. Business justification: Port dues are vessel-level charges calculated per berth call based on GRT/LOA bands. Berth allocation triggers port dues billing by referencing the applicable schedule for the vessel's characteristics

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Berths are profit centers in port P&L reporting. Each berth allocation generates revenue and costs tracked to profit centers for segment reporting, performance management, and strategic berth utilizat

attributes.name: terminal_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the system user who created this berth allocation record. Links to workforce domain for audit trail.

attributes.name: terminal_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the terminal operations staff member responsible for creating and managing this berth allocation. Links to workforce domain.

attributes.name: terminal_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the system user who last modified this berth allocation record. Links to workforce domain for audit trail.

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Berth compatibility validation, crane allocation planning, mooring gang sizing, and operational resource forecasting require vessel type specifications before vessel arrival. Critical for berth planni

attributes.name: wharfage_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.wharfage_schedule. Business justification: Wharfage charges apply to cargo handled at berth. Berth allocation determines which wharfage schedule applies based on cargo type, vessel type, and berth zone. Essential for cargo-based revenue calcul

attributes.name: allocated_crane_count
attributes.description: Number of Ship-to-Shore (STS) cranes or Quay Cranes (QC) allocated for cargo operations during this berth allocation. Impacts vessel turnaround time and terminal productivity.

attributes.name: allocated_quay_length_m
attributes.description: Length of quay allocated for this vessel in meters. Must accommodate vessel Length Overall (LOA) plus safety margins.
attributes.references: PIANC (World Association for Waterborne Transport Infrastructure) Standards

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments related to this berth allocation. May include operational instructions, coordination details, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the berth allocation. Format: BA-YYYYMMDD-NNNN where YYYYMMDD is allocation date and NNNN is sequence number.

attributes.name: allocation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or justification for this specific berth allocation. May include service requirements, vessel preferences, operational constraints, or commercial agreements.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the berth allocation. Planned: initial allocation created; Confirmed: vessel and berth confirmed; Active: vessel currently berthed; Completed: vessel departed; Cancelled: allocation cancelled; Suspended: temporarily on hold.

attributes.name: atb
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vessel berthed at the allocated berth. Captured from Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS) or Terminal Operating System (TOS).
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Port Call Standards

attributes.name: atd
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the vessel departed from the allocated berth. Captured from Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS) or Terminal Operating System (TOS).
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Port Call Standards

attributes.name: berth_draft_restriction_m
attributes.description: Maximum allowable draft at the allocated berth in meters. Vessel draft must not exceed this value for safe berthing operations.

attributes.name: berth_productivity_target_mph
attributes.description: Target container handling productivity in moves per hour for this berth allocation. Used for performance monitoring and SLA compliance.

attributes.name: berth_window_duration_hours
attributes.description: Planned duration of the berth window in hours. Calculated from berth window start and end times. Used for berth utilization KPIs.

attributes.name: berth_window_end
attributes.description: End of the allocated berth window. Defines the latest time the berth is reserved for this vessel before it must be released.

attributes.name: berth_window_start
attributes.description: Start of the allocated berth window. Defines the earliest time the berth is reserved for this vessel.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for cancellation if allocation status is cancelled. Includes vessel no-show, schedule changes, operational constraints, or customer request.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this berth allocation was cancelled. Null if allocation has not been cancelled.

attributes.name: cargo_operation_type
attributes.description: Type of cargo operations planned for this berth allocation. LoLo: Lift-on Lift-off (container); RoRo: Roll-on Roll-off (vehicles); Mixed: combination; Bulk: bulk cargo; General: general cargo.

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this berth allocation was confirmed by the berth planner and vessel operator. Represents transition from planned to confirmed status.

attributes.name: crane_allocation_type
attributes.description: Type of cranes allocated for this berth. STS: Ship-to-Shore crane; QC: Quay Crane; MHC: Mobile Harbour Crane; Mixed: combination of crane types.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this berth allocation record was first created in the Terminal Operating System. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format Standard

attributes.name: etb
attributes.description: Planned timestamp when the vessel is estimated to berth at the allocated berth. Used for berth planning and resource scheduling.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Port Call Standards

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: Planned timestamp when the vessel is estimated to depart from the allocated berth. Used for berth window planning and next vessel scheduling.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Port Call Standards

attributes.name: expected_container_moves
attributes.description: Estimated total number of container moves (load + discharge) planned for this vessel call. Used for resource planning and productivity forecasting.

attributes.name: expected_teu_volume
attributes.description: Expected total TEU volume to be handled during this berth allocation. Includes both loading and discharge operations.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Standards

attributes.name: imdg_cargo_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Cargo Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this berth allocation involves dangerous goods cargo requiring IMDG compliance. True if dangerous goods are present; False otherwise.

tag_set.value: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Cargo Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this berth allocation record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Format Standard

attributes.name: mooring_gang_count
attributes.description: Number of mooring gangs allocated for securing the vessel to the berth. Typically ranges from 1 to 4 depending on vessel size and weather conditions.
attributes.references: International Labour Organization (ILO) Maritime Labour Convention

attributes.name: pilotage_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether marine pilotage services are required for this berth allocation. True if pilotage is mandatory; False if vessel can berth without pilot.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this berth allocation. Critical: emergency or VIP vessel; High: priority service; Normal: standard service; Low: flexible scheduling.

attributes.name: sla_turnaround_time_hours
attributes.description: Contractual Service Level Agreement turnaround time commitment for this vessel in hours. Measured from ATB to ATD.

attributes.name: special_handling_requirements
attributes.description: Any special handling requirements for this berth allocation such as IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods) cargo, refrigerated containers, oversized cargo, or security protocols.

attributes.name: tide_window_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this berth allocation is constrained by tidal conditions. True if vessel can only berth during specific tide windows; False if tide-independent.

attributes.name: towage_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether towage (tug) services are required for this berth allocation. True if tugs are needed for berthing/unberthing; False otherwise.

attributes.name: vessel_draft_m
attributes.description: Maximum draft of the vessel in meters. Must be validated against berth depth restrictions to ensure safe berthing.

attributes.name: vessel_loa_m
attributes.description: Length Overall of the vessel in meters. Used to validate berth allocation suitability and quay length requirements.

attributes.name: weather_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this berth allocation has weather-related restrictions (wind speed, wave height, visibility). True if weather-sensitive; False otherwise.

products.name: reefer_monitoring
products.description: Transactional record of reefer container temperature and condition monitoring events within the terminal yard. Captures container number, yard slot position, set temperature, actual temperature reading, humidity reading, CO2 level, ventilation setting, monitoring timestamp, alarm flag, alarm type (temperature deviation, power failure, door open), and technician inspection reference. Ensures cold chain integrity for perishable cargo.

attributes.name: reefer_monitoring_id
attributes.description: Primary key for reefer_monitoring

attributes.name: commodity_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.commodity_code. Business justification: Cold chain compliance validation, temperature range verification against commodity specifications, and cargo-specific monitoring protocols require HS code reference. Essential for perishable cargo qua

attributes.name: container_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the reefer container being monitored. Links to the container master data.

attributes.name: container_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to terminal.container_visit. Business justification: Reefer monitoring events track temperature and condition of refrigerated containers during their terminal visit. The reefer_monitoring table already has container_id pointing to cargo.container (cross

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the technician who performed manual inspection or intervention on this reefer container.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Reefer monitoring is separately billable service (power supply, temperature monitoring, alarm response). Link enables per-container reefer charge validation, power consumption billing - specialized co

attributes.name: yard_slot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to terminal.yard_slot. Business justification: reefer_monitoring has yard_slot_position (STRING) which should be normalized to FK for authoritative slot reference. Monitoring events are tied to physical locations where reefer plugs are available.

attributes.name: actual_temperature
attributes.description: The measured actual temperature inside the reefer container at the time of monitoring in degrees Celsius. Critical for cold chain integrity verification.

attributes.name: alarm_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an alarm condition was triggered during this monitoring event. True indicates an alarm was raised, False indicates normal operation.

attributes.name: alarm_severity
attributes.description: The severity level of the alarm condition. Critical requires immediate action, high requires urgent attention, medium requires scheduled intervention, low is informational.

attributes.name: alarm_type
attributes.description: The category of alarm condition detected. Temperature deviation indicates actual temperature outside acceptable range, power failure indicates loss of electrical supply, door open indicates container door unsealed, humidity deviation indicates moisture level out of range, CO2 deviation indicates gas concentration issue, equipment malfunction indicates refrigeration unit failure.

attributes.name: cargo_type
attributes.description: The classification of perishable cargo being transported in the reefer container. Examples include frozen meat, fresh produce, pharmaceuticals, dairy products, flowers.

attributes.name: co2_level
attributes.description: The carbon dioxide concentration measured inside the reefer container in percentage. Critical for controlled atmosphere cargo such as fruits and vegetables.

attributes.name: cold_chain_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this monitoring event confirms cold chain integrity compliance. True indicates temperature and conditions within acceptable range, False indicates breach of cold chain requirements.

attributes.name: compressor_runtime_hours
attributes.description: The cumulative operating hours of the refrigeration compressor since last reset. Used for maintenance scheduling and equipment lifecycle management.

attributes.name: compressor_status
attributes.description: The operational status of the refrigeration compressor unit. Running indicates active cooling, stopped indicates unit off, standby indicates ready but not cooling, fault indicates malfunction.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Free text description of the corrective action taken or required in response to this monitoring event. Populated when intervention was necessary.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this monitoring event requires corrective action or intervention. True indicates follow-up action needed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this monitoring record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: defrost_cycle_status
attributes.description: The status of the automatic defrost cycle for the refrigeration unit. Active indicates defrost in progress, inactive indicates normal cooling mode, scheduled indicates defrost pending.

attributes.name: door_status
attributes.description: The physical status of the reefer container door. Closed indicates door shut but not sealed, open indicates door ajar or open, sealed indicates door closed with customs or security seal intact.

attributes.name: humidity_reading
attributes.description: The relative humidity percentage measured inside the reefer container. Important for cargo types sensitive to moisture levels such as fresh produce.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this monitoring record was last modified in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: monitoring_source
attributes.description: The method or system that captured this monitoring reading. Automated sensor indicates TOS integration, manual inspection indicates technician reading, remote telemetry indicates IoT device, RFID reader indicates tag-based monitoring.

attributes.name: monitoring_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this monitoring event. Active indicates ongoing monitoring, resolved indicates issue closed, escalated indicates elevated to management, pending review indicates awaiting technician assessment.

attributes.name: monitoring_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reefer container monitoring reading was captured. Principal business event timestamp for this monitoring transaction.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether an alert notification was sent to stakeholders for this monitoring event. True indicates notification dispatched to customer or operations team.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when alert notification was sent to stakeholders regarding this monitoring event. Null if no notification was sent.

attributes.name: o2_level
attributes.description: The oxygen concentration measured inside the reefer container in percentage. Used for controlled atmosphere monitoring to preserve perishable cargo.

attributes.name: power_status
attributes.description: The electrical power connection status of the reefer container. Connected indicates active power supply, disconnected indicates no power, standby indicates backup power mode.

attributes.name: power_supply_voltage
attributes.description: The electrical voltage being supplied to the reefer container in volts. Standard voltages are 220V, 380V, or 440V depending on terminal infrastructure.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free text field for additional notes, observations, or comments related to this reefer monitoring event. Used by technicians and operations staff for context.

attributes.name: sensor_device_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the monitoring sensor or telemetry device that captured this reading. Used for device calibration tracking and data quality assurance.

attributes.name: set_temperature
attributes.description: The target temperature setting configured for the reefer container in degrees Celsius. This is the temperature the refrigeration unit is programmed to maintain.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this monitoring event represents a breach of customer service level agreement for reefer monitoring. True indicates SLA breach occurred.

attributes.name: technician_inspection_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier linking this monitoring event to a technician inspection work order or maintenance record. Populated when manual intervention occurred.

attributes.name: temperature_deviation
attributes.description: The calculated difference between set temperature and actual temperature in degrees. Positive values indicate warmer than set point, negative values indicate cooler than set point.

attributes.name: temperature_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for temperature readings. Standard is Celsius but Fahrenheit may be used in some jurisdictions.

attributes.name: ventilation_rate
attributes.description: The air exchange rate in cubic meters per hour when ventilation is active. Applicable for cargo requiring fresh air circulation.

attributes.name: ventilation_setting
attributes.description: The ventilation mode configured for the reefer container. Closed for frozen cargo, open for fresh air exchange, controlled for modified atmosphere.

products.name: container_damage
products.description: Transactional record of container damage assessments and surveys conducted at the terminal. Captures container number, container visit reference, damage type (structural, door, floor, roof, side panel), damage severity (minor, moderate, major), damage location code, discovery point (gate-in, discharge, yard inspection), surveyor ID, photographic evidence reference, repair recommendation, liability party, and damage report status. Supports P&I claims and cargo liability management.
products.reference: Container Damage Report / EIR (Equipment Interchange Receipt)

attributes.name: container_damage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the container damage record. Primary key for the container damage assessment entity.

attributes.name: container_id
attributes.description: Reference to the container that sustained damage. Links to the container master record for full container details including container number, size, type, and ownership.

attributes.name: container_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific container visit or handling event during which the damage was discovered. Links to the container movement or visit record in the Terminal Operating System (TOS).

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Container damage repairs generate invoices or credit adjustments. Link supports damage claim billing, repair cost recovery, liability party invoicing - standard terminal damage handling process.

attributes.name: ohs_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.ohs_incident. Business justification: Container damage discovery often coincides with or causes safety incidents (falling cargo, structural failure, hazmat exposure). Incident investigations must cross-reference damage reports to determin

attributes.name: primary_container_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the system user who created the initial damage record. Supports audit trail and accountability for data quality.

attributes.name: primary_container_owner_port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal owner of the container (may be shipping line, leasing company, or container pool). Critical for determining who must be notified and who will receive repair payment.
attributes.references: Terminal Operating System (TOS) Container Owner Master

attributes.name: repair_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Container repairs are outsourced to specialized repair vendors. Damage reports must track which vendor performed repairs for cost recovery, quality assessment, vendor performance evaluation, and liabi

attributes.name: security_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_incident. Business justification: Container damage may indicate security breach (tampering, theft, sabotage). Links damage report to security incident for investigation coordination, root cause analysis, and determination whether dama

attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipping line or carrier responsible for the container at the time of damage discovery. Used for notification, claims, and liability coordination.
attributes.references: Terminal Operating System (TOS) Shipping Line Master

attributes.name: surveyor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the surveyor or inspector who conducted the damage assessment. May be internal terminal staff or external independent surveyor depending on damage severity and liability context.

attributes.name: trade_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.trade_document. Business justification: Damage reports may require amendments to trade documents (survey certificates, condition reports). Documentary evidence chain for cargo claims and insurance. Links operational damage record to regulat

attributes.name: actual_repair_cost
attributes.description: Final invoiced cost of repairs completed. Used for variance analysis against estimate, billing to liable party, and financial reporting. Amount in terminal base currency.

attributes.name: cargo_damage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the container damage also resulted in damage to the cargo inside. Triggers separate cargo damage assessment and claims processes.
attributes.references: Terminal Operating System (TOS) Cargo Damage Management

attributes.name: cargo_status_at_discovery
attributes.description: Whether the container was empty or laden (loaded with cargo) when the damage was discovered. Impacts liability assessment and urgency of repair or cargo transfer.

attributes.name: claim_reference_number
attributes.description: External claim reference number assigned by the P&I club, insurance company, or shipping line for tracking the damage claim. Used for reconciliation and correspondence.

attributes.name: container_size_type
attributes.description: ISO 6346 container size and type code. Denormalized from container master for reporting and analysis. Format: 2-digit size code + 2-letter type code (e.g., 22G1 for 20ft general purpose).
attributes.references: ISO 6346 Container Size and Type Codes

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions implemented to prevent recurrence of similar damage incidents. May include training, equipment maintenance, process changes, or safety improvements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management and Corrective Action

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the damage record was first created in the Terminal Operating System. Part of audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: damage_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the damage observed, including dimensions, extent, and any contributing factors. Provides context for surveyors, repairers, and claims adjusters.

attributes.name: damage_location_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific location on the container where damage occurred. Uses IICL location coding system for precise damage mapping and repair specification.

attributes.name: damage_report_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the damage report used for external communication with shipping lines, P&I clubs, and surveyors. Format: DMG-YYYYMMDD sequence.

attributes.name: damage_report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the damage report. Tracks progression from initial discovery through survey, liability determination, claims processing, and final resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|disputed|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: damage_severity
attributes.description: Assessment of the severity level of the damage based on repair cost, structural integrity impact, and container serviceability. Used for prioritization and liability determination.

attributes.name: damage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of damage sustained by the container. Categorizes damage by the structural component or system affected to support repair estimation and liability assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: structural|door|floor|roof|side_panel|corner_post|front_wall|refrigeration_unit|twist_lock|seal — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IICL (Institute of International Container Lessors) Damage Classification

attributes.name: discovery_location
attributes.description: The specific physical location within the terminal where the damage was discovered, such as gate lane number, yard block and row, or berth position. Supports incident investigation and operational analysis.

attributes.name: discovery_point
attributes.description: The operational checkpoint or activity during which the damage was first discovered. Critical for establishing liability and determining whether damage occurred on-terminal or pre-existing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gate_in|gate_out|discharge|loading|yard_inspection|vessel_inspection|delivery|receiving — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Gate Operations and Yard Management

attributes.name: discovery_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the container damage was first identified and recorded. Used for liability determination and claims processing timelines.

attributes.name: edi_message_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the EDI message (such as CODECO Container Damage Report) sent to notify external parties of the damage. Supports audit trail and message reconciliation.

attributes.name: environmental_incident_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the container damage resulted in an environmental incident such as spill, leak, or release of hazardous materials. Triggers regulatory reporting and remediation protocols.

attributes.name: equipment_involved
attributes.description: Identification of terminal equipment involved in causing or discovering the damage, such as RTG (Rubber Tyred Gantry), STS (Ship-to-Shore crane), reach stacker, or gate inspection equipment. Supports root cause analysis.

attributes.name: estimated_repair_cost
attributes.description: Surveyor estimate of the cost to repair the damage to IICL standards. Used for liability assessment, claims processing, and repair authorization thresholds. Amount in terminal base currency.

attributes.name: imdg_class
attributes.description: IMDG classification of dangerous goods if the damaged container held hazardous cargo. Critical for safety assessment and environmental incident reporting. Empty if container held general cargo.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to the damage record. Tracks record currency and supports change detection for downstream systems.

attributes.name: liability_party

products.name: container_tariff_exception_application
products.description: This association product represents the application of approved tariff exceptions to specific container visits during terminal operations. It captures the operational linkage between negotiated rate concessions and actual container movements, recording which exceptions were applied, the effective rates charged, and the financial impact. Each record links one container visit to one tariff exception with attributes that exist only in the context of this billing application.. Existence Justification: In maritime terminal operations, a single container visit can have multiple tariff exceptions applied simultaneously (e.g., a volume discount exception plus a free-day extension exception for the same container), and a single tariff exception (such as a customer-level rate agreement) applies to multiple container visits over time. The business actively manages these applications as operational billing events, tracking which exceptions were applied to which containers, the effective rates charged, and the revenue impact for each application.

products.name: berth_discount_application
products.description: This association product represents the application of commercial discount schemes to specific berth allocations. It captures which discount schemes were applied to which berth allocations, the effective discount value realized, and the business justification for the discount application. Each record links one berth allocation to one discount scheme with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific discount application.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, a single berth allocation can qualify for multiple concurrent discount schemes (e.g., a high-volume customer receives both a loyalty discount and an off-peak berthing discount on the same vessel call). Conversely, a single discount scheme (e.g., 'Q1 2024 Container Volume Incentive') applies to many berth allocations across multiple customers and vessel calls. The commercial team actively manages which discounts apply to which allocations, tracks approval workflows, and records the effective discount amounts for billing reconciliation.

domains.name: cargo
domains.description: Manages cargo handling, loading/discharge operations, stowage planning (BAPLIE), dangerous goods (IMDG), FCL/LCL management, BOL processing, and cargo documentation. Covers cargo manifests, POL/POD tracking, container pre-announcement (COPARN), delivery orders (D/O), HS Code assignment, and cargo condition monitoring. SSOT for cargo movement and handling data.

products.name: shipment
products.description: Core master entity representing a cargo consignment moving through the port, from pre-arrival notification to final delivery or transshipment. Captures shipper/consignee parties, POL/POD routing, cargo type (FCL/LCL/RoRo/LoLo/Bulk), commodity description, HS Code reference, weight (MT), volume (CBM), TEU/FEU count, booking and BOL references, vessel call linkage, IMDG classification where applicable, and cargo lifecycle status. SSOT for cargo consignment identity within the port ecosystem.

attributes.name: cargo_condition

attributes.name: final_destination_port_code

attributes.name: imdg_class

attributes.name: is_oversized

attributes.name: is_transshipment
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this cargo is being transshipped (transferred to another vessel) rather than being delivered locally. Affects yard allocation, customs procedures, and operational workflow.

attributes.name: net_weight_mt

products.name: manifest
products.description: Transactional record of the cargo manifest submitted per vessel call, including individual line items representing each BOL or container entry. products.description: Master record for the vessel stowage plan (BAPLIE) associated with a vessel call, including individual container slot assignments (bay/row/tier positions). Captures BAPLIE message reference, vessel call reference, voyage number, plan version, plan type (pre-stow/final/actual), total TEU capacity, total TEU loaded, total weight (MT), stability calculation reference, trim and list values, hazmat segregation compliance flag, reefer plug count used, OOG (out-of-gauge) count, plan submission datetime, planner ID, and approval status. SSOT for vessel stowage planning data and container slot assignments. Sourced from NAVIS N4 vessel planning module.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cargo stowage plan record. Primary key for the vessel stowage plan associated with a specific vessel call.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or operations manager who approved the stowage plan. Ensures accountability in the approval workflow.

attributes.name: primary_stowage_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vessel planner or stowage coordinator responsible for creating this plan. Links to workforce management system.

attributes.name: security_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_incident. Business justification: Stowage plan tampering, unauthorized modifications, or cyber-attacks on planning systems are security incidents requiring investigation. Links plan integrity breaches to security response, supporting

attributes.name: vessel_call_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.call_booking. Business justification: Stowage plans are prepared for booked vessel calls - planning artifact must reference call booking for capacity validation, service requirement verification, and operational coordination between booki

attributes.name: vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel call for which this stowage plan is created. Links the stowage plan to a specific vessel visit.

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: FK to vessel.vessel

attributes.name: baplie_message_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number for the BAPLIE EDI message transmitted for this stowage plan. BAPLIE is the standard EDI message format for vessel stowage plans in maritime logistics.

attributes.name: created_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when this stowage plan record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: discharge_count
attributes.description: Total number of containers to be discharged at this port according to the stowage plan. Used for berth productivity planning.

attributes.name: empty_container_count
attributes.description: Number of empty containers included in the stowage plan. Empty containers are repositioned for operational needs and affect weight distribution.

attributes.name: hazmat_container_count
attributes.description: Total number of containers carrying dangerous goods according to IMDG classification. Used for safety planning and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: hazmat_segregation_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stowage plan complies with IMDG Code segregation requirements for dangerous goods. True means all hazmat containers are properly segregated according to their class.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stowage plan is the current active version for the vessel call. False for superseded or cancelled plans.

attributes.name: laden_container_count
attributes.description: Number of loaded (full) containers in the stowage plan. Represents containers carrying cargo as opposed to empty repositioning units.

attributes.name: last_modified_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when this stowage plan record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: list_value_degrees
attributes.description: Lateral inclination of the vessel from vertical measured in degrees. Indicates port or starboard tilt. Must be within safe limits for vessel operations.

attributes.name: load_count
attributes.description: Total number of containers to be loaded at this port according to the stowage plan. Used for yard and gate operations planning.

attributes.name: next_port_of_call
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the next port in the vessel's voyage after departure from the current port. Used for routing and discharge planning.

attributes.name: oog_count
attributes.description: Number of out-of-gauge containers in the stowage plan. OOG containers exceed standard dimensions and require special stowage considerations.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Standards

attributes.name: plan_approval_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the stowage plan was officially approved for execution. Marks the transition from planning to operational phase.

attributes.name: plan_completion_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the actual loading operations according to this plan were completed. Used for operational performance tracking.

attributes.name: plan_remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for planner notes, special instructions, or operational considerations related to this stowage plan. Captures context not represented in structured fields.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stowage plan. Tracks the plan through creation, approval, execution, and completion stages. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|in-progress|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: plan_submission_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time when the stowage plan was submitted for approval. Tracks the planning timeline and compliance with submission deadlines.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stowage plan stage. Pre-stow is the initial plan, final is the approved plan before operations, actual reflects the completed loading, and revised indicates changes after initial approval.

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version number of the stowage plan. Increments with each revision to track changes and updates to the plan during the planning lifecycle.

attributes.name: port_of_loading
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port where containers are being loaded according to this plan. Standard international port identifier.

attributes.name: reefer_plug_capacity
attributes.description: Total number of refrigerated container electrical connection points available on the vessel. Defines the maximum number of reefer containers that can be powered simultaneously.

attributes.name: reefer_plug_count_used
attributes.description: Number of refrigerated container electrical connection points (plugs) utilized in this stowage plan. Used to manage vessel power capacity for temperature-controlled cargo.

attributes.name: restow_count
attributes.description: Number of containers that need to be temporarily moved (restowed) to access containers underneath. Indicates stowage plan efficiency and operational complexity.

attributes.name: shipping_line_code
attributes.description: Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) identifying the shipping line operating the vessel. Four-character code used in EDI and documentation.
attributes.references: National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) SCAC Standard

attributes.name: stability_calculation_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the vessel stability calculation document or system record. Links to detailed stability analysis ensuring safe loading conditions.

attributes.name: terminal_operator_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the terminal operator responsible for executing the stowage plan. Links to the specific terminal handling the vessel.

attributes.name: total_feu_loaded
attributes.description: Number of forty-foot equivalent containers loaded on the vessel. Complements TEU count for detailed capacity tracking.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Standards

attributes.name: total_teu_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum container capacity of the vessel expressed in TEU. Represents the total number of twenty-foot equivalent containers the vessel can carry.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Standards

attributes.name: total_teu_loaded
attributes.description: Actual number of TEU loaded on the vessel according to this stowage plan. Used to calculate vessel utilization and capacity management.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Standards

attributes.name: total_weight_mt
attributes.description: Total weight of all cargo loaded on the vessel in metric tons. Critical for vessel stability calculations and compliance with safe loading limits.

attributes.name: transhipment_container_count
attributes.description: Number of containers being transhipped through this port (loaded from one vessel to be discharged to another). Important for port operations planning.

attributes.name: trim_value_meters
attributes.description: Difference in draft between the forward and aft of the vessel measured in meters. Positive value indicates stern trim, negative indicates bow trim. Critical for vessel stability and navigation safety.

attributes.name: vessel_imo_number
attributes.description: Seven-digit unique vessel identifier assigned by the International Maritime Organization. Permanent identifier that remains with the vessel throughout its lifetime.

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: The voyage identifier assigned by the shipping line for this vessel call. Used to track the vessel's journey across multiple ports.

products.name: stowage_position
products.description: Individual container slot assignment within a vessel stowage plan, representing the planned or actual position of a container on the vessel. Captures stowage plan reference, container number, bay number, row number, tier number, ISO position code, weight (KG), height (MM), port of discharge, hazmat class, reefer flag, OOG dimensions (overhang fore/aft/port/starboard/height), temperature setting, ventilation setting, and position status (planned/confirmed/actual). Enables BAPLIE message generation and vessel stability calculations.

attributes.name: stowage_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cargo stowage position record. Primary key for individual container slot assignments within vessel stowage plans.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.bill_of_lading. Business justification: Stowage position references the BOL for the cargo being stowed. Bol_number is denormalized and should be retrieved via FK. This links stowage planning to the cargo documentation.

attributes.name: container_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.container. Business justification: Stowage position assigns a specific container to a vessel bay/row/tier location. Container_number is denormalized and should be retrieved via FK. This is a core stowage planning relationship.

attributes.name: masterdata_shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipping line or slot charterer operating this container slot. May differ from vessel operator in slot charter arrangements.
attributes.references: Port Community System - PCS Stakeholder Messaging

attributes.name: primary_stowage_port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipper (consignor) party responsible for the cargo in this container. Links to customer/participant master data.
attributes.references: Port Community System - PCS Cargo Manifests

attributes.name: primary_stowage_vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel on which this container is stowed. Links to vessel master data for ship identification.

attributes.name: stowage_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vessel stowage plan that contains this position assignment. Links to the overall BAPLIE (Bayplan/Stowage Plan) document.

attributes.name: voyage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific voyage during which this stowage position is active. Links to voyage scheduling and routing information.

attributes.name: bay_number
attributes.description: Longitudinal position identifier on the vessel from bow to stern. Two or three-digit numeric code representing the bay location in the vessel's cell structure.

attributes.name: booking_reference
attributes.description: Shipping line booking number or reservation reference associated with this container. Links stowage position to commercial booking and Bill of Lading (BOL).

attributes.name: cargo_type
attributes.description: Classification of cargo loading: FCL (Full Container Load - single shipper), LCL (Less than Container Load - consolidated), empty (repositioning), special (project cargo, vehicles, etc.).

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stowage position assignment was confirmed and approved by the vessel planner. Represents the confirmation event in the position lifecycle.

attributes.name: container_height_mm
attributes.description: Physical height of the container in millimeters. Standard values include 2591mm (standard), 2896mm (high cube). Used for clearance and stacking calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 Freight Containers Classification Dimensions and Ratings

attributes.name: container_size_type
attributes.description: ISO 6346 four-character code identifying container size and type. First two characters indicate length and height, last two indicate type and features (e.g., 45G1 for 40ft high cube general purpose).
attributes.references: ISO 6346 - Freight Containers Coding Identification and Marking

attributes.name: container_weight_kg
attributes.description: Verified gross mass of the container including cargo and tare weight, measured in kilograms. Critical for vessel stability calculations and SOLAS VGM compliance.
attributes.references: SOLAS Convention Chapter VI Regulation 2 - Cargo Information

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stowage position record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: discharged_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the container was physically discharged from this stowage position. Null for containers still on board. Captured from terminal operating system crane operations.

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: World Customs Organization Harmonized System commodity classification code. Six to ten-digit code used for customs clearance, tariff determination, and trade statistics.

attributes.name: imdg_class
attributes.description: IMDG Code classification for dangerous goods cargo. Values range from 1 to 9 with subdivisions (e.g., 3.1, 8.2). Null for non-hazardous cargo. Critical for segregation and safety compliance.
attributes.references: IMDG Code - International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code

attributes.name: iso_position_code
attributes.description: Six-digit ISO 9711 compliant position code combining bay, row, and tier numbers. Standard format for container slot identification in BAPLIE messages.

attributes.name: lashing_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this container requires special lashing or securing beyond standard cell guides. True for deck cargo, OOG, or heavy containers requiring additional securing.
attributes.references: CSS Code - Code of Safe Practice for Cargo Stowage and Securing

attributes.name: loaded_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the container was physically loaded into this stowage position on the vessel. Captured from terminal operating system crane operations.

attributes.name: oog_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this container carries out-of-gauge cargo exceeding standard container dimensions. True for OOG cargo requiring special handling and stowage considerations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 Freight Containers Classification Dimensions and Ratings

attributes.name: overhang_aft_mm
attributes.description: Aft overhang dimension in millimeters for out-of-gauge cargo extending beyond the container rear. Null for standard cargo. Used for clearance and lashing calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 Freight Containers Classification Dimensions and Ratings

attributes.name: overhang_fore_mm
attributes.description: Forward overhang dimension in millimeters for out-of-gauge cargo extending beyond the container front. Null for standard cargo. Used for clearance and lashing calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 Freight Containers Classification Dimensions and Ratings

attributes.name: overhang_height_mm
attributes.description: Vertical overhang dimension in millimeters for out-of-gauge cargo extending above the container top. Null for standard cargo. Used for clearance and bridge height calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 Freight Containers Classification Dimensions and Ratings

attributes.name: overhang_port_mm
attributes.description: Port side overhang dimension in millimeters for out-of-gauge cargo extending beyond the container left side. Null for standard cargo. Used for clearance and lashing calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 Freight Containers Classification Dimensions and Ratings

attributes.name: overhang_starboard_mm
attributes.description: Starboard side overhang dimension in millimeters for out-of-gauge cargo extending beyond the container right side. Null for standard cargo. Used for clearance and lashing calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 668 - Series 1 Freight Containers Classification Dimensions and Ratings

attributes.name: planned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stowage position was initially planned and assigned in the vessel planning system. Represents the planning event in the position lifecycle.

attributes.name: pod_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port where this container will be discharged from the vessel. Critical for discharge sequencing and yard planning.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: pol_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE five-character code identifying the port where this container was loaded onto the vessel. Used for cargo tracking and manifest reconciliation.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE - United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stowage position assignment. Tracks progression from planning through execution: planned (initial assignment), confirmed (verified by planner), loaded (physically loaded), discharged (removed from vessel), restowed (repositioned), cancelled (assignment voided).

attributes.name: reefer_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this container is a refrigerated unit requiring temperature control and power connection. True for reefer containers, False for dry containers.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or exceptions related to this stowage position. May include handling instructions, damage notes, or coordination messages.

attributes.name: row_number
attributes.description: Transverse position identifier across the vessel from port to starboard. Two-digit numeric code with odd numbers on port side and even numbers on starboard side.

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: Security seal number affixed to the container door. Used for customs verification and cargo security. Multiple seals may be recorded as comma-separated values.

attributes.name: stowage_category
attributes.description: General stowage location category on the vessel: deck (above deck), hold (cargo hold), underdeck (below deck), hatch (hatch cover area). Affects cargo protection and accessibility.
attributes.references: SOLAS Convention Chapter VI - Carriage of Cargoes

attributes.name: temperature_setting_celsius
attributes.description: Target temperature setting for refrigerated containers in degrees Celsius. Null for non-reefer containers. Range typically -30°C to +30°C for perishable cargo.

attributes.name: tier_number
attributes.description: Vertical position identifier from keel to deck. Two-digit numeric code representing the tier level in the vessel's stacking structure.

attributes.name: transhipment_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this container is in transit and will be transferred to another vessel at this port. True for transhipment cargo, False for origin/destination cargo.
attributes.references: Port Community System - PCS Cargo Manifests

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for dangerous goods (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline). Null for non-hazardous cargo. Used for hazmat documentation and emergency response.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this stowage position record was last modified. Audit trail for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: ventilation_setting_cbm_per_hour
attributes.description: Ventilation airflow rate for reefer containers measured in cubic meters per hour. Null for non-reefer containers. Critical for cargo requiring fresh air exchange.

products.name: dangerous_goods_declaration
products.description: Master record for the Dangerous Goods Declaration (DGD) submitted for IMDG-classified cargo. Captures DGD number, shipment/BOL reference, container number, IMDG class (1–9), UN number, proper shipping name, packing group (I/II/III), flash point, net quantity, gross quantity, emergency contact, segregation group, special provisions, limited quantity flag, marine pollutant flag, EMS code, MFAG reference, declaration date, declarant details, and port authority acceptance status. Mandatory for IMDG compliance and ISPS security. Sourced from PCS.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_declaration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dangerous goods declaration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.bill_of_lading. Business justification: DGD is submitted for dangerous cargo covered by a specific BOL. Bol_number is denormalized and should be retrieved via FK. This links the hazmat declaration to the cargo title document.

attributes.name: cargo_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.cargo_booking. Business justification: DG declarations must reference cargo bookings for approval workflow, segregation planning, and compliance verification. Port authorities require linking hazmat declarations to booking commitments befo

attributes.name: compliance_hs_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.hs_code. Business justification: Hazmat cargo has specific HS code classifications (Chapter 28-38 chemicals, explosives, etc.). Real business need: dual-use goods screening, export controls, customs duty calculation for dangerous goo

attributes.name: container_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.container. Business justification: DGD specifies which container holds the dangerous goods. Container_number is denormalized and should be retrieved via FK. This is critical for stowage planning and segregation compliance.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.customs_declaration. Business justification: Dangerous goods declarations must be linked to customs declarations for regulatory compliance. Real business process: customs authorities require IMDG documentation as part of clearance; port state co

attributes.business_glossary_term: Declarant Port Community Participant Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.port_community_participant. Business justification: IMDG Code requires traceable declarant identity for dangerous goods liability and emergency response. Links declarant_name/company text to participant record for compliance verification, accreditation

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.emergency_response_plan. attributes.name: hazard_register_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.hazard_register. Business justification: DG cargo creates specific IMDG-classified hazards that must be registered in the port's hazard register for regulatory compliance, emergency response planning, segregation management, and terminal ris

attributes.name: inspector_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: IMDG Code and port authority regulations require documented inspector identity for dangerous goods declaration verification, acceptance decisions, and safety audit trail. Port state control inspection

attributes.name: packaging_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.packaging_type. Business justification: DG declarations must specify IMDG-compliant packaging with correct packing group for the IMDG class. Linking to packaging_type master enables automated validation of packaging group compatibility, UN

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.risk_assessment. Business justification: Each DG declaration requires formal risk assessment for stowage position, segregation compliance, handling procedures, and emergency response per IMDG Code and port safety management system. Risk asse

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment containing this dangerous goods cargo.

attributes.name: trade_restriction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.trade_restriction. Business justification: Dangerous goods may be subject to trade restrictions (dual-use goods, chemical weapons precursors, prohibited substances). Real regulatory requirement: export control compliance officers must screen D

attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel scheduled to carry this dangerous goods cargo. Used for vessel-level IMDG compliance checks and manifest aggregation.

attributes.name: acceptance_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the port authority officially accepted or rejected the dangerous goods declaration. Used for compliance reporting and gate release.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dangerous goods declaration record was first created in the Port Community System. Audit trail for compliance.

attributes.name: declarant_email
attributes.description: Email address of the declarant for official correspondence and declaration queries.

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: Date when the dangerous goods declaration was signed and submitted by the declarant. Critical for compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: declaration_place
attributes.description: City or location where the dangerous goods declaration was signed and issued.

attributes.name: dgd_number
attributes.description: Unique externally-known dangerous goods declaration document number issued by the shipper or freight forwarder.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the person or organization to contact in case of emergency involving this dangerous goods shipment. Required 24/7 availability.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency telephone number for technical advice on the dangerous goods. Must be monitored at all times during transport.

attributes.name: ems_code
attributes.description: Emergency response procedures for fires (F-code) and spillage (S-code). Format: F-X,S-Y where X and Y are letters (e.g., F-E,S-D). Guides crew emergency response.

attributes.name: excepted_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dangerous goods are shipped in excepted quantities per IMDG Code Chapter 3.5, allowing maximum packaging and documentation relief. True if excepted quantity, False otherwise.

attributes.name: flash_point_celsius
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors ignite when exposed to an ignition source, measured in degrees Celsius. Critical for Class 3 flammable liquids.

attributes.name: gross_quantity
attributes.description: Total weight or volume of the dangerous goods including packaging. Used for cargo manifests and capacity planning.

attributes.name: imdg_class
attributes.description: IMDG hazard classification: 1=Explosives, 2=Gases, 3=Flammable liquids, 4=Flammable solids, 5=Oxidizing substances, 6=Toxic/infectious, 7=Radioactive, 8=Corrosives, 9=Miscellaneous. Includes sub-divisions (e.g., 1.1, 2.1).

attributes.name: imdg_subsidiary_risk
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Subsidiary Risk
attributes.description: Secondary hazard class(es) if the substance presents additional risks beyond the primary IMDG class. Pipe-separated if multiple (e.g., 6.1|8).

tag_set.value: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Subsidiary Risk

attributes.name: inspection_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when physical inspection of the dangerous goods container was completed by port authority or customs officials.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether port authority or customs requires physical inspection of the dangerous goods container before acceptance. True if inspection required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: limited_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dangerous goods are shipped in limited quantities per IMDG Code Chapter 3.4, allowing certain packaging and labeling exemptions. True if limited quantity, False otherwise.

attributes.name: marine_pollutant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substance is identified as a marine pollutant under MARPOL Annex III. True if marine pollutant, False otherwise.
attributes.references: MARPOL Annex III; IMDG Code Section 2.10.3

attributes.name: mfag_reference
attributes.description: MFAG table number providing first aid guidance for exposure to this substance. Used by ship medical officers and port emergency responders.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dangerous goods declaration record was last updated. Tracks amendments and corrections to the declaration.

attributes.name: net_quantity
attributes.description: Net weight or volume of the dangerous goods excluding packaging. Used for segregation and stowage calculations.

attributes.name: number_of_packages
attributes.description: Total count of individual packages, drums, cylinders, or units containing the dangerous goods within the container or shipment.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: Degree of danger: I=High danger, II=Medium danger, III=Low danger. Determines packaging and handling requirements.

attributes.name: pod_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE 5-character code for the port where the dangerous goods container is discharged from the vessel.

attributes.name: pol_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE 5-character code for the port where the dangerous goods container is loaded onto the vessel.

attributes.name: port_authority_acceptance_status
attributes.description: Current status of port authority review and acceptance of the dangerous goods declaration: pending=awaiting review, accepted=approved for handling, rejected=not compliant, conditional=accepted with restrictions, under_review=in validation process.

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: Official UN proper shipping name of the dangerous goods as listed in the IMDG Code Dangerous Goods List. Must be used on all transport documents.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for net and gross quantities: kg=kilograms, L=liters, m3=cubic meters, tonnes=metric tons.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by port authority if the dangerous goods declaration was rejected or requires correction. Guides declarant remediation.

attributes.name: segregation_group
attributes.description: Segregation group code(s) determining stowage separation requirements from incompatible dangerous goods (e.g., acids, alkalis, ammonium compounds). Used for BAPLIE stowage planning.

attributes.name: special_provisions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IMDG special provision codes (e.g., SP23, SP274) that modify standard requirements for packing, stowage, or handling of this specific substance.

attributes.name: stowage_category
attributes.description: IMDG stowage category defining where cargo may be stowed on vessel: A=On or under deck, B=On deck only, C=Away from living quarters, D=On deck only away from living quarters, E=On deck only in open cargo space.

attributes.name: stowage_position
attributes.description: Actual or planned stowage location on vessel in bay-row-tier format (e.g., 010282 = Bay 01, Row 02, Tier 82). Used in BAPLIE for segregation verification.
attributes.references: BAPLIE EDI Message; IMDG Code Section 7.1

attributes.name: technical_name
attributes.description: Chemical or technical name of the substance, required when the proper shipping name is a generic N.O.S. (Not Otherwise Specified) entry.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the dangerous substance or article. Format: UN followed by 4 digits (e.g., UN1203 for gasoline).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods; IMDG Code

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: Voyage or rotation number of the vessel carrying this dangerous goods shipment. Links DGD to specific vessel call.

products.name: container_preadvice
products.description: Transactional record of COPARN (Container Pre-Announcement) EDI messages received from shipping lines or agents, notifying the terminal of containers expected for gate-in or vessel loading. Captures COPARN message ID, message reference number, sending party (shipping line/agent), receiving terminal, message datetime, vessel call reference, voyage number, container number, container type/size, operation type (in/out), expected arrival window, cargo status (full/empty), BOL reference, and processing status (received/validated/accepted/rejected). Sourced from PCS EDI gateway.

attributes.name: container_preadvice_id
attributes.description: Primary key for container_preadvice

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id

attributes.name: container_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.shipment. Business justification: COPARN is submitted for a specific shipment booking. Booking_reference is denormalized and should be retrieved via FK to shipment. This links the pre-advice message to the commercial shipment record.

products.name: shipment_tariff_exception
products.description: This association product represents the application of approved tariff exceptions to specific cargo shipments moving through the port. It captures the commercial pricing deviations granted for each shipment-exception combination, including the approved rates, discounts, waivers, extended free days, validity periods, and approval authority. Each record links one shipment to one tariff exception with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific application of the exception to the shipment.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, a single cargo shipment can legitimately have multiple tariff exceptions applied simultaneously (e.g., a volume discount exception, a free time extension exception, and a surcharge waiver exception all applying to the same shipment). Conversely, a single approved tariff exception (such as a trade lane discount or customer loyalty waiver) is routinely applied to multiple shipments that meet the exception criteria. Port commercial teams actively manage these exception applications as distinct operational records, tracking approval, rates, validity periods, and revenue impact for each shipment-exception combination for audit, compliance, and revenue management purposes.

products.name: cargo_rail_wagon_load
products.description: This association product represents the operational loading event between a container and a rail visit. It captures the physical placement of a specific container onto a specific wagon within a rail train visit, including wagon position, load sequence, securing/lashing instructions, and load/discharge timestamps. Each record represents one container's journey on one rail visit, with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific loading operation.. Existence Justification: In maritime rail intermodal operations, a single rail visit (train) carries multiple containers distributed across multiple wagons, and a single container can be transported on multiple different rail visits over its lifecycle (inbound to port, outbound to inland depot, repositioning moves, transshipment). The rail_wagon_load junction is an operational business entity that rail planners and terminal operators actively manage, tracking wagon position, load sequence, securing equipment, and load/discharge timestamps for each container-on-train movement.

products.name: container_gate_transaction
products.description: This association product represents the gate transaction event between a container and a truck visit. It captures the specific handling details, verification results, and condition assessment that occur when a particular container passes through the gate as part of a specific truck visit. Each record links one container to one truck visit with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific gate transaction.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, a single truck visit can handle multiple containers (e.g., a chassis carrying two 20-foot containers, or sequential gate transactions for multiple containers on one truck trip), and each container experiences multiple truck visits throughout its port dwell time (inbound delivery, repositioning moves, outbound pickup). Gate transaction data such as seal verification status, condition assessment, turnaround time, and damage reporting are specific to each container-visit combination and must be tracked per transaction.

products.name: bol_discount_application
products.description: This association product represents the application of commercial discount schemes to specific Bills of Lading. It captures which discount schemes were applied to each BOL, the verification of eligibility criteria, the calculated discount amount, and approval details for revenue reconciliation and audit purposes. Each record links one bill_of_lading to one discount_scheme with attributes that exist only in the context of this commercial discount application.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, a single Bill of Lading can qualify for and receive multiple discount schemes simultaneously (e.g., a volume discount for high TEU count, a loyalty discount for the shipping line's tier status, and a promotional campaign discount). Conversely, each discount scheme is applied to many different Bills of Lading over time as various shipments meet the eligibility criteria. The commercial/tariff team actively manages these discount applications, verifying eligibility, calculating amounts, obtaining approvals, and tracking them for revenue reconciliation and audit purposes.

products.name: container_surcharge_application
products.description: This association product represents the application of specific surcharge rules to individual containers during terminal operations and billing cycles. It captures the operational event of applying a surcharge (BAF, CAF, hazmat, oversize, peak season, etc.) to a container, including the calculated amount, calculation basis, timestamp, and any waivers or approvals. Each record links one container to one surcharge rule with attributes that exist only in the context of this billing application.. Existence Justification: In maritime terminal operations, containers routinely incur multiple surcharges simultaneously based on their characteristics and operational context (e.g., a refrigerated oversize container during peak season may incur BAF, CAF, reefer surcharge, oversize surcharge, and peak season surcharge). Conversely, each surcharge rule (BAF, CAF, hazmat, etc.) applies to thousands of containers that meet its applicability criteria. The terminal billing system actively manages these surcharge applications as discrete billing events, tracking the calculated amount, calculation basis, application timestamp, and any waivers for accurate invoicing and dispute resolution.
