products.name: risk_assessment_participant
products.description: This association product represents the formal involvement of port community participants in operational risk assessments for shared port operations. It captures participant-specific risk exposure levels, control responsibilities, consultation records, and mitigation commitments for multi-party operations such as vessel-shore interface activities, dangerous goods handling involving multiple stakeholders, and shared operational areas. Each record links one risk assessment to one port community participant with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific involvement relationship.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, risk assessments for shared operational areas and multi-party activities (vessel-shore interface, dangerous goods handling, bunkering operations) genuinely involve multiple port community participants simultaneously, each with distinct exposure levels and control responsibilities. A single risk assessment for a vessel bunkering operation may involve the shipping line, bunkering service provider, port operator, and potentially customs/inspection authorities, each requiring formal consultation, risk acceptance, and mitigation commitments under ISO 45001. Conversely, a single participant like a major shipping line is involved in dozens of different risk assessments across different operational areas, vessel types, and hazardous activities throughout the year.

attributes.description: Physical or RFID-enabled port access badge number issued to the contact person for entry into controlled port facility zones. Links to the port access control system for audit trail and ISPS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISPS Code - Port Facility Security; RFID Access Control Standards; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: preferred_channel
attributes.description: The contact person's preferred channel for receiving port notifications and operational communications. Drives the notification dispatch logic in the Port Management Information System (PMIS) and PCS messaging engine. Valid values: email (electronic mail), sms (short message service), phone (voice call), fax (facsimile), pcs_portal (Port Community System web portal), edi (Electronic Data Interchange automated message).
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; IMO FAL Convention; EDI Standards (UN/EDIFACT)

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or BCP-47 language code representing the contact person's preferred language for receiving communications, documents, and notifications (e.g., 'en' for English, 'zh-CN' for Simplified Chinese, 'ar' for Arabic). Supports multilingual port community operations.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 - Language Codes; BCP-47 Language Tags; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Formal salutation or honorific prefix for the contact person (e.g., Mr, Ms, Dr, Capt). Used in formal port correspondence, bill of lading communications, and official maritime documentation where professional titles are required.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention - Facilitation of International Maritime Traffic; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Contact Entity (salutation field)

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the contact person's operational location (e.g., 'Asia/Singapore', 'Europe/Rotterdam', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Used to schedule notifications and communications at appropriate local times, particularly for ETA/ETD alerts across international shipping routes.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; IMO FAL Convention

products.name: participant_address
products.description: Physical and postal address records for port community participants, supporting multiple address types per participant: registered office, operational address, billing address, correspondence address, and port agent address. Captures street, city, state, postal code, country (ISO 3166), address type, and validity period. Used for trade documentation, customs declarations, and invoice delivery.

attributes.name: participant_address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each participant address record in the port community system. Primary key for the participant_address data product.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: add column country_id (BIGINT) with FK to masterdata.country.country_id - addresses must reference a standardized country for trade compliance

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, cargo owner, customs broker, trucking company, port agent, etc.) to whom this address belongs.

attributes.name: address_format_type
attributes.description: Indicates the structural format of the address. Structured addresses follow standard street/city/postal hierarchy; unstructured addresses are free-form (common in some Asian and Middle Eastern jurisdictions); po_box and private_bag are postal delivery formats used for correspondence addresses.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Standard; WCO Data Model

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including building number, street name, or PO Box. Used in trade documentation, customs declarations, and invoice delivery per WCO data model requirements.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; IMO FAL Convention Form 1; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, unit, building name, or additional location detail. Supplements address_line_1 for complete postal addressing on customs declarations and trade documents.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Standard

attributes.name: address_line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for district, suburb, or additional locality detail. Used for complex international addresses where two lines are insufficient for complete postal addressing on BOL and customs documentation.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Standard

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active addresses are used in trade documentation and invoice delivery. Pending_verification addresses are awaiting confirmation from the participant or customs authority. Superseded addresses have been replaced by a newer record but retained for historical audit.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Address Management; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address purpose within port community operations. Registered office is the legal entity address; operational is the day-to-day working address; billing is used for invoice delivery and THC/WHR/DMG charge correspondence; correspondence is for general trade documentation and BOL/D/O dispatch; port_agent is the local port agent's operational address.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Address Management; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: attention_to
attributes.description: Name of the specific person, department, or role to whom correspondence should be directed at this address. Used on trade documents, BOL, D/O, and invoice delivery to ensure correct routing within large organisations such as shipping lines or freight forwarders.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Standard

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the address. Required field for customs declarations, trade documentation, and invoice delivery. Used in Port Community System (PCS) for cargo manifest address validation.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under ISPS Code, ISO 28000 supply chain security, and port community data governance policies.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; ISPS Code; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: customs_registered_address_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the officially registered address with the national customs authority for the participant. Customs-registered addresses are used on import/export declarations and must match the address held in the customs authority's trader registration system.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework; National Customs Authority Requirements; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: customs_registration_number
attributes.description: Customs authority registration or trader identification number associated with this address. Required for customs declarations and trade compliance submissions. Corresponds to the Economic Operator Registration and Identification (EORI) number or equivalent national customs trader ID.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; WCO SAFE Framework; National Customs Authority Requirements

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Department or business unit within the participant organisation at this address. Used for routing trade documentation, customs correspondence, and invoices to the correct operational unit (e.g., Import Operations, Customs Compliance, Accounts Payable).
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this address record is valid and in use for the participant. Supports temporal address management for participants who change registered office or operational addresses. Used in trade documentation to ensure the correct address is applied for a given transaction date.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; IMO FAL Convention; SAP S/4HANA - Business Partner Address Management

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date until which this address record is valid. Null indicates the address is currently active with no planned expiry. When populated, the address is superseded after this date and a new address record should be active. Supports validity period management for port agent addresses and seasonal operational addresses.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; IMO FAL Convention; SAP S/4HANA - Business Partner Address Management

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address associated with this specific address record. Used for electronic delivery of invoices, D/O, trade documentation, and customs correspondence to the correct department or location within the participant organisation.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; EDI Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number associated with this address. Retained for legacy trade documentation workflows and customs authorities that still require fax-based submission of cargo manifests and customs declarations in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; WCO Data Model; National Customs Authority Requirements

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary address for the given address type for the participant. Only one address per participant per address_type should be flagged as primary at any point in time. Used to determine the default address for invoice generation and trade documentation.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Address Management; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the address has been verified against an authoritative postal or customs registry. Verified addresses are required for customs declarations and official trade documentation submissions to national customs authorities.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; National Customs Authority Requirements; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: isps_facility_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Facility Code
attributes.description: ISPS facility code assigned to the address if it is a port facility or secure logistics facility. Required for ISPS Code compliance and port security declarations. Applicable to port agent addresses and operational addresses at ISPS-designated facilities.
attributes.references: ISPS Code (International Ship and Port Facility Security Code); IMO MSC/Circ.1192; National Maritime Safety Authority

tag_set.value: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Facility Code

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language in which the address is recorded. Relevant for multilingual port communities where addresses may be recorded in local script (e.g., Arabic, Chinese, Japanese) as well as in Latin script for international trade documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; WCO Data Model; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for geospatial analytics, port logistics routing, and intermodal transport coordination. Particularly relevant for container yard (CY), ICD, and CFS addresses.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for geospatial analytics, port logistics routing, and intermodal transport coordination. Particularly relevant for container yard (CY), ICD, and CFS addresses.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with this address. Used to capture delivery instructions, access restrictions, security clearance requirements, or other operational notes relevant to port logistics and trade documentation delivery.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: pcs_address_reference
attributes.description: Address reference code assigned by the Port Community System for use in EDI messaging, cargo manifests, and customs integration. Used in COPARN, IFTMIN, and other EDI message types to identify the participant's address without transmitting full address details.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - EDI Standards; UN/EDIFACT; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number associated with this address location. Used for operational contact at the specific address, particularly for port agent addresses and operational addresses. Formatted in E.164 international format where possible.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; IMO FAL Convention; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the address. Used for invoice delivery, trade documentation, and customs declarations. Format varies by country; validated against country-specific postal code standards in the Port Community System.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Standard; WCO Data Model

attributes.name: source_system_address_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this address record in the originating source system (e.g., Dynamics 365 CRM address GUID, the source system address sequence number, PCS address reference). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and back-integration with operational systems.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; SAP S/4HANA ERP - Business Partner; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the address. Captured as ISO 3166-2 subdivision code where applicable. Required for customs declarations in jurisdictions with state-level trade compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; WCO Data Model; National Customs Authority Requirements

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number (VAT, GST, or equivalent) registered at this address. Used for invoice generation, THC billing, and financial reporting. Required for cross-border trade documentation and compliance with national tax authority requirements.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; National Tax Authority Requirements; SAP S/4HANA FI - Tax Management

attributes.name: un_locode
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE for the city or port location associated with this address. Particularly relevant for port agent addresses and operational addresses at seaport locations. Used in EDI messaging (IFTMIN, COPARN) and PCS cargo manifest submissions.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations); UNECE Recommendation 16; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and for audit trail compliance under port community data governance and trade compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; ISPS Code; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the address was last verified. Used to determine whether re-verification is required per port security and trade compliance policies. Addresses older than the configured re-verification threshold may be flagged for review.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method by which the address was verified. Manual verification is performed by port operations staff; postal_registry uses national postal authority data; customs_registry uses WCO or national customs authority data; third_party uses a commercial address validation service; self_declared is provided by the participant without independent verification.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; ISPS Code

products.name: org_hierarchy
products.description: Captures parent-child corporate hierarchy relationships between port community participants — shipping line parent companies and their regional subsidiaries, freight forwarder networks, and conglomerate cargo owners. Tracks hierarchy type (corporate, operational, billing), effective dates, and relationship depth. Enables consolidated billing, group credit management, and enterprise-level reporting across related entities.

attributes.name: org_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each parent-child corporate hierarchy relationship record between port community participants in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; IAPH Data Standards

attributes.name: child_org_port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the child or subsidiary organisation entity in the hierarchy (e.g., regional subsidiary, local freight forwarder branch, subsidiary cargo owner). Used to traverse downward in the corporate tree.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account Hierarchy; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: parent_port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: add column parent_participant_id (BIGINT) with FK to customer.port_community_participant.port_community_participant_id - org hierarchy needs a parent reference to model corporate group structures

attributes.name: primary_root_org_port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ultimate parent (root) organisation at the top of the corporate hierarchy tree. Enables direct group-level consolidation for billing, credit management, and enterprise reporting without full tree traversal.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA FI Group Consolidation

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for the creation or modification of this hierarchy relationship. 'approved' = validated and authorised by the port commercial team; 'pending_approval' = submitted and awaiting review; 'rejected' = not approved; 'under_review' = currently being assessed.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Workflow; SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner Approval

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the port authority commercial officer or system user who approved this hierarchy relationship. Used for audit trail and governance compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Governance

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy relationship was formally approved by the authorised port commercial officer. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Governance

attributes.name: billing_consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether charges and invoices for the child organisation are consolidated and billed to the parent organisation under this hierarchy relationship. True = consolidated billing applies (e.g., THC, WHR, DMG charges rolled up to parent); False = child is billed independently.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module; SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Receivable; IAPH Tariff Standards

attributes.name: contract_inheritance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child organisation inherits master contract terms (tariff schedules, service agreements, credit terms) from the parent organisation. True = contract terms cascade; False = child operates under its own independently negotiated contracts.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Contract Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Hierarchy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage, compliance, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: credit_consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the credit limit and credit exposure of the child organisation is managed at the parent group level under this hierarchy. True = group credit management applies; False = child has independent credit management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: crm_account_hierarchy_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Account Hierarchy ID
attributes.description: The source system identifier for this hierarchy relationship as recorded in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account Hierarchy module. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the CRM system of record and the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account Hierarchy Module

tag_set.value: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Account Hierarchy ID

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this parent-child hierarchy relationship becomes valid and binding. Used for temporal validity tracking, consolidated billing activation, and group credit management effective dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner Time-Dependency; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this parent-child hierarchy relationship ceases to be valid. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active relationship. Used for historical hierarchy reconstruction and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner Time-Dependency; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: governance_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary legal jurisdiction governing this hierarchy relationship. Relevant for regulatory compliance, ISPS Code administration, and Port State Control (PSC) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IMO ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; WCO

attributes.name: hierarchy_category
attributes.description: Classifies the port community participant category to which this hierarchy relationship belongs. Enables segment-specific analytics and reporting (e.g., shipping line parent-subsidiary networks, freight forwarder global networks, conglomerate cargo owner structures). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shipping_line|freight_forwarder|cargo_owner|customs_broker|trucking_company|port_agent — promote to reference product if additional values required]
attributes.references: IAPH Port Community Participant Classification; Port Community System (PCS) Stakeholder Messaging Standards

attributes.name: hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business code identifying this specific hierarchy relationship, used for cross-system referencing in Port Community System (PCS) and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM. Follows the format ORG-HIER-[alphanumeric].
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Stakeholder Messaging Standards; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: hierarchy_depth_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth level of this relationship within the overall corporate hierarchy tree, where level 1 represents the ultimate parent (root node). Enables efficient tree traversal, roll-up reporting, and enterprise-level consolidated analytics across related port community participants.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Community System Standards; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialised path string representing the full ancestry chain from root to this node (e.g., '/1001/1045/1078'), enabling efficient subtree queries and hierarchy traversal without recursive joins. Populated and maintained by the TOS/CRM integration pipeline.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account Hierarchy; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Design Patterns

attributes.name: hierarchy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hierarchy relationship. 'active' = currently valid and in use; 'inactive' = relationship exists but not currently operative; 'pending' = awaiting approval or activation; 'suspended' = temporarily halted (e.g., credit hold); 'terminated' = permanently ended.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner Lifecycle

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the parent-child relationship. 'corporate' = legal ownership/shareholding structure; 'operational' = operational reporting line; 'billing' = consolidated billing and invoicing group; 'regulatory' = regulatory compliance grouping (e.g., ISPS, IMO); 'commercial' = commercial/contractual grouping for tariff and SLA management.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Community System Standards; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000

attributes.name: imo_company_number
attributes.description: The IMO Company Identification Number assigned to the parent organisation in this hierarchy by the International Maritime Organization. Provides a unique, permanent identifier for shipping companies and operators for regulatory compliance and vessel ownership tracking.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.1078(28) — IMO Company and Registered Owner Identification Number Scheme

attributes.name: is_primary_hierarchy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy relationship is the primary (canonical) hierarchy for the child organisation when multiple hierarchy types exist. True = primary hierarchy used for default roll-up reporting and consolidated billing; False = secondary or supplementary hierarchy.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account Hierarchy; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy relationship record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, commercial notes, or operational remarks about this hierarchy relationship that are not captured in structured fields. Used by port commercial and customer service teams.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Notes; IAPH Port Community System Standards

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of equity ownership the parent organisation holds in the child organisation for corporate hierarchy types. Relevant for regulatory reporting, group credit exposure assessment, and consolidated financial reporting. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: IMO Ship Registration and Ownership Standards; WCO Trade Compliance; SAP S/4HANA FI Consolidation

attributes.name: pcs_hierarchy_ref
attributes.description: The external reference identifier for this hierarchy relationship as recorded in the Port Community System (PCS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and the PCS for customs integration, cargo manifest, and trade documentation purposes.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) Stakeholder Messaging Standards; WCO Data Model

attributes.name: regulatory_group_code
attributes.description: Regulatory grouping code assigned by the port authority or national maritime safety authority to identify this hierarchy for compliance reporting purposes (e.g., ISPS security group, PSC inspection group, IMO company identification grouping).
attributes.references: IMO ISPS Code Administration; National Maritime Safety Authority; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: relationship_role
attributes.description: Describes the specific role of the child organisation relative to the parent within this hierarchy link. For example, a shipping line regional office may be a 'subsidiary', while a port agent acting on behalf of a shipping line is an 'agent'.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Account Relationship Types; IAPH Stakeholder Classification

attributes.name: sla_inheritance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child organisation inherits the Service Level Agreement (SLA) terms and conditions from the parent organisation under this hierarchy relationship. True = SLA terms cascade from parent to child; False = child has independently negotiated SLA terms.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Agreements; IAPH Port Service Standards

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this hierarchy relationship was terminated or deactivated. Supports audit compliance, regulatory reporting, and historical analysis of port community participant corporate changes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corporate_restructure|acquisition|divestiture|contract_expiry|regulatory_action|voluntary_exit|other — promote to reference product if additional values required]
attributes.references: IMO Ship Ownership and Registration; WCO Trade Compliance; SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner Lifecycle

products.name: accreditation
products.description: Single source of truth for all accreditations, certifications, permits, official documents, and access credentials held by port community participants and their personnel/vehicles. Covers entity-level accreditations (ISPS facility security, customs broker licensing, freight forwarder registration, dangerous goods handling certification, stevedoring company accreditation), official documents (trade licences, insurance certificates including P&I cover, vessel operator certificates), and individual-level permits (port access permits for personnel and vehicles, ISPS security zone access authorisations, biometric-linked access credentials, contractor access passes). Captures document/certificate type, scope level (entity, individual, vehicle), permit holder reference, issuing authority, certificate/document number, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, verification status, file reference, security zone access level, biometric reference, revocation status, and linked compliance requirements. This product subsumes what were previously separate participant_document and port_access_permit concepts — all official documents and access permits are managed here as a single SSOT. Critical for compliance gating in PCS and VTMS workflows, ISPS Code enforcement, port zone access control, and audit readiness.
products.reference: ISPS / IMO / National Maritime Authority Certification

attributes.name: accreditation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each accreditation, certification, permit, or official document record held by a port community participant or their personnel/vehicle. Primary key for the accreditation data product.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; ISPS Code

attributes.name: compliance_hs_code_id

attributes.name: contractor_safety_id

attributes.name: cost_centre_id

attributes.name: imdg_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.imdg_class. Business justification: Dangerous goods handling accreditations specify which IMDG classes the holder is certified for; mandatory for ISPS compliance, cargo acceptance gate checks, and segregation enforcement in port operati

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant entity (shipping line, freight forwarder, customs broker, stevedoring company, trucking company, port agent, cargo owner, etc.) that holds this accreditation at the entity level. Null when the accreditation is held at individual or vehicle level only.

attributes.name: accreditation_category
attributes.description: High-level category grouping for the accreditation. Security covers ISPS and access control documents. Trade Compliance covers customs, freight forwarder, and broker licences. Operational covers stevedoring, dangerous goods, and vessel operator certifications. Insurance covers P&I and liability certificates. Environmental covers ISO 14001 and MARPOL compliance certificates. Health and Safety covers OHS and ISO 45001 certifications.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; WCO SAFE Framework; IMO MARPOL; ISO 14001; ISO 45001; ILO MLC 2006

attributes.name: coverage_scope_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific operational scope, geographic coverage, or service categories covered by this accreditation (e.g., 'Authorised for FCL and LCL customs clearance at Port of Melbourne', 'Stevedoring operations limited to container terminal berths 1-6'). Provides context beyond the accreditation type classification.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework; ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this accreditation record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation point for data lineage, compliance reporting, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: crm_record_reference
attributes.description: The record identifier from Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM corresponding to this accreditation. Enables bidirectional synchronisation between the accreditation data product and the CRM system for customer-facing compliance status visibility and service request management.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The official externally-assigned certificate, licence, permit, or document number as issued by the relevant authority (e.g., customs broker licence number, ISPS facility security certificate number, port access permit number). This is the primary business identifier used in compliance gating and audit trails.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; ISO 28000

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation, certificate, or permit ceases to be valid. Null for open-ended or permanent accreditations. Used as the primary trigger for renewal workflows, compliance gating in PCS and VTMS, and automated expiry alerts. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; ISO 28000; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: file_reference
attributes.description: Storage path, URL, or document management system reference to the scanned or digital copy of the original accreditation document or certificate. Enables direct retrieval of source documents for audit, compliance verification, and Port State Control inspections.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The maximum indemnity coverage amount specified in the insurance certificate, expressed in the currency indicated by insurance_currency_code. Populated only for insurance certificate accreditation types. Used to verify that minimum coverage thresholds required by port bylaws are met. Classified as confidential financial data.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs; IMO FAL Convention; National Maritime Safety Authority; ISO 28000

attributes.name: insurance_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the insurance coverage amount (e.g., USD, EUR, AUD). Populated only when insurance_coverage_amount is present.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; International Group of P&I Clubs; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this accreditation is a mandatory regulatory or port bylaw requirement for the participant to conduct operations. True indicates the accreditation is legally or contractually required. False indicates it is voluntary or supplementary. Used in compliance gating logic to determine whether a missing or expired accreditation blocks operations.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; National Maritime Safety Authority; Port Bylaws

attributes.name: is_revoked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this accreditation has been formally revoked by the issuing authority or the port. True indicates the accreditation is revoked and must not be used for compliance gating. Provides a fast-path check for access control systems independent of the full status field.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO Resolution A.1119(30); National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation, certificate, or permit was officially issued by the issuing authority. Establishes the effective start of the document's validity period and is used in compliance age calculations.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; ISPS Code; ISO 28000; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: issuing_authority_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction under which the accreditation was issued. Critical for cross-border trade compliance, mutual recognition agreements, and Port State Control verification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Full name of the government body, regulatory authority, classification society, or port authority that issued the accreditation, certificate, or permit (e.g., National Maritime Safety Authority, Customs Authority, Port State Control, IMO-recognised organisation). Used for verification and audit purposes.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; ISPS Code; ISO 28000

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this accreditation record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit trail completeness in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the accreditation was verified against the issuing authority's records or through a formal audit process. Used to determine whether re-verification is required and to support Port State Control inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; ISO 28000; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: linked_compliance_requirement
attributes.description: Reference code or description of the specific regulatory or contractual compliance requirement that mandates this accreditation (e.g., 'ISPS Code Section 2.1.4', 'Customs Act Section 183', 'Port Bylaws Clause 12.3'). Links the accreditation to the governing regulatory framework for audit readiness.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework; ISO 28000; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, conditions, restrictions, or remarks associated with this accreditation record. May include special conditions imposed by the issuing authority, port-specific operational restrictions, or compliance officer observations.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; ISPS Code; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: pcs_document_reference
attributes.description: The document identifier assigned by the Port Community System (PCS) to this accreditation record. Enables direct cross-reference between the accreditation data product and the PCS for customs integration, cargo manifest compliance gating, and stakeholder messaging workflows.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); IMO FAL Convention; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: permit_holder_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued identity document number (passport, national ID, seafarer's identity document) of the individual permit holder. Populated only when scope_level is 'individual'. Used for identity verification at port access control points and ISPS security zone entry. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention Form 5; ILO Seafarers Identity Documents Convention (No. 185); GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: permit_holder_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual person (personnel, contractor, driver) who holds this permit or access credential when scope_level is 'individual'. Null for entity-level or vehicle-level accreditations. Classified as restricted PII as it directly identifies a natural person.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; IMO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); ISPS Code; ILO MLC

attributes.name: pi_insurance_policy_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Insurance Policy Number
attributes.description: The Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club insurance policy number associated with this insurance certificate accreditation. Populated only when accreditation_type is 'pi_insurance_certificate'. P&I cover is a mandatory requirement for vessel operators and stevedoring companies operating within the port. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: International Group of P&I Clubs; IMO FAL Convention; SOLAS; National Maritime Safety Authority

tag_set.value: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Insurance Policy Number

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the renewal application must be submitted to the issuing authority to avoid a lapse in accreditation. Typically calculated as a fixed lead-time before the expiry_date (e.g., 30 or 60 days prior). Drives automated renewal reminder workflows and compliance monitoring dashboards.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Tracks the current state of the renewal process for this accreditation. Not Due indicates the document is current and renewal is not yet required. Renewal Initiated indicates internal renewal preparation has begun. Renewal Submitted indicates the renewal application has been lodged with the issuing authority. Renewal Approved indicates the renewed document has been received. Renewal Overdue indicates the document has expired and renewal has not been completed.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation was formally revoked by the issuing authority or the port authority. Null when the accreditation has not been revoked. Used in audit trails and compliance investigations.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO Resolution A.1119(30); Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for revocation of the accreditation, as recorded by the revoking authority or port compliance officer. Null when not revoked. Critical for audit readiness and ISPS Code enforcement documentation.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO Resolution A.1119(30); ISO 28000

attributes.name: rfid_tag_number
attributes.description: The Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag number embedded in the physical access card or vehicle transponder associated with this accreditation. Used for automated gate access control and security zone entry tracking in NAVIS N4 gate operations.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations; ISO/IEC 18000 RFID Standards

attributes.name: scope_level
attributes.description: Indicates whether this accreditation applies at the entity (organisation/company) level, individual (person/personnel) level, or vehicle level. Drives compliance gating logic in PCS and VTMS workflows and determines which permit holder reference fields are populated.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accreditation was suspended by the issuing authority or the port. Null when the accreditation has not been suspended. Used in compliance investigations and audit trails to track the duration of suspension periods.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; IMO Resolution A.1119(30)

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for suspension of the accreditation, as recorded by the suspending authority or port compliance officer. Null when not suspended. Required for ISPS Code enforcement documentation and Port State Control audit readiness.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; ISO 28000

attributes.name: vehicle_registration_number
attributes.description: Official vehicle registration plate number for vehicle-level access permits. Populated only when scope_level is 'vehicle'. Used for automated gate access control, RFID matching, and port security zone vehicle authorisation in NAVIS N4 gate operations.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; National Maritime Safety Authority; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle for which the access permit is issued. Populated only when scope_level is 'vehicle'. Determines applicable port zones, weight restrictions, and operational areas within the terminal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truck|trailer|forklift|reach_stacker|agv|private_vehicle|motorcycle|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISPS Code; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accreditation or document has been independently verified against the issuing authority's records. Unverified indicates the document has been received but not yet checked. Verified indicates successful confirmation with the issuing authority. Verification Failed indicates the document could not be confirmed as authentic. Pending Verification indicates verification has been initiated and is in progress.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; WCO SAFE Framework; ISO 28000; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

products.name: sla_profile
products.description: Single source of truth for Service Level Agreement definitions, targets, and measured performance outcomes for port community participants. Defines performance commitments including vessel turnaround time targets, container dwell time limits, gate processing time SLAs, documentation processing windows, and billing dispute resolution timeframes. Captures SLA tier name, metric type, target value, unit of measure, measurement window, breach threshold, and penalty/credit terms. Also stores all operational performance measurement records: measurement period, actual value, variance from target, breach flag, breach severity, remediation action taken, responsible party, and measurement timestamp. This product subsumes what was previously a separate sla_performance concept — both SLA definitions and their measured outcomes are managed here as a single SSOT. Assigned to participants via service agreements. Enables SLA reporting, penalty/credit calculation, performance trending, breach alerting, and continuous improvement tracking.
products.reference: Port SLA Framework / PMIS SLA Configuration

attributes.name: sla_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the SLA profile record. Serves as the primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, cargo owner, customs broker, trucking company, or port agent) to whom this SLA profile is assigned. Links to the customer master in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and Port Community System (PCS).
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS); IAPH Stakeholder Management

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: SLAs are often berth-specific or terminal-specific (container terminal vs bulk terminal); performance measurement, crane availability commitments, and turnaround time targets require precise location

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: SLA targets vary fundamentally by vessel category (container, bulk, tanker); turnaround time commitments, pilotage requirements, and berth allocation priorities differ by vessel type in port service a

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Actual Performance Value
attributes.description: The measured actual performance value for the metric_type during the measurement period. For example, actual vessel turnaround time of 26.5 hours, actual container dwell time of 4.2 days, or actual gate processing time of 12 minutes. Expressed in unit_of_measure. Sourced from NAVIS N4 TOS, VTMS, or PCS operational data.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Performance Reporting; IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework; VTMS

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Actual Performance Value

attributes.name: bol_reference
attributes.description: The Bill of Lading reference number associated with the cargo or container for which this SLA measurement applies. Relevant for cargo handling, documentation processing, and customs clearance SLA types. Links to PCS cargo manifest and trade documentation records.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); WCO Customs Data Model; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: breach_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of SLA breach events recorded within the current measurement_window period. Used to determine if escalating penalty tiers apply (e.g., first breach = warning, third breach = critical escalation) and to track chronic underperformance patterns.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Escalation Framework

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual_value exceeded the breach_threshold for this measurement period, constituting a formal SLA breach. When True, triggers penalty/credit calculation workflows in the source system and escalation notifications in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Billing Module; SAP S/4HANA FI; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: Classification of the severity level when a breach of the SLA threshold occurs. Critical breaches trigger immediate escalation and maximum penalty/credit terms; warning-level breaches initiate remediation planning without financial penalty. Used in SLA breach alerting and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Escalation Framework; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: breach_threshold
attributes.description: The value at which an SLA breach is formally triggered. May differ from target_value to allow a tolerance band (e.g., target vessel turnaround = 24 hours, breach threshold = 28 hours). Expressed in the same unit_of_measure as target_value. Used for automated breach alerting in NAVIS N4 and PCS.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework; NAVIS N4 TOS Billing Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this SLA profile record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data governance, lineage tracking, and compliance reporting in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: credit_cap_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Credit Cap Value
attributes.description: The maximum cumulative credit or penalty amount that can be applied within a single measurement_window period, expressed in penalty_currency_code. Protects the port operator from unlimited financial exposure under a single SLA agreement. Confidential commercial contract term.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO; IAPH Commercial Best Practices

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Credit Cap Value

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective End Date
attributes.description: The date on which this SLA profile definition ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended profiles. When populated, triggers profile_status transition to 'expired'. Aligns with contract expiry management in the source system Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective End Date

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective Start Date
attributes.description: The date from which this SLA profile definition becomes binding and applicable to assigned service agreements. Aligns with contract commencement dates in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and the source system management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective Start Date

attributes.name: escalation_contact
attributes.description: Name or role designation of the primary escalation contact responsible for managing SLA breach resolution on behalf of the port operator. Typically a Port Operations Manager or Commercial Manager. Confidential internal business contact information.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Escalation Framework; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: force_majeure_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether force majeure clauses apply to this SLA profile, suspending breach penalties during declared force majeure events (e.g., severe weather, port closures, ISPS security incidents). When True, breach measurements are paused during force majeure periods.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Convention; ISPS Code; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: imo_number
attributes.description: The IMO vessel identification number associated with the vessel call for vessel-operations SLA measurements. Provides a globally unique, permanent vessel identifier for cross-referencing with VTMS, NAVIS N4, and international maritime databases. Nullable for non-vessel SLA types.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Identification Number Scheme (Resolution A.1078(28)); SOLAS Chapter XI-1 Regulation 3

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this SLA profile record was most recently modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer, change data capture (CDC) processing, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Internal Data Governance Standard; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: measurement_period_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Period End Timestamp
attributes.description: The precise end timestamp of the performance measurement period for this SLA record. For vessel-call SLAs, this is the Actual Time of Departure (ATD); for gate processing SLAs, this is the gate-out timestamp. Captured from NAVIS N4 TOS or VTMS event feeds.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Event Management; VTMS Vessel Tracking; IMO Port Efficiency Guidelines

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Period End Timestamp

attributes.name: measurement_period_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Period Start Timestamp
attributes.description: The precise start timestamp of the performance measurement period for this SLA record. For vessel-call SLAs, this is the Actual Time of Arrival (ATA); for gate processing SLAs, this is the gate-in timestamp. Captured from NAVIS N4 TOS or VTMS event feeds.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS Event Management; VTMS Vessel Tracking; IMO Port Efficiency Guidelines

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Period Start Timestamp

attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Source System
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the actual_value measurement was sourced. Ensures data lineage traceability for SLA disputes and audit purposes. attributes.description: The time window over which SLA performance is measured and evaluated. 'per_call' applies to individual vessel calls or gate transactions; 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly' apply to aggregated operational periods. Determines the frequency of SLA reporting cycles.

attributes.description: The specific performance metric being governed by this SLA profile (e.g., 'vessel_turnaround_time', 'container_dwell_time', 'gate_in_processing_time', 'documentation_processing_window', 'billing_dispute_resolution_time', 'crane_productivity_moves_per_hour', 'customs_clearance_time'). attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators Framework; NAVIS N4 TOS KPI Module; IMO Port Efficiency Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational context, commercial commentary, or exception notes related to this SLA profile or measurement record. attributes.name: penalty_amount_applied
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Amount Applied
attributes.description: The actual financial penalty or credit amount applied for this specific breach event, expressed in penalty_currency_code. May differ from the standard penalty_value if partial waivers, caps, or commercial adjustments were applied. Feeds into the source system credit memo or debit note processing.

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Amount Applied

attributes.name: penalty_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which the penalty_value is calculated when an SLA breach occurs. 'per_event' applies a flat fee per breach; 'per_hour' or 'per_day' applies a rate for each unit of time in breach; 'per_teu' applies to container volume; 'percentage_of_invoice' applies a percentage of the relevant THC or service charge.

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Currency Code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the penalty_value (e.g., USD, EUR, SGD, AUD). Ensures correct financial processing in the source system for multi-currency port operations.

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Currency Code

attributes.name: penalty_type
attributes.description: The type of financial remedy applied when an SLA breach occurs. 'credit' reduces future invoices; 'rebate' is a cash payment back to the participant; 'liquidated_damages' are contractually pre-agreed fixed amounts per breach event; 'none' indicates a non-financial SLA with reporting obligations only.

attributes.name: penalty_value
attributes.description: The financial penalty or credit amount applied per SLA breach event, expressed in the currency defined by penalty_currency_code. For percentage-based penalties, this represents the percentage of the applicable invoice or THC charge. Confidential as it reflects commercial contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Controlling; IAPH Tariff and Commercial Standards

attributes.name: penalty_waiver_reason

attributes.description: Free-text justification for waiving or reducing the standard penalty_value for a breach event. Common reasons include force majeure, port congestion beyond operator control, mutual agreement, or first-time breach goodwill waiver. attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail; IAPH Commercial Best Practices; IMO Port Service Agreements

attributes.name: remediation_due_date

attributes.description: The target date by which the remediation_action must be completed and verified. Drives service request SLA tracking in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and ensures timely resolution of performance issues.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Module; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Remediation Due Date

attributes.name: remediation_status

attributes.name: responsible_party

attributes.name: review_frequency

attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Service Module; IAPH Port Management Best Practices

attributes.name: sla_tier

attributes.name: measurement_event_timestamp

attributes.name: measurement_period_end
attributes.description: The end date and time of the measurement period over which SLA performance is evaluated. Defines the closing boundary of the observation window.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start
attributes.description: The start date and time of the measurement period over which SLA performance is evaluated. Defines the beginning boundary of the observation window (e.g., start of a vessel call, start of a billing cycle, start of a gate operation window).
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators; IMO FAL Convention; Internal SLA Governance Policy

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Defines the granularity and type of the measurement period. 'vessel_call' — measured per individual vessel port call; 'per_transaction' — measured per individual cargo or gate transaction; 'daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly' — calendar-based aggregation periods as defined in the service agreement.

attributes.name: measurement_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this SLA performance measurement event, used for cross-referencing with CRM service records, billing disputes, and customer communications. Sourced from Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM SLA KPI Instance ID.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI Instance; Internal SLA Governance Policy

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this SLA performance measurement record. 'pending' — awaiting data capture; 'measured' — raw value recorded; 'validated' — confirmed by operations; 'disputed' — customer has raised a dispute; 'waived' — breach waived per agreement terms; 'cancelled' — measurement voided.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI Instance; Internal SLA Governance Policy

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the SLA metric target and actual values. Examples include 'hours', 'minutes', 'moves_per_hour', 'TEU_per_day', 'percentage', 'days', 'count'. Ensures consistent interpretation of target_value and actual_value fields.

attributes.name: metric_category

attributes.name: metric_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SLA metric being measured, such as 'Vessel Turnaround Time', 'Container Gate-In Processing Time', 'Berth Waiting Time', 'Crane Productivity (moves/hour)', 'Documentation Processing Time', or 'Cargo Availability Notification Lead Time'.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators; NAVIS N4 TOS KPI Framework; Internal SLA Governance Policy

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The financial penalty or service credit amount applicable for this SLA breach, expressed in the contract currency. attributes.name: penalty_applicable_flag

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the remediation action for this SLA breach event. attributes.name: service_type

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The transaction or record identifier from the source operational system (e.g., NAVIS N4 vessel visit ID, VTMS port call number, PCS cargo manifest reference) that was used to derive the actual_value for this SLA measurement. Supports data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS; VTMS; Port Community System (PCS); Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The committed SLA target value as defined in the service agreement for this metric and measurement period. Represents the performance threshold the port has contractually committed to deliver (e.g., vessel turnaround ≤ 24 hours, crane productivity ≥ 25 moves/hour).
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI; Internal SLA Governance Policy; IAPH Port Performance Indicators

attributes.name: validated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the port operations staff member or system process that validated this SLA measurement record. Populated when measurement_status transitions to 'validated'. Supports audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Governance Policy; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: validated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this SLA measurement record was formally validated by port operations staff or an automated validation process. Populated when measurement_status transitions to 'validated'.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Governance Policy; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the target value ((actual - target) / target * 100). Enables proportional comparison of SLA deviations across metrics with different units and scales. Stored as a raw operational measurement field captured at the time of evaluation.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators; Internal SLA Governance Policy

attributes.name: variance_value
attributes.description: The arithmetic difference between actual_value and target_value (actual minus target). A positive variance may indicate overperformance or underperformance depending on the metric direction (e.g., for time-based metrics, positive variance means slower than target). Stored as a raw operational field, not a derived KPI.
attributes.references: IAPH Port Performance Indicators; Internal SLA Governance Policy

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA breach for this measurement event has been formally waived by the port authority. Waivers may be granted for force majeure events, weather disruptions, or commercial goodwill. When True, penalty_applicable_flag should be False.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Governance Policy; IMO Force Majeure Guidelines

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason a breach waiver was granted. Common reasons include force majeure (weather, natural disaster), equipment breakdown, third-party delay (customs, pilotage), or commercial agreement. Populated only when waiver_flag is True.
attributes.references: Internal SLA Governance Policy; IMO Force Majeure Guidelines
