attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; UN/EDIFACT COPARN; IFTMIN

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the service request, determining SLA response and resolution targets. Critical priority applies to vessel safety, ISPS security incidents, or cargo at imminent risk. High applies to operational disruptions affecting vessel or terminal schedules.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Priority; IMO SOLAS; ISPS Code

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the service request at lodgement. Used in all customer-facing communications, Port Community System (PCS) messaging, and EDI exchanges. Format: SR-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Number; Port Community System (PCS) Messaging Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority to which this service request must be or has been notified (e.g., IMO, National Maritime Safety Authority, Port State Control, WCO, ILO). Populated when regulatory_notification_required is true.
attributes.references: IMO; ISPS Code Administration; National Maritime Safety Authority; PSC Authorities; WCO

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service request requires formal notification to a regulatory authority such as the National Maritime Safety Authority, Port State Control (PSC), IMO, or customs authority. Triggered for ISPS security incidents, MARPOL environmental complaints, SOLAS safety violations, or customs fraud allegations.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS; MARPOL Convention; ISPS Code; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; WCO

attributes.name: related_vessel_name
attributes.description: Name of the vessel associated with this service request, where the request relates to vessel operations, berth allocation, pilotage, towage, or vessel-related billing disputes. Supports cross-referencing with VTMS and NAVIS N4 vessel records.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS - Vessel Entity; VTMS - Vessel Tracking; IMO Ship Identification

attributes.name: reopen_count
attributes.description: Number of times this service request has been reopened after a previous resolution or closure. A high reopen count indicates unresolved root causes or customer dissatisfaction with the initial resolution. Used in quality and recurrence analysis.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Reopen Count; ISO 10002 - Complaints Handling

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service request from lodgement through investigation to resolution. Drives workflow routing and SLA monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new|open|in_progress|pending_customer|resolved|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Status; IAPH Port Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the customer interaction. Distinguishes between general enquiries, formal complaints, billing disputes, operational service requests, incident reports, permit applications, and documentation requests. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enquiry|complaint|dispute|service_request|incident_report|permit_application|documentation_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Type; IAPH Customer Service Framework

attributes.name: resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardised outcome code applied at case closure indicating how the service request was resolved (e.g., resolved_in_favour_of_customer, resolved_in_favour_of_port, partial_credit_issued, no_action_required, referred_to_regulator, withdrawn_by_customer). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resolved_customer_favour|resolved_port_favour|partial_credit|no_action|referred_regulator|withdrawn|information_provided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Resolution Code; IAPH Dispute Resolution Framework

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the resolution actions taken, findings of investigation, decisions made, and any remedial actions or credits applied. Captured by the assigned case handler at resolution. Forms part of the audit trail for regulatory and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Resolution Description; ISO 10002 - Customer Satisfaction Complaints Handling

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service request was formally resolved and a resolution communicated to the customer. Used to calculate total resolution time and SLA compliance for resolution targets.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Resolve By; IAPH Customer Service KPI Framework

attributes.name: sla_resolution_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA resolution target was breached for this service request. True if the resolved_timestamp exceeded sla_resolution_target or if the case remains unresolved past the target. Used for SLA compliance reporting and penalty calculations.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA Breach; IAPH KPI Framework

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Breach Flag

attributes.name: sla_resolution_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Target Timestamp
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which the port must fully resolve this service request, calculated from lodgement_timestamp based on the applicable SLA tier, request type, and priority level.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI; IAPH Port Service Level Agreement Standards

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Target Timestamp

attributes.name: sla_response_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA first-response target was breached for this service request. True if the acknowledged_timestamp exceeded sla_response_target or if no acknowledgement was sent before the target. Used for SLA compliance reporting and KPI dashboards.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA Breach; IAPH KPI Framework

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Breach Flag

attributes.name: sla_response_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Target Timestamp
attributes.description: The contractual deadline by which the port must send an initial response to the customer for this service request, calculated from lodgement_timestamp based on the applicable SLA tier and priority level.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI; IAPH Port Service Level Agreement Standards

tag_set.value: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Target Timestamp

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing granular context within the primary category. Examples include: THC dispute, demurrage claim, container damage, vessel delay, ISPS access, dangerous goods documentation, BOL amendment. Supports detailed analytics and specialist routing.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Case Sub-Category; NAVIS N4 TOS

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Brief, descriptive title summarising the nature of the service request as provided by the customer or captured by the port agent at lodgement. Used in case lists, dashboards, and customer communications.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System audit timestamp recording when this service request record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

products.name: communication_log
products.description: Auditable log of all formal communications between the port and port community participants, including vessel call notifications, ETA/ETB/ETD advisories, documentation requests, compliance notices, billing notifications, service alerts, and regulatory correspondence. Captures communication type, channel (EDI, email, PCS message, SMS, letter), direction (inbound/outbound), subject, body reference, timestamp, delivery status, acknowledgement status, and linked business event reference (vessel call ID, invoice number, service request ID). Supports audit trail for regulatory compliance, dispute resolution, and ISPS security communication requirements.

attributes.name: communication_log_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each communication log record in the port community system. Primary key for the communication_log data product.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Port Community System (PCS) Data Standards

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.bill_of_lading. Business justification: Communication logs reference bol_number as text. Direct FK enables message threading by shipment, audit trail reconstruction for documentation disputes, and regulatory compliance reporting (e.g., VGM

attributes.name: container_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to cargo.container. Business justification: Communication logs reference container_number as text. Direct FK enables message threading by container (gate notifications, reefer alerts, damage reports), operational event correlation, and customer

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Customer communication activities (service desk, regulatory correspondence, EDI support) consume resources tracked by cost centres for operational cost allocation, service costing, and customer servic

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.customs_declaration. Business justification: Communications about declaration status updates, amendment requests, or clearance notifications must reference the specific declaration. Port community systems require this link for audit trails and r

attributes.name: customs_hold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.customs_hold. Business justification: Communications about hold notifications, examination scheduling, or release confirmations must reference the specific hold. Port operators need this link to track all stakeholder communications regard

attributes.name: parent_communication_communication_log_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier linking this communication to a parent communication record, enabling threading of reply chains and follow-up correspondence. Null for original (non-reply) communications.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, cargo owner, customs broker, trucking company, port agent, etc.) involved in this communication. Links to the customer master record.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Communications are often location-specific (berth allocation confirmations, gate appointment notifications, terminal access instructions); operational coordination and message routing require precise

attributes.name: related_incident_ohs_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.ohs_incident. Business justification: Communications with participants about safety incidents (incident notification letters, investigation updates, corrective action requests) require formal linkage for regulatory compliance, audit trail

attributes.name: sender_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Audit trail for port-initiated communications. Required for dispute resolution, regulatory compliance reporting, and employee performance tracking. No denormalized column exists to remove.

attributes.name: service_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service request or CRM case linked to this communication. Populated for service alerts, complaint responses, and operational service correspondence managed in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel call business event linked to this communication. Populated for vessel call notifications, ETA/ETB/ETD advisories, and berth-related communications. Null when the communication is not associated with a specific vessel call.
attributes.references: VTMS (Vessel Traffic Management System); IMO FAL Convention; NAVIS N4 TOS

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Vessel-related communications (ETA updates, berth requests, pilotage coordination) are vessel-type-specific; message routing, SLA tracking, and operational planning require vessel type context for app

attributes.name: acknowledged_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recipient formally acknowledged receipt of the communication. Null if acknowledgement has not been received. Critical for ISPS security communication compliance and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of documents or files attached to this communication. Supports audit completeness checks and document management workflows. Zero for communications with no attachments.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: body_reference
attributes.description: Reference pointer (document store path, object key, or external document ID) to the full body content of the communication. The actual message body is stored externally (e.g., document management system or object storage) to avoid large text in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The medium or interface through which the communication was transmitted. Includes Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), email, Port Community System (PCS) message, SMS, physical letter, or fax. Supports channel-level analytics and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: EDI Standards (UN/EDIFACT); Port Community System (PCS); ISO 28000

attributes.name: communication_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the communication record. Tracks progression from draft through sent, delivered, failed, acknowledged, or rejected. Supports SLA monitoring and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; ISO 28000

attributes.name: communication_type
attributes.description: Classification of the communication by its business purpose. Covers vessel call notifications, ETA/ETB/ETD advisories, documentation requests, compliance notices, billing notifications, service alerts, regulatory correspondence, and ISPS security notices. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vessel_call_notification|eta_etb_etd_advisory|documentation_request|compliance_notice|billing_notification|service_alert|regulatory_correspondence|security_notice — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO FAL Convention; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific contact person at the port community participant organisation who is the addressee or originator of this communication. Business-confidential as it identifies a named individual within a commercial counterparty.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this communication log record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and regulatory compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: crm_activity_reference
attributes.description: The activity or interaction record identifier from Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM corresponding to this communication. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the CRM system of record for customer-facing communications.

attributes.name: delivery_failure_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason for delivery failure when delivery_status is 'failed', 'bounced', or 'undeliverable'. Captures error codes or descriptions from the transmission channel (e.g., invalid email address, EDI partner not reachable, SMS gateway error). Null when delivery is successful.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Technical delivery outcome of the communication transmission. Distinct from communication_status (which tracks the business lifecycle), delivery_status reflects the channel-level transmission result (e.g., email bounce, EDI acknowledgement failure, SMS undeliverable).

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the communication was sent by the port to a port community participant (outbound) or received by the port from a participant (inbound). Critical for audit trail and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: edi_interchange_reference
attributes.description: The unique interchange control reference number from the EDI transmission envelope (UNB segment in UN/EDIFACT). Used to correlate EDI messages with their functional acknowledgements (CONTRL) and for EDI error resolution. Null for non-EDI channels.

attributes.name: edi_message_type
attributes.description: UN/EDIFACT message type identifier for EDI-channel communications. Applicable when channel is 'EDI'. Common types include COPARN (Container Pre-Announcement), BAPLIE (Bayplan/Stowage Plan), IFTMIN (Instruction Message for Transport), COARRI (Container Discharge/Load Report), CODECO (Container Gate-In/Out), CUSCAR (Customs Cargo Report). Null for non-EDI channels.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT Standards; IMO FAL Convention; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: escalation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this communication has been escalated due to non-response, SLA breach, or compliance risk. Supports dispute resolution workflows and management reporting on overdue regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port SLA Management; ISPS Code Administration

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice or billing document associated with this communication. Populated for billing notifications, Terminal Handling Charge (THC) advisories, demurrage (DMG) notices, and detention (DET) billing correspondence. Null for non-billing communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; NAVIS N4 Billing; Port Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: is_acknowledged
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recipient has formally acknowledged receipt of this communication. True when acknowledgement has been received; False when pending. Supports ISPS compliance and SLA reporting.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: is_regulatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this communication is classified as regulatory correspondence subject to mandatory retention and audit requirements. True for ISPS security notices, Port State Control (PSC) correspondence, customs compliance notices, and MARPOL/SOLAS regulatory communications.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; PSC Authorities; SOLAS; MARPOL; WCO

attributes.name: is_response_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this communication requires a formal response from the recipient. True for documentation requests, compliance notices, and regulatory correspondence. False for informational advisories and one-way notifications.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO FAL Convention; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: isps_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Classification
attributes.description: ISPS Code security classification level applicable to this communication. Security Level 1 is normal operations; Level 2 is heightened security; Level 3 is exceptional threat. Non-ISPS for communications not subject to ISPS requirements. Mandatory for ISPS audit trail.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO SOLAS Chapter XI-2

tag_set.value: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Classification

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) indicating the language in which the communication was composed. Supports multilingual port community operations and regulatory correspondence in required languages.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: pcs_message_reference
attributes.description: Unique message identifier assigned by the Port Community System (PCS) for communications transmitted via the PCS channel. Enables traceability back to the originating PCS transaction for customs integration, cargo manifest, and trade documentation workflows.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); WCO Data Model; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: port_code
attributes.description: United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations (UN/LOCODE) identifying the port facility from which or to which this communication pertains. Supports multi-port operations and regulatory reporting by port authority.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE; IMO FAL Convention; IAPH Port Standards

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the communication, determining processing urgency and SLA response time targets. Urgent priority is used for ISPS security alerts and safety-critical notifications.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; SOLAS; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the communication was received by the destination system or party. For inbound communications, this is the principal business event timestamp. Null for outbound communications not yet confirmed received.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: recipient_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the receiving party for this communication. For EDI, this is the EDI recipient ID (UNB/S003). For email, this is the recipient email address. For PCS messages, this is the PCS participant code. Enables audit trail of communication destination.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT Standards; Port Community System (PCS); ISPS Code Administration

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique reference number assigned to this communication record, used for tracking and cross-referencing in the Port Community System (PCS) and Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM. Enables parties to cite a specific communication in disputes or audits.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which a response or action is required from the recipient of this communication. Used for compliance notices, documentation requests, and regulatory correspondence to enforce SLA and regulatory deadlines.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO FAL Convention; Port SLA Management

attributes.name: response_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which a response was actually received from the recipient. Compared against response_due_date to determine SLA compliance and identify overdue communications. Null if no response has been received.
attributes.references: Port SLA Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this communication record may be purged or archived in accordance with the applicable data retention policy. Calculated based on communication type and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISPS records retained for minimum 5 years, customs records per WCO guidelines).
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; WCO Data Model; GDPR Article 5; ISO 28000

attributes.name: sender_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the sending party for this communication. For EDI, this is the EDI sender ID (UNB/S002). For email, this is the sender email address. For PCS messages, this is the PCS participant code. Enables audit trail of communication origin.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT Standards; Port Community System (PCS); ISPS Code Administration

attributes.name: sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the communication was dispatched or transmitted by the sending party. This is the principal business event timestamp for outbound communications. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; ISPS Code Administration; ISO 28000

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: The subject line or title of the communication, providing a concise description of the communication's topic. Used for search, classification, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this communication log record was last modified. Tracks status updates, delivery confirmations, and acknowledgement events for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; GDPR Article 5

products.name: credit_assessment
products.description: Credit assessment records for port community participants, capturing credit application details, assessed credit limit, credit rating, assessment methodology, supporting financial documents, assessor identity, assessment date, approval status, and next review date. Tracks credit history and limit changes over time. Used by the billing domain for credit control and by commercial teams for account onboarding decisions.
products.reference: CRM Credit Management / SAP FI Credit Control

attributes.name: credit_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each credit assessment record within the port community participant credit management system.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the authorised approver (e.g., Credit Manager, CFO) who formally approved or rejected the credit assessment outcome. Supports segregation of duties and approval authority audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Oracle HCM Cloud; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.participant_account. Business justification: Credit assessments evaluate specific accounts, not just participants. Large shipping lines or freight forwarders maintain multiple accounts with different credit profiles, payment terms, and risk rati

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, cargo owner, customs broker, trucking company, or port agent) for whom this credit assessment is conducted.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: primary_credit_assessor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the port employee or credit analyst who conducted the credit assessment. Used for accountability, audit trail, and workload reporting in the source system and the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: annual_revenue
attributes.description: The port community participant's most recently reported annual revenue, sourced from submitted financial statements and used as a key input to the credit assessment and limit determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the port community participant formally submitted the credit application or the credit assessment was initiated by the commercial team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit assessment was formally approved by the authorised approver, marking the point from which the credit limit becomes effective.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The organisational approval authority level at which the credit assessment was approved, reflecting the port's delegated authority framework based on credit limit thresholds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: credit_officer|credit_manager|finance_director|cfo|board — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; ISO 28000

attributes.name: approved_credit_limit
attributes.description: The final credit limit formally approved by the authorised approver, which may differ from the assessed limit following management review or escalation. This is the enforceable credit ceiling for the participant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorised approver who approved or rejected the credit assessment, captured at the time of decision for audit trail and governance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: assessed_credit_limit
attributes.description: The credit limit amount determined by the assessor following evaluation of the participant's financial standing, payment history, and risk profile. This is the operative limit used by the billing domain for credit control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credit assessor formally conducted and completed the credit evaluation, distinct from the application submission date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology or combination of methods used to conduct the credit assessment, such as financial statement analysis, external credit bureau reports, trade references, or the port's internal scoring model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: financial_statement_analysis|credit_bureau_report|trade_reference|internal_scoring_model|combined|external_agency — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative notes recorded by the assessor documenting key findings, risk factors, qualitative observations, and rationale for the credit decision. Supports audit trail and future review context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric reference number assigned to this credit assessment, used in correspondence with the port community participant and referenced in billing and commercial onboarding workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit assessment record, tracking its progression from initial submission through review, approval or rejection, and eventual expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|expired|withdrawn — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit assessment indicating whether it is an initial assessment for new account onboarding, a scheduled periodic review, a triggered review due to payment behaviour changes, or a credit limit adjustment request. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial|periodic_review|triggered_review|limit_increase|limit_decrease|onboarding — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the credit assessor who conducted the evaluation, captured at the time of assessment for audit and reporting purposes. Complements the assessor_employee_id for human-readable audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this credit assessment record was first created in the system, used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; SAP S/4HANA FI; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: credit_bureau_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or report identifier from an external credit bureau or trade credit agency report obtained as part of the assessment process. Enables traceability back to the source credit report.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of any trade credit insurance arrangement covering the port community participant's credit exposure, where the port has obtained insurance to mitigate default risk. Null if no insurance is in place.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; P&I Club Insurance Standards

attributes.name: credit_rating
attributes.description: Internal credit rating assigned to the port community participant following assessment, using a standardised rating scale aligned with international credit rating conventions. Drives review frequency and credit terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; IAPH Port Finance Guidelines; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score derived from the assessment methodology, representing the port community participant's creditworthiness on the port's internal scoring scale. Used to determine credit rating tier and approved limit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management; Basel III Credit Risk Framework

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM opportunity or account onboarding record that initiated this credit assessment, enabling traceability between commercial pipeline activities and credit decisions.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the credit limits and financial assessments are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, AUD). Aligns with the port's billing currency configuration in the source system
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: days_past_due_count
attributes.description: The number of days the port community participant's outstanding invoices were past due at the time of assessment, sourced from the source system receivable. A key input to the credit scoring model.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Receivable; NAVIS N4 Billing

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the assessed credit limit and terms become binding and active for the port community participant, used by the billing domain for credit control enforcement.

products.name: onboarding_application
products.description: End-to-end onboarding application records for new port community participants seeking to register with the port. attributes.name: preferred_contact_language
attributes.description: The ISO 639-1 language code representing the customer's preferred language for communication with their relationship manager (e.g., en, zh-CN, ar, fr). Supports multilingual port community engagement.

attributes.name: relationship_health_score

attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Relationship Analytics; IAPH Commercial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: response_time_target_hours
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally agreed maximum response time in hours for the assigned relationship manager to respond to customer enquiries or service requests under this assignment. Supports SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: IAPH SLA Management Guidelines; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA KPI

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed frequency at which the relationship manager conducts formal account review meetings with the customer. Supports scheduling of Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reviews and service performance discussions.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Account Review Schedule; IAPH Commercial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assigned staff member's role in managing the customer relationship. Defines the nature of engagement and authority level within the port organisation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: key_account_manager|commercial_manager|port_agent_liaison|customer_success_manager|trade_development_manager|operations_liaison — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Role Classification; IAPH Port Commercial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The SLA tier applicable to this customer relationship assignment, determining response time commitments, service priority, and escalation thresholds. Platinum and gold tiers typically apply to major shipping lines and key accounts.
attributes.references: IAPH Port SLA Management Guidelines; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - SLA Entity

attributes.name: strategic_account_flag

attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Account Classification; IAPH Commercial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: terminal_code
attributes.description: The specific terminal identifier within the port where this relationship manager assignment applies. Relevant for multi-terminal ports where customer relationships may be scoped to a specific container terminal, RoRo terminal, or bulk terminal.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 - Terminal Configuration; TOPS Expert TOS - Terminal Registry

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for terminating this relationship manager assignment. Populated when assignment_status transitions to terminated. Supports workforce analytics and customer retention reporting.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Assignment Closure Reason; Oracle HCM Cloud - Termination Reason

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this relationship manager assignment record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loading in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

products.name: participant_document
products.description: Repository of official documents submitted by or issued to port community participants, including trade licences, insurance certificates (P&I cover), customs broker licences, dangerous goods handling certificates, vessel operator certificates, and port access permits. Captures document type, document number, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, file reference, verification status, and linked accreditation record. Supports compliance gating and audit readiness.

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each participant document record in the port community system. Primary key for the participant_document data product.

attributes.name: accreditation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the linked accreditation record that this document supports or satisfies as a compliance requirement. Enables compliance gating by associating documents to specific accreditation milestones.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: agreement_id

attributes.name: commodity_code_id

attributes.name: compliance_hs_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.hs_code. Business justification: Commodity-specific permits (phytosanitary, veterinary, CITES) must reference the HS code they authorize. Port security validates that participant documents cover the specific commodity being imported/

attributes.name: imdg_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.imdg_class. Business justification: Dangerous goods certificates and training records specify which IMDG classes are covered; cargo acceptance gate checks, ISPS compliance verification, and dangerous goods handling authorization depend

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, customs broker, cargo owner, trucking company, port agent, etc.) who submitted or to whom this document was issued.

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_document_participant_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer participant_document record that replaces this document upon renewal or reissuance. Enables document version chain tracking and ensures compliance systems reference the current valid document.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: trade_restriction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.trade_restriction. Business justification: Import/export permits must reference the specific trade restriction they satisfy (sanctions, embargoes, license requirements). Port compliance officers validate permit-restriction alignment before car

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Document verification workflow tracks which port staff member verified compliance documents. Essential for ISPS/customs audits and quality assurance. verified_by is bare string.

attributes.name: certified_copy
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document on file is a certified true copy (True) or an original (False). Certified copies may have different evidentiary weight for regulatory compliance purposes.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: compliance_gate_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is currently blocking the participant from accessing port services or completing accreditation (True = blocked). Set to True when a mandatory document is expired, rejected, or pending verification. Drives real-time compliance gating in the Port Community System.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; Port Community System (PCS); ISO 28000

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of insurance coverage or financial guarantee stated in the document (e.g., P&I cover limit, cargo insurance sum insured). Applicable primarily to insurance certificates. Used for risk assessment and minimum coverage compliance checks.
attributes.references: P&I Club Rules; IMO; International Group of P&I Clubs

attributes.name: coverage_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the coverage amount stated in the document (e.g., USD, EUR, AUD). Required to normalise coverage values across multi-currency insurance instruments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this participant document record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the document lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The official externally-issued or internally-assigned document number as printed on the physical or digital document (e.g., licence number, certificate serial, permit reference). This is the business identifier used for cross-referencing with issuing authorities and regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO); IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: document_scope
attributes.description: Indicates the operational scope to which the document applies — whether it covers the entire participant entity, a specific vessel, a cargo consignment, a port facility, or an individual person (e.g., a named customs broker). Determines how the document is applied during compliance gating.

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: The full descriptive title of the document as stated on the official instrument (e.g., 'Protection and Indemnity Insurance Certificate', 'Dangerous Goods Handling Authorisation'). Provides human-readable identification beyond the document type code.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the official document submitted by or issued to the port community participant. Drives compliance gating rules and determines which regulatory framework applies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trade_licence|insurance_certificate|customs_broker_licence|dangerous_goods_certificate|vessel_operator_certificate|port_access_permit|isps_certificate|marpol_certificate|solas_certificate|p_and_i_cover_letter|customs_clearance_authority|imdg_handling_certificate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO; ISPS Code Administration; WCO; IMDG Code; MARPOL; SOLAS

attributes.name: document_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document as issued by the authority (e.g., 'v2', 'Amendment 3', '2024 Edition'). Tracks amendments and reissues of the same document number without full replacement.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the document ceases to be valid. Null indicates the document has no expiry (e.g., certain trade registrations). Used for compliance gating — expired documents block port access or service provision until renewed.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO; National Maritime Safety Authority; ISO 28000

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: The digital file format of the stored document copy (e.g., PDF, JPEG, XML for EDI-transmitted certificates). Determines rendering and processing requirements for document management systems.

attributes.name: file_reference
attributes.description: The storage path, URI, or document management system reference pointing to the digital copy of the document (e.g., cloud object storage path, DMS document ID). Enables retrieval of the original scanned or electronic document for audit and compliance review.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: imo_number
attributes.description: The IMO vessel identification number (7-digit) associated with the document when the document scope is vessel-level (e.g., vessel operator certificate, vessel-specific ISPS certificate). Provides unambiguous vessel linkage for maritime regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.1078(28); SOLAS Chapter XI-1 Regulation 3

attributes.name: insurer_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance underwriter or P&I Club that issued the insurance certificate (e.g., 'UK P&I Club', 'Gard P&I', 'Skuld'). Applicable to insurance-type documents. Used for risk management and claims processing.
attributes.references: P&I Club Rules; International Group of P&I Clubs; IMO

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is a mandatory regulatory or port authority requirement (True) for the participant's accreditation or service access, or an optional supplementary document (False). Mandatory documents block service provision if not verified.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO; National Maritime Safety Authority; WCO

attributes.name: isps_relevant
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Relevant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is relevant to ISPS Code compliance requirements (True), such as port facility security certificates, vessel security plans, or security officer designations. Enables targeted ISPS compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO SOLAS Chapter XI-2

tag_set.value: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Relevant Flag

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the document was officially issued or certified by the issuing authority. Used to determine document age, validity windows, and renewal scheduling.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: The name of the regulatory body, government agency, classification society, or accredited organisation that issued or certified the document (e.g., 'International Maritime Organization', 'National Maritime Safety Authority', 'Lloyd's Register', 'Australian Border Force'). Critical for verifying document authenticity and regulatory standing.
attributes.references: IMO; National Maritime Safety Authority; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; WCO

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the jurisdiction in which the document was issued (e.g., AUS, SGP, GBR). Used for cross-border trade compliance and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 or 639-2 language code of the document's primary language (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'zh'). Used to determine whether a certified translation is required for port authority review.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers to record additional observations, conditions, endorsements, or special instructions associated with the document (e.g., 'Conditional approval pending physical inspection', 'Covers vessels under IMO 1234567 only').
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); ISPS Code Administration

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The insurance policy or P&I cover entry number associated with the insurance certificate document. Enables cross-referencing with insurer records for claims and coverage verification.
attributes.references: P&I Club Rules; International Group of P&I Clubs

attributes.name: psc_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether Port State Control authorities have been notified of a document deficiency or non-compliance finding related to this document (True = notified). Supports PSC inspection management and regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; IMO; SOLAS; MARPOL

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the document was rejected during verification (e.g., 'Document expired prior to submission', 'Issuing authority not recognised', 'Signature mismatch'). Populated only when verification_status is 'rejected'. Guides participant re-submission.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); ISPS Code Administration

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before the expiry date at which the port authority should trigger a renewal reminder notification to the participant. Configurable per document type to align with regulatory lead times (e.g., 90 days for P&I certificates, 30 days for port access permits).
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document requires periodic renewal (True) or is a one-time permanent issuance (False). Drives automated renewal reminder workflows and compliance calendar management.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; IMO; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the document was submitted to the port authority (e.g., Port Community System portal, EDI message, email, manual counter submission, API integration). Supports process analytics and EDI compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); EDI Standards; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the participant submitted the document to the port authority for review and verification. Used to measure processing turnaround times and SLA compliance for document verification.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: translation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a certified translation of this document is required for port authority compliance review (True). Triggered when the document language is not an accepted official language of the port jurisdiction.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this participant document record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to any attribute, supporting audit readiness and data lineage in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was last verified or reviewed by port authority compliance staff. Supports audit trails and tracks when the verification status was last confirmed.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document verification process. Controls compliance gating: only 'verified' documents unlock accreditation milestones and port access. 'Rejected' triggers re-submission workflow. 'Expired' triggers renewal notification.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Administration; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

products.name: edi_subscription
products.description: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) subscription configuration for port community participants, defining which EDI message types they are subscribed to send or receive via the Port Community System. Covers COPARN (container pre-announcement), IFTMIN (transport instruction), BAPLIE (stowage plan), CUSCAR (customs cargo report), and INVOIC (invoice) message types. Captures message type, direction, EDI standard (UN/EDIFACT, XML), communication protocol (AS2, SFTP), endpoint address, and active status.
products.reference: PCS EDI Configuration / UN/EDIFACT Message Subscription

attributes.name: edi_subscription_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each EDI subscription configuration record within the Port Community System. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: pcs_channel_id
attributes.description: The internal channel or queue identifier assigned by the Port Community System to route messages for this subscription. Used for operational monitoring and message tracing within the PCS.

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, cargo owner, customs broker, trucking company, or port agent) who owns this EDI subscription.

attributes.name: primary_edi_partner_id
attributes.description: The EDI interchange sender identifier (ISA06 in ANSI X12, UNB sender in UN/EDIFACT, or AS2-From header) that uniquely identifies the sending party in the EDI message envelope. Used for message routing and validation.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT ISO 9735 UNB Segment; IETF RFC 4130 (AS2); WCO Data Model

attributes.name: service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service agreement or contract under which this EDI subscription is provisioned, linking the technical configuration to the commercial terms and SLA obligations.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Sales Pipeline; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: EDI message subscriptions are often vessel-type-specific (BAPLIE for container vessels, IFTDGN for dangerous goods); message routing, validation rules, and subscription eligibility depend on vessel ty

attributes.name: acknowledgement_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a functional acknowledgement (e.g., CONTRL in UN/EDIFACT, 997/999 in ANSI X12, MDN in AS2) is required from the receiving party upon successful receipt and processing of each EDI message.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT ISO 9735 CONTRL Message; IETF RFC 4130 (AS2 MDN); Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timeout_minutes
attributes.description: The maximum number of minutes the Port Community System will wait for a functional acknowledgement before flagging the transmission as unacknowledged and triggering an alert or retry. Applicable when acknowledgement_required is true.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; SLA Management

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiry date of the digital certificate associated with this EDI subscription. Used to proactively manage certificate renewals and prevent service disruptions due to expired certificates.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; ISO 28000 - Supply Chain Security; X.509 Certificate Standard

attributes.name: certificate_thumbprint
attributes.description: The SHA-1 or SHA-256 thumbprint of the digital certificate used for AS2 message signing or SFTP public key authentication. Used to validate the identity of the communicating party and ensure message integrity.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; ISO 28000 - Supply Chain Security; IETF RFC 4130 (AS2); X.509 Certificate Standard

attributes.name: character_set
attributes.description: The character set encoding used for EDI message content under this subscription. UTF-8 is the standard for modern integrations; ISO-8859-1 is common in legacy UN/EDIFACT implementations.
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT ISO 9735; ISO/IEC 10646 (Unicode); Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: The transport/communication protocol used to exchange EDI messages between the port community participant and the Port Community System. AS2 (Applicability Statement 2) and SFTP are the most common in maritime logistics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AS2|SFTP|FTP|FTPS|API_REST|SMTP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IETF RFC 4130 (AS2); IETF RFC 4251 (SFTP); Port Community System (PCS) Technical Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this EDI subscription configuration record was first created in the system, capturing the audit trail for the subscription's inception.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: crm_subscription_ref
attributes.description: The corresponding subscription or service agreement reference number in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, enabling cross-system traceability between the EDI configuration and the commercial relationship record.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM - Service Requests; ISO/IEC 11179

attributes.name: customs_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether EDI messages under this subscription are automatically forwarded to the Customs authority integration layer within the Port Community System. Applicable for CUSCAR (Customs Cargo Report) and related trade compliance message types.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Data Model; IMO FAL Convention; Port Community System (PCS) - Customs Integration

attributes.name: edi_standard
attributes.description: The EDI data interchange standard used for this subscription. UN/EDIFACT is the dominant standard in maritime logistics per IMO and WCO guidelines. XML and JSON are used for modern API-based integrations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UN/EDIFACT|XML|JSON|ANSI X12|TRADACOMS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UN/EDIFACT ISO 9735; World Customs Organization (WCO) Data Model; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: edi_version
attributes.description: The specific version of the EDI standard in use for this subscription (e.g., D96A, D00B for UN/EDIFACT; 4010, 5010 for ANSI X12). Ensures correct message parsing and validation at the Port Community System gateway.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this EDI subscription configuration becomes active and the Port Community System begins routing messages according to this configuration.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; ISO/IEC 11179

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this EDI subscription configuration expires or is scheduled to be deactivated. Null indicates an open-ended subscription with no planned termination date.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; ISO/IEC 11179

attributes.name: endpoint_address
attributes.description: The network endpoint address (URL, hostname, IP address, or AS2 station identifier) to which EDI messages are sent or from which they are received. Classified as confidential as it reveals integration infrastructure details.

attributes.name: endpoint_port
attributes.description: The TCP/IP port number used for the EDI communication endpoint (e.g., 22 for SFTP, 443 for HTTPS/AS2). Required for firewall configuration and connectivity management.
attributes.references: IETF RFC 4130 (AS2); IETF RFC 4251 (SFTP); Port Community System (PCS) Technical Standards

attributes.name: imo_company_number
attributes.description: The IMO-assigned unique company identification number for the port community participant, used in EDI message headers for shipping lines and ship operators to ensure regulatory traceability per IMO Resolution A.1078(28).
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Resolution A.1078(28); IMO FAL Convention; UN/EDIFACT

attributes.name: ip_whitelist
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of approved source IP addresses or CIDR ranges permitted to connect to the EDI endpoint for this subscription. Enforced at the Port Community System firewall for ISPS Code and ISO 28000 supply chain security compliance.

attributes.name: is_encrypted
attributes.description: Indicates whether EDI messages transmitted under this subscription are encrypted in transit (e.g., using TLS/SSL for SFTP or S/MIME for AS2). Required for ISPS Code compliance and ISO 28000 supply chain security.
attributes.references: ISPS Code - International Ship and Port Facility Security; ISO 28000 - Supply Chain Security; IETF RFC 4130 (AS2)

attributes.name: is_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether EDI messages transmitted under this subscription are digitally signed to ensure non-repudiation and message integrity. Relevant for customs cargo reports (CUSCAR) and trade compliance under WCO standards.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Data Model; ISPS Code; ISO 28000 - Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: last_error_code
attributes.description: The error code returned by the most recent failed EDI transmission or processing attempt under this subscription. Supports operational troubleshooting and incident management.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; UN/EDIFACT CONTRL Error Codes

attributes.name: last_error_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent EDI transmission or processing error for this subscription. Used alongside last_error_code for incident tracking and SLA breach analysis.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; ISO 8601

attributes.name: last_message_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recently transmitted or received EDI message under this subscription. Used for monitoring subscription activity, detecting stale connections, and SLA reporting.

attributes.name: max_message_size_kb
attributes.description: The maximum allowable size in kilobytes for a single EDI message transmitted under this subscription. Enforced at the Port Community System gateway to prevent oversized transmissions that could impact system performance.

attributes.name: message_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the port community participant is configured to SEND (OUTBOUND) or RECEIVE (INBOUND) this EDI message type via the Port Community System.

attributes.name: message_frequency
attributes.description: The expected frequency or trigger mode for EDI message transmission under this subscription. Real-time = event-driven immediate dispatch; Scheduled = at defined intervals; On-demand = manually triggered; Batch daily/weekly = aggregated periodic transmissions.

attributes.name: message_type

attributes.name: notification_phone

attributes.name: participant_role

attributes.description: The maximum number of minutes within which the Port Community System must process and deliver an inbound EDI message or confirm receipt of an outbound message, as defined in the participant's service agreement.
