attributes.name: subscription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the EDI subscription. Active = operational and processing messages; Inactive = configured but not processing; Suspended = temporarily halted (e.g., due to connectivity issues or compliance hold); Pending = awaiting activation/testing; Terminated = permanently decommissioned.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: subscription_type
attributes.description: Classification of the EDI subscription tier. Standard = regular production subscription; Premium = high-volume or priority-routed subscription with enhanced SLA; Test = non-production testing environment; Pilot = limited trial configuration for new message types or participants.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: test_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscription is operating in test/sandbox mode, where messages are processed but do not trigger live operational actions in the Terminal Operating System or Customs systems. Used during onboarding and integration testing.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Stakeholder Messaging; UN/EDIFACT ISO 9735

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this EDI subscription configuration record, supporting audit trail requirements and change management.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Port Community System (PCS)

products.name: port_access_permit
products.description: Port access permits issued to port community participant personnel and vehicles, granting authorised access to restricted port zones in compliance with ISPS Code requirements. Captures permit holder (person or vehicle), permit type (personnel, vehicle, contractor), ISPS security zone access level, issuing authority, issue date, expiry date, biometric reference, and revocation status. Distinct from accreditation (which is entity-level) — this is individual-level access control.
products.reference: ISPS Port Access Control / Port Security Permit

attributes.name: port_access_permit_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each port access permit record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: authorized_access_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.access_point. Business justification: Permits specify which access points holder may use for entry/exit. Essential for access control system integration and permit validation at gates. Role prefix clarifies this is authorized entry point,

attributes.name: contractor_safety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.contractor_safety. Business justification: Access permits for contractor personnel must reference contractor safety qualification status. Permit issuance and renewal depend on current safety clearance, incident history, and training compliance

attributes.name: isps_facility_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.isps_facility_record. Business justification: Port access permits must validate against ISPS facility security requirements and current security level. Port security officers require this link to enforce zone access restrictions based on facility

attributes.name: issuing_officer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: ISPS security compliance requires tracking which port security officer issued each access permit. Critical for audit trails, security incident investigations, and regulatory inspections. issuing_offic

attributes.name: issuing_security_personnel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_personnel. Business justification: Port access permits are issued by security personnel under ISPS Code requirements. Tracks which security officer issued/approved each permit for audit trail and accountability. Role prefix distinguish

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant entity (shipping line, freight forwarder, trucking company, port agent, etc.) under whose sponsorship this permit was issued. Links to the customer master.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Access permits grant entry to specific terminals, berths, or ISPS security zones; physical access control enforcement, gate validation, and security zone management require precise location-level auth

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Vendors providing on-site services (equipment maintenance, construction, stevedoring) require ISPS-compliant port access permits for personnel and vehicles entering restricted zones. Real business pro

attributes.name: access_time_restriction
attributes.description: Time-of-day restriction applied to this permit. Unrestricted permits allow 24/7 access; other values limit access to defined operational windows. Enforced at gate entry systems and ISPS checkpoints.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP)

attributes.name: application_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the original permit application submitted through the Port Community System (PCS) or port authority portal. Links the issued permit back to the application workflow for audit and traceability.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS); ISPS Code Part A Section 2

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) at which the permit application was formally approved by the issuing authority. Distinct from issue_date which records the calendar date of issuance. Supports ISPS audit trail with precise approval timing.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the security background check was completed for this permit holder. Used to determine whether a re-check is required at renewal based on the port's ISPS security policy interval.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority Security Screening Guidelines

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the security background check conducted on the permit holder prior to issuance. Passed status is a prerequisite for active permit issuance under ISPS requirements. Waived may apply to certain visitor categories under escort.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority Security Screening Guidelines

attributes.name: badge_number
attributes.description: Physical badge or access card number printed on the permit holder's port ID badge. Used by gate access control systems, RFID readers, and security checkpoints to validate physical access. May differ from permit_number.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: biometric_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique reference token linking this permit to the holder's biometric record stored in the port's secure biometric identity management system (fingerprint, iris, or facial recognition template). The actual biometric template is NOT stored here — only the reference token. Null for vehicle permits.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; GDPR Article 9 (Special Category Data); ISO/IEC 19794 Biometric Data Interchange

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) at which this permit record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data governance and lineage tracking in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: crm_contact_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding contact record in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM for the permit holder or their sponsoring organisation. Enables cross-system traceability between the access permit and the CRM customer engagement record.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM; Port Community System (PCS)

attributes.name: escort_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the permit holder must be accompanied by an authorised port escort at all times while within restricted ISPS zones. True for visitor and certain contractor permit types; False for credentialed personnel with full unescorted access.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the port access permit ceases to be valid. After this date the permit_status transitions to expired and physical access is denied. Renewal must be initiated before this date to maintain uninterrupted access.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: holder_date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the individual permit holder in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for identity verification, background screening, and ISPS compliance records. Null for vehicle permits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ISPS Code Part A Section 2

attributes.name: holder_employer_name
attributes.description: Name of the organisation that employs or sponsors the permit holder (e.g., shipping line, stevedoring company, customs broker, trucking company). Used to link the individual to their sponsoring port community participant for accountability and audit.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ILO MLC 2006

attributes.name: holder_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual permit holder (person) as it appears on their government-issued identity document. Populated for personnel, contractor, visitor, crew, and emergency permit types. Null for vehicle-only permits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: holder_id_document_number
attributes.description: The unique number of the government-issued identity document (passport number, national ID number, seafarer book number, etc.) used to verify the permit holder's identity during the application process.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; GDPR Article 4; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: holder_id_document_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identity document presented by the permit holder at the time of application and verification. Used for ISPS compliance audit and background check records.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; IMO FAL Convention; ILO MLC 2006

attributes.name: holder_nationality
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the nationality of the individual permit holder. Required for ISPS background screening and customs/immigration compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ISPS Code Part A Section 2; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.description: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code security level at which this permit was issued. Level 1 is normal operations; Level 2 is heightened threat; Level 3 is exceptional threat. Permits issued at higher security levels may carry additional access restrictions.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2.1; IMO MSC/Circ.1192; SOLAS Chapter XI-2

attributes.name: isps_zone_access
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISPS-designated restricted port zones to which this permit grants access (e.g., berth_side|container_yard|gate_complex|bonded_warehouse|control_room). Defined per the port's ISPS Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: berth_side|container_yard|gate_complex|bonded_warehouse|control_room|vessel_deck|hazmat_area — promote to reference product for zone management]
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2.1; SOLAS Chapter XI-2; IMO MSC/Circ.1192

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the port access permit was formally issued and became effective. Marks the start of the permit's validity period.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the port authority department or designated security officer responsible for issuing this permit (e.g., Port Security Office, ISPS Compliance Unit). Required for audit trail and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: max_entry_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of gate entries permitted under this access permit within its validity period. Null indicates unlimited entries (applicable to permanent and multi-entry permits). Enforced by the gate access control system.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations

attributes.name: permit_category
attributes.description: Operational category of the permit defining its usage scope. Permanent permits are issued for long-term employees; temporary permits cover short-term contractors or visitors; single-entry permits are for one-time access events; multi-entry permits allow repeated access within the validity period.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP)

attributes.name: permit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique permit reference number assigned by the port authority at issuance. Used on physical badges, gate scanners, and ISPS audit trails. Format: PAP-<PORT_CODE>-<SEQUENCE>.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; IMO MSC/Circ.1192

attributes.name: permit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the port access permit. Active permits grant physical access; suspended permits are temporarily blocked pending investigation; revoked permits are permanently cancelled; expired permits have passed their expiry date without renewal.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port State Control (PSC) Inspection Guidelines

attributes.name: permit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the access permit indicating whether it covers a person (personnel, contractor, visitor, crew, emergency responder) or a vehicle. Drives the applicable ISPS security zone rules and badge colour coding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: personnel|vehicle|contractor|visitor|crew|emergency — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2.1; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: previous_permit_number
attributes.description: Permit number of the immediately preceding permit that this record renews or replaces. Enables lineage tracing across permit renewal cycles for ISPS audit and compliance history.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or special conditions associated with this permit (e.g., restricted to specific berth, requires safety induction completion, hazardous cargo handling certification required). Captured by the issuing security officer.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP)

attributes.name: renewal_count
attributes.description: Number of times this permit has been renewed since its original issuance. Tracks the renewal history for compliance reporting and to identify long-standing permit holders who may require periodic re-vetting under ISPS policy.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the permit was formally revoked prior to its natural expiry. Populated only when permit_status is revoked. Null for active, suspended, or expired permits.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the permit was revoked. Required when permit_status is revoked to support ISPS audit trails and incident reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: security_breach|employment_terminated|document_expired|disciplinary_action|voluntary_surrender|lost_stolen|other — promote to reference product if additional reasons are required]
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority Incident Reporting

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) chip embedded in the permit holder's access badge or vehicle transponder. Enables automated gate entry/exit tracking and real-time zone monitoring within the port.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 18000 RFID Standards; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations

attributes.name: sponsoring_vessel_imo_number
attributes.description: IMO vessel identification number of the vessel whose call is the basis for issuing this permit (e.g., for crew shore passes or vessel-specific contractor access). Null for permits not tied to a specific vessel call.
attributes.references: IMO Ship Identification Number Scheme (Resolution A.1078(28)); ISPS Code Part A Section 2

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date on which the permit was placed into suspended status pending investigation or administrative review. Populated only when permit_status is suspended. Null for all other statuses.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port State Control (PSC) Inspection Guidelines

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for suspending the permit. Populated when permit_status is suspended. Supports security incident investigation and ISPS compliance audit.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; ISO 28000:2022

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) at which this permit record was last modified. Supports change detection, incremental loading in the lakehouse, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: vehicle_registration_number
attributes.description: Official government-issued registration plate number of the vehicle for vehicle-type permits. Null for personnel permits. Used at gate entry/exit for automated plate recognition and ISPS vehicle access control.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; National Maritime Safety Authority Vehicle Access Regulations

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle covered by a vehicle-type permit. Determines applicable port zone access rules, weight restrictions, and escort requirements. Null for personnel permits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truck|trailer|forklift|crane|passenger_vehicle|motorcycle|heavy_equipment — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 2; Port Infrastructure Safety Regulations

products.name: participant_service_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the commercial agreement between a port community participant and a specific port service. It captures negotiated pricing, discount structures, volume tiers, and payment terms that exist only in the context of this participant-service relationship. Each record links one port community participant to one service code with commercial terms that override standard tariff rates. This is the operational SSOT for participant-specific service pricing used by NAVIS N4 billing module and the source system invoice generation.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, participants (shipping lines, freight forwarders, cargo owners) subscribe to multiple port services (pilotage, towage, stevedoring, wharfage, storage), and each service is provided to multiple participants. The business actively manages participant-service agreements with negotiated rates, volume discounts, effective periods, and payment terms that vary by participant-service combination. This is a recognized commercial concept called Service Agreement or Tariff Agreement.

attributes.name: participant_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each participant-service agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_agreement_id
attributes.description: add column contract_agreement_id (BIGINT) with FK to contract.agreement.agreement_id - participant service agreements should reference the formal contract for legal traceability

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Participant Service Agreement - Port Community Participant Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the port community participant who has negotiated this service agreement

tag_set.value: Participant Service Agreement - Port Community Participant Id

attributes.name: service_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Participant Service Agreement - Service Code Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific port service covered by this agreement

tag_set.value: Participant Service Agreement - Service Code Id

attributes.name: agreement_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number for the commercial agreement or contract document that governs this participant-service pricing. Links to contract management system or document repository.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this participant-service agreement. ACTIVE agreements are used in billing calculations. SUSPENDED agreements are temporarily inactive but not terminated.

attributes.name: billing_frequency_override
attributes.description: Service-specific billing frequency that overrides standard billing cycles (e.g., per call, weekly, monthly, quarterly). Used when participants negotiate consolidated billing for specific services.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this participant-service agreement record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the negotiated rate (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Must align with participant's billing currency or be explicitly agreed in contract.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the standard or negotiated rate for this participant-service combination. Range 0.00 to 100.00. Applied before minimum charge validation.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Start date from which this participant-service agreement is valid and should be applied in billing. Part of temporal validity for tariff revision cycles.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: End date until which this participant-service agreement is valid. Null indicates open-ended agreement. Used for contract expiry management and tariff transitions.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this agreement record. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this participant-service agreement record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSZ. Used for change tracking and audit.

attributes.name: minimum_charge
attributes.description: Participant-specific minimum charge for this service, overriding the standard minimum charge defined in service_code master. Null indicates standard minimum applies.

attributes.name: negotiated_rate
attributes.description: Participant-specific negotiated rate for this service, overriding the standard tariff rate. Used by billing systems to calculate charges. Null indicates standard rate applies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special conditions, exceptions, or commercial terms specific to this participant-service agreement. Used by commercial and billing teams for context.

attributes.name: payment_terms_override
attributes.description: Service-specific payment terms that override the participant's default payment terms for this particular service. Used when certain high-value services (e.g., pilotage, towage) require prepayment or shorter payment cycles.

attributes.name: volume_tier
attributes.description: Volume tier classification for this participant-service agreement (e.g., Tier 1: 0-1000 TEU, Tier 2: 1001-5000 TEU, Tier 3: 5000+ TEU). Determines eligibility for volume-based discounts.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the commercial team member who created this agreement record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: location_access_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the security and operational access authorization between port community participants and port locations. It captures ISPS-compliant access control, vehicle and equipment permissions, and time-bound authorization periods for participants to access specific port locations. Each record links one port community participant to one port location with security clearance levels, authorization dates, and operational restrictions that exist only in the context of this access relationship. This is the operational SSOT for port security access control and gate management systems.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, port community participants (trucking companies, stevedores, customs brokers, freight forwarders) require access to multiple port locations (berths, container yards, gate lanes, CFS sheds) based on their operational roles and contracts. Simultaneously, each port location is accessed by multiple participants throughout daily operations. Port security actively manages these access authorizations as time-bound, security-cleared permissions with specific operational restrictions per participant-location pair.

attributes.name: location_access_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each location access authorization record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the port security officer or system administrator who approved this access authorization. Used for audit trail and accountability. References the identity management system user ID.

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Location Access Authorization - Port Community Participant Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the port community participant being granted access authorization

tag_set.value: Location Access Authorization - Port Community Participant Id

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Location Access Authorization - Port Location Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the port location for which access is authorized

tag_set.value: Location Access Authorization - Port Location Id

attributes.name: access_count
attributes.description: Total number of successful access events by this participant to this location since authorization was granted. Incremented by gate control systems. Used for usage analytics and billing (if applicable). Reset to zero if authorization is revoked and re-issued.

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: Classification of the access permission level granted to the participant for this specific location. Determines operational privileges and security restrictions. Values: FULL_ACCESS (unrestricted operational access), RESTRICTED_ACCESS (limited to specific times/activities), ESCORT_REQUIRED (must be accompanied by port security), NO_ACCESS (authorization revoked but record retained for audit).

attributes.name: authorization_approval_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this access authorization was officially approved and became enforceable. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting. Must be on or before authorization_start_date.

attributes.name: authorization_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the participants authorization to access this port location expires. Null indicates indefinite authorization subject to ongoing ISPS compliance. Gate systems automatically deny access after this date. Must be on or before the participants ISPS accreditation expiry date.

attributes.name: authorization_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the participant is authorized to access this port location. Used by gate control systems to validate time-bound access permissions. Must be on or after the participants ISPS accreditation date.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this access authorization record. ACTIVE = currently valid and enforceable, SUSPENDED = temporarily disabled pending investigation or compliance review, EXPIRED = authorization_end_date has passed, REVOKED = permanently cancelled due to security breach or contract termination, PENDING_APPROVAL = awaiting port security approval. Gate systems only honor ACTIVE authorizations.

attributes.name: equipment_access_permitted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the participant is authorized to operate cargo handling equipment (cranes, reach stackers, RTGs) at this port location. Requires additional operator certification validation. Used by equipment management systems to enforce operational safety and authorization.

attributes.name: isps_clearance_level
attributes.description: ISPS security clearance level required and granted for this participant-location combination. LEVEL_1 = normal operations, LEVEL_2 = heightened security threat, LEVEL_3 = exceptional security threat. Determines access permissions during different MARSEC (Maritime Security) levels. Participant must hold clearance at or above the locations current MARSEC level to gain access.

attributes.name: last_access_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful access event by this participant to this location. Updated by gate control systems upon each entry. Used for access pattern analysis and dormant authorization identification. Null if participant has never accessed the location since authorization was granted.

attributes.name: operational_hours_restriction
attributes.description: Time-of-day or day-of-week restrictions on when the participant may access this location. Format: JSON string or structured text defining allowed time windows (e.g., 'MON-FRI 06:00-18:00', '24/7', 'DAYLIGHT_ONLY'). Null indicates no time restrictions. Used by gate control systems to enforce temporal access policies.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this authorization was revoked or suspended. Null if authorization_status is ACTIVE, EXPIRED, or PENDING_APPROVAL. Required for REVOKED and SUSPENDED statuses. Used for security incident investigation and compliance audits.

attributes.name: vehicle_access_permitted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the participant is authorized to bring vehicles (trucks, forklifts, terminal tractors) into this port location. False indicates pedestrian-only access. Used by gate lane systems to validate vehicle entry permissions.

products.name: participant_trade_exemption
products.description: This association product represents the exemption or license granted to a port community participant for a specific trade restriction. It captures the legal authorization that permits a participant to conduct trade activities that would otherwise be prohibited or controlled under sanctions, embargoes, or trade controls. Each record links one port community participant to one trade restriction with attributes that exist only in the context of this exemption relationship, including exemption type, reference numbers, validity periods, authorized volumes, and approval authority.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, a single port community participant (shipping line, freight forwarder, cargo owner) can hold exemptions or licenses for multiple trade restrictions (e.g., exemption for sanctioned territory A, license for controlled goods B, humanitarian exemption for embargo C). Conversely, a single trade restriction affects multiple participants, and multiple participants may hold exemptions for the same restriction under different terms. The business actively manages these exemptions as legal compliance artifacts with specific validity periods, authorized volumes, and approval authorities that are essential for customs clearance and cargo release decisions.

attributes.name: participant_trade_exemption_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each participant trade exemption record. Primary key.

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Participant Trade Exemption - Port Community Participant Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the port community participant who holds the exemption or license

tag_set.value: Participant Trade Exemption - Port Community Participant Id

attributes.name: trade_restriction_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Participant Trade Exemption - Trade Restriction Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the trade restriction for which the exemption or license is granted

tag_set.value: Participant Trade Exemption - Trade Restriction Id

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government agency, regulatory body, or international organization that issued and approved the exemption or license.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the exemption or license was officially approved and granted to the participant.

attributes.name: authorized_volume
attributes.description: Maximum volume, quantity, or value of goods that the participant is authorized to trade under this exemption. Unit depends on the restriction type (e.g., metric tons, TEUs, USD value).

attributes.name: authorized_volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the authorized volume (e.g., metric tons, TEUs, currency for value-based limits).

attributes.name: conditions
attributes.description: Detailed conditions, restrictions, and compliance requirements that the participant must meet to maintain the validity of the exemption.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the exemption record was created in the port community system.

attributes.name: exemption_reference
attributes.description: Official reference number or identifier assigned to the exemption or license by the issuing authority. Used for verification during customs clearance and cargo release processes.

attributes.name: exemption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the exemption. Determines whether the exemption can be used for customs clearance and cargo release decisions.

attributes.name: exemption_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exemption mechanism granted to the participant. Determines the scope and conditions under which the participant may conduct otherwise restricted trade activities.

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the exemption was last verified or validated by port compliance officers during a cargo clearance process.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the exemption record was last updated in the port community system.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date on which the exemption or license expires. After this date, the participant is no longer authorized to conduct the specified trade activities without renewal.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the exemption or license becomes effective and the participant is authorized to conduct the specified trade activities.

products.name: commodity_handling_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory and operational authorization for a port community participant to handle specific commodity types. It captures approval status, certification validity, volume limits, and dangerous goods handling permissions. Each record links one port community participant to one commodity code with attributes that exist only in the context of this authorization relationship. Critical for trade compliance, ISPS security, IMDG dangerous goods management, and customs clearance workflows.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, freight forwarders, cargo handlers, customs brokers, and shipping lines require regulatory authorization to handle specific commodity types (HS codes), particularly for dangerous goods (IMDG), quarantine-controlled goods, and restricted commodities. A single participant is authorized to handle multiple commodity types (e.g., a freight forwarder handles both reefer cargo and dry bulk), and each commodity type can be handled by multiple authorized participants. The port authority and trade compliance teams actively manage these authorizations with approval workflows, expiry tracking, volume limits, and dangerous goods certifications.

attributes.name: commodity_handling_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each commodity handling authorization record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commodity_code_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Commodity Handling Authorization - Commodity Code Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the commodity code for which handling authorization is granted

domains.name: tariff
domains.description: Owns the complete port services pricing catalog including THC (Terminal Handling Charges), wharfage (WHR), pilotage fees, demurrage (DMG), detention (DET), PIL, BAF, CAF, storage tariffs, and SLA-linked service rate cards. Covers rate cards, pricing rules, discount structures, and tariff schedules. SSOT for all commercial pricing and tariff definitions.

products.name: port_tariff
products.description: Master catalog of all port tariff schedules published by the port authority, organized by charge type discriminator. Supported charge types include THC (Terminal Handling Charges by container type/movement/zone), wharfage (WHR by cargo type/HS code/tonnage), pilotage (by LOA/GRT band/zone/time), towage (by GRT/DWT band/tug count/operation type), mooring (by LOA band/gang count/time), port dues (light dues, conservancy, anchorage by vessel GRT/flag), storage (by container status/type/zone with escalating bands), demurrage (DMG by container type/day with free time and escalation), and detention (DET for off-terminal equipment retention). Each record defines a named tariff schedule with its charge type classification, effective period, applicable trade lanes, vessel categories, cargo types, terminal zones, regulatory approval status, and filing reference. New charge types are added as new rows with a charge_type discriminator — no schema changes required. Supports multiple concurrent schedules per charge type. This is the SSOT for all tariff schedule definitions — individual charge amounts are held in tariff_item.

products.name: item
products.description: Individual line-item charge definition within a port tariff schedule. Represents a single billable service rate (e.g., THC per TEU by container type, wharfage per GRT by cargo category, pilotage per LOA band by zone, storage per day per TEU by escalation tier, towage per GRT band by operation type). Captures the charge code, unit of measure (TEU, FEU, GRT, LOA, CBM, tonne, day, move, gang), charge basis, rate amount, minimum charge, maximum charge, rounding rules, vessel/cargo/trade applicability conditions, and rate band thresholds for tiered pricing. products.name: rate_card
products.description: Negotiated or published rate card defining specific pricing applicable to a customer segment, shipping line, cargo owner, or trade lane. A rate card references one or more tariff items and overrides or discounts the base tariff rates for a defined period. Supports standard commercial rate cards and SLA-linked rate cards with service performance tiers (Gold/Silver/Bronze), committed KPIs (vessel turnaround time, crane productivity moves/hour, gate processing time), penalty/premium clauses, measurement periods, and escalation clauses. Captures rate card name, version, effective and expiry dates, applicable customer tier, trade lane, service type, SLA tier (if applicable), currency, approval workflow status, and link to originating tariff_negotiation. An SLA tier discriminator distinguishes standard rate cards from performance-linked rate cards — no separate entity required. Serves as the commercial pricing instrument linking the tariff catalog to customer agreements and SLA-based billing adjustments.

products.name: surcharge_rule
products.description: Unified definition of all applicable surcharges and adjustment factors layered on top of base tariff rates, maintained as versioned time-series records. Covers BAF (Bunker Adjustment Factor) with fuel index references (Platts, MOPS, Singapore), calculation method (flat per TEU or percentage), and trade lane scope; CAF (Currency Adjustment Factor) with currency pair, percentage, and calculation base (percentage of freight or THC); PIL (Port Infrastructure Levy); ISPS security surcharge; peak season surcharge; hazardous cargo (IMDG) surcharge; OOG (out-of-gauge) surcharge; cold ironing surcharge; and any other periodic or conditional surcharge. Each record defines the surcharge type discriminator, calculation method (flat fee, percentage of base, per unit), rate amount or percentage, applicable index reference, effective period, trade lane scope, vessel type applicability, publication authority, and applicability conditions. New surcharge types are added as new rows — no schema changes required. Enables historical surcharge reconstruction for billing disputes and audit.

attributes.name: surcharge_rule_id

attributes.name: port_tariff_id

attributes.name: applicability_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text description of specific conditions under which this surcharge applies (e.g., applies only during peak season months, applies when fuel price exceeds threshold, applies to vessels over 50,000 DWT). Captures business rules not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval and lifecycle status of the surcharge rule: DRAFT (under development), PENDING_APPROVAL (submitted for review), APPROVED (approved but not yet effective), ACTIVE (currently in effect), SUSPENDED (temporarily inactive), EXPIRED (past effective_to_date), CANCELLED (permanently withdrawn). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|PENDING_APPROVAL|APPROVED|ACTIVE|SUSPENDED|EXPIRED|CANCELLED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approved_by

attributes.name: approved_timestamp

attributes.name: billing_frequency

attributes.name: calculation_base

Applicable when calculation_method is PERCENTAGE_OF_BASE.

attributes.name: calculation_method

attributes.name: cargo_type_applicability

Defines cargo classification scope for the surcharge. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FCL|LCL|BREAKBULK|RORO|DANGEROUS|REEFER|OOG|ALL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: compounding_allowed

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: effective_from_date

attributes.name: effective_to_date

attributes.name: minimum_charge

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: notice_period_days

attributes.name: proration_method

products.name: discount_scheme
products.description: Commercial discount scheme defining volume-based, loyalty-based, or promotional discounts applicable to port service charges. Captures discount scheme name, discount type (percentage, flat rate, free days), applicable tariff items or charge codes, qualifying thresholds (TEU volume, call frequency, cargo tonnage), customer tier eligibility, effective period, and approval authority. Enables the port to offer competitive pricing to high-volume shipping lines and cargo owners.

products.name: sla_rate_card

products.name: pricing_rule
products.description: Configurable business rule defining conditional logic for charge calculation, rate selection, tariff applicability, and conflict resolution. Captures rule name, rule type (tiered pricing, conditional surcharge, minimum charge enforcement, free period calculation, tariff selection, applicability matrix, conflict resolution), trigger conditions (cargo type, vessel class, trade direction, customer segment, terminal zone, service type, trade lane), priority order for conflict resolution when multiple tariffs could apply, effective period, and rule expression or decision logic. Includes the full applicability matrix specifying which tariff applies to which combination of customer segment, vessel type, cargo category, trade lane, terminal zone, and service type — serving as the deterministic tariff selection engine. Used by the billing engine and TOS charge calculation to select the correct tariff and rate for each billable event without ambiguity. New applicability dimensions are added as rule conditions — no separate entity required.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line (unit rate, line amount, tax amount, net amount).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of discount applied to this line item. Reduces the line amount before tax calculation.

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: Code identifying any discount applied to this line item. References promotional discounts, volume discounts, or contractual rate reductions.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is under dispute by the customer. True if disputed, False otherwise. Affects accounts receivable aging and collection processes.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for dispute if dispute_flag is True. Captures customer objections and billing discrepancies.

attributes.name: line_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount for this line item before tax. Calculated as quantity multiplied by unit rate, plus any applicable adjustments.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the invoice. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items on the invoice document.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice line record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this line item. Captures special instructions, billing clarifications, or operational context.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date

attributes.name: service_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the service was completed. Used to calculate duration-based charges and service level agreement compliance.

attributes.name: service_start_timestamp

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated for this line item. Derived from line amount multiplied by tax rate.

attributes.name: tax_code

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Tax rate percentage applied to this line item. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 for 10% tax).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

attributes.name: unit_rate

attributes.name: payment_type

products.name: receivable_account
products.description: The single authoritative customer billing and accounts receivable master for each port community participant — THE unified customer record for all billing, credit management, and collections operations in this domain. Combines billing configuration (invoice delivery method, EDI partner ID, preferred currency, payment terms net 7/14/30/60, billing cycle vessel-call/weekly/monthly, account manager, billing address) with financial position tracking (credit limit, outstanding balance, aging buckets 0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ days, dunning level, credit hold flag, average days to pay). Captures account code, the source system number (KNA1/KNB1), account name, VAT/tax registration, account classification (shipping line/freight forwarder/cargo owner/terminal operator/government), account status (active/suspended/blocked/closed), last payment date, credit rating, and EDI partner configuration. SSOT for customer identity, billing preferences, credit exposure, AR aging, and settlement terms. All invoices, payments, disputes, adjustments, dunning notices, and statements reference this single master.

Captures recognition event date, invoice or service order reference, recognized revenue amount, deferred revenue amount, recognition method (point-in-time for THC/pilotage vs over-time for storage/lease), accounting period, the source system code, cost centre, profit centre, and recognition status. attributes.name: gl_posting_date

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, explanations, or audit notes related to the revenue recognition event. Used for documenting special circumstances, manual adjustments, or compliance annotations.

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue is recognized in the accounting system. This is the business event date for revenue realization, distinct from invoice date or service delivery date.

attributes.name: recognition_event_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the revenue recognition event, formatted as REV- followed by 10 digits. Used for audit trails and financial reporting.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: The method used to recognize revenue for this event. Point-in-time applies to discrete services (THC, pilotage, towage); Over-time applies to continuous services (storage, lease); Milestone applies to project-based services; Proportional applies to usage-based services; Straight-line applies to subscription or fixed-term contracts.

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the revenue recognition event. Pending indicates awaiting approval; Recognized indicates revenue has been posted to GL; Deferred indicates revenue is held for future periods; Reversed indicates a correction or cancellation; Adjusted indicates a modification post-recognition; Cancelled indicates the event was voided.

attributes.name: recognized_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The amount of revenue recognized in this event, posted to the general ledger. Represents the portion of the invoice or service order value that is realized in the current accounting period.

attributes.name: revenue_stream_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the revenue stream for strategic reporting and EBITDA analysis. attributes.name: reversal_flag

attributes.name: source_transaction_reference

attributes.name: unit_of_measure

TEU = Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit; FEU = Forty-foot Equivalent Unit; TON = Metric ton; CBM = Cubic meter; HOUR = Service hour; DAY = Calendar day; MOVE = Container move; UNIT = Generic unit count; KG = Kilogram; MT = Metric tonne. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TEU|FEU|TON|CBM|HOUR|DAY|MOVE|UNIT|KG|MT — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: The rate per unit of measure applied to calculate the revenue amount. Represents the tariff or contracted price per TEU, per hour, per day, etc.

products.name: charge_event
products.description: Granular chargeable service events captured from NAVIS N4 TOS and other operational systems, representing all raw billable activities before invoice consolidation. Covers commercial charges (container moves, gate transactions, crane hire, reefer connections, hazardous handling, storage days) and statutory/regulatory charges (wharfage assessments based on cargo weight/volume, port dues based on vessel GRT/NRT, pilotage levies, navigation fees). Also captures demurrage and detention charge calculations including free time start/end, excess days, and daily rates. Captures charge event reference, event type, event timestamp, container number, vessel call ID, vessel IMO/GRT/NRT, BOL number, cargo weight/volume, equipment ID, quantity, unit of measure, applicable tariff code, calculated charge amount, currency, billing status (unbilled/billed/disputed/waived), exemption flag, free time days allowed, excess days, statutory authority reference, and source system reference. SSOT for all pre-invoice chargeable activity including commercial, statutory, and demurrage/detention charges.
