attributes.description: Reference to the final invoice generated upon conversion of this proforma invoice. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipping line, agent, or customer account to whom this proforma invoice is issued.

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.rate_card. Business justification: Proforma invoices for negotiated-rate customers must reference the applicable rate card to ensure estimated charges reflect contracted rates, not published tariff. Critical for vessel operators to val

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.run. Business justification: Proforma invoices can be batch-generated by billing runs. This FK enables tracking which billing run generated each proforma invoice, supporting batch processing and audit trails.

attributes.name: shipping_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.shipping_line. Business justification: Proforma invoices are typically issued to shipping lines for advance billing of expected vessel call charges. Essential for shipping line credit management and pre-arrival billing.

attributes.name: slot_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intermodal.slot_booking. Business justification: Slot bookings for rail/truck services trigger proforma invoices before service delivery. Standard practice in intermodal terminal operations for advance billing, deposit collection, and service confir

attributes.name: vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel call for which this proforma invoice was issued. Links to the vessel operations domain.

attributes.name: vessel_master_id
attributes.description: Unique seven-digit IMO ship identification number assigned to the vessel. Denormalized for quick reference.

attributes.name: acknowledged_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the customer representative who acknowledged the proforma invoice.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer acknowledged the proforma invoice. Null if not yet acknowledged.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the customer has acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the proforma invoice. Used for pre-clearance and financial planning.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Additional adjustments applied to the proforma invoice, such as Bunker Adjustment Factor (BAF), Currency Adjustment Factor (CAF), or other surcharges.

attributes.name: berth_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the berth allocated to the vessel for this call. Used for berth-specific tariff calculation.

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the billing contact person for proforma invoice delivery and correspondence.

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary billing contact person at the customer organization to whom the proforma invoice is addressed.

attributes.name: billing_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the billing contact person for proforma invoice inquiries and clarifications.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the proforma invoice was cancelled. Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for cancellation of the proforma invoice, such as vessel call cancellation, customer request, or billing error. Null if not cancelled.

attributes.name: conversion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the proforma invoice was converted to a final invoice. Null if not yet converted.

attributes.name: conversion_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the proforma invoice has been converted to a final invoice, expired without conversion, or cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the proforma invoice record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the proforma invoice amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the proforma invoice was delivered to the customer. Options include email, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), customer portal, or printed copy.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the proforma invoice was delivered to the customer via the specified delivery method.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the proforma invoice, including volume discounts, promotional discounts, or contractual rebates.

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: Estimated time of arrival of the vessel at the port. Used to calculate time-based charges such as berth occupancy and pilotage.

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: Estimated time of departure of the vessel from the port. Used to calculate duration-based charges.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the proforma invoice was generated and issued to the customer.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who last modified the proforma invoice record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the proforma invoice record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the proforma invoice, including special instructions, clarifications, or customer communications.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms applicable to the proforma invoice, such as net 30 days, advance payment required, or credit terms per Service Level Agreement (SLA).

attributes.name: proforma_invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the proforma invoice. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, customer acknowledgement, conversion to final invoice, expiration, or cancellation.

attributes.name: proforma_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique proforma invoice number used for customer reference and tracking. Typically follows port-specific numbering convention.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Primary service category for which charges are estimated. Includes vessel dues, berth charges, pilotage, towage, Terminal Handling Charge (THC), and wharfage.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated charges before taxes, adjustments, and discounts. Sum of all line item charges.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated tax amount applicable to the proforma invoice, including VAT, GST, or other applicable port service taxes.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final estimated total amount payable on the proforma invoice after all taxes, discounts, and adjustments. This is the amount the customer is expected to pay.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the proforma invoice validity period. Charges are estimated as of this date.

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the proforma invoice. After this date, the proforma is no longer valid and must be reissued or converted to final invoice.

products.name: statement_of_account
products.description: Periodic accounts receivable statement documents issued to port customers summarizing all billing activity (invoices raised, payments received, credit/debit memos applied, outstanding balance) for a defined statement period. Captures statement number, customer account reference, statement date, statement period (monthly/quarterly), opening balance, total invoices raised, total payments received, total adjustments, closing balance, aging summary (current/30/60/90/90+ days), statement delivery method, and customer acknowledgement. Supports regulatory requirements for periodic AR disclosure, customer reconciliation, and dispute prevention. Generated as part of month-end billing close process.

attributes.name: statement_of_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the statement of account record. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_cycle. Business justification: Statements of account are generated per billing cycle. The billing_cycle table contains the authoritative period dates and fiscal period information. Adding billing_cycle_id normalizes period tracking

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer receivable account for which this statement is issued. Links to the billing account master.

attributes.name: prior_statement_of_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on statement_of_account (prior_statement_of_account_id)

attributes.name: run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing run batch process during which this statement was generated as part of the month-end or period-end billing close.

attributes.name: statement_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user identifier of the person or automated process that created the statement record.

attributes.name: statement_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: The system user identifier of the person or automated process that last modified the statement record.

attributes.name: acknowledged_by_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the customer contact person who acknowledged the statement on behalf of the customer organization.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer formally acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the statement.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the statement, raised a dispute, or has not responded.

attributes.name: aging_31_60_days
attributes.description: The portion of the closing balance representing invoices that are overdue by 31-60 days from their due date.

attributes.name: aging_61_90_days
attributes.description: The portion of the closing balance representing invoices that are overdue by 61-90 days from their due date.

attributes.name: aging_current
attributes.description: The portion of the closing balance representing invoices that are current or overdue by 0-30 days from their due date.

attributes.name: aging_over_90_days
attributes.description: The portion of the closing balance representing invoices that are overdue by more than 90 days from their due date. Indicates high collection risk.

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: The email address of the primary billing contact person at the customer organization.

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: The name of the primary billing contact person at the customer organization to whom the statement is addressed.

attributes.name: billing_contact_phone
attributes.description: The phone number of the primary billing contact person at the customer organization.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statement was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for cancelling the statement, if the statement status is cancelled. Used for audit and process improvement.

attributes.name: closing_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding accounts receivable balance at the end of the statement period. Calculated as opening balance plus invoices and debit adjustments minus payments and credit adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the statement record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: credit_adjustment_count
attributes.description: The total number of credit adjustment transactions applied to the customer account during the statement period.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this statement are denominated.

attributes.name: debit_adjustment_count
attributes.description: The total number of debit adjustment transactions applied to the customer account during the statement period.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The channel through which the statement was delivered to the customer. Aligns with customer communication preferences.

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the statement was successfully delivered to the customer through the specified delivery method.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has raised a dispute or discrepancy regarding the statement contents or balances.

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: The unique reference number of the billing dispute case raised by the customer in relation to this statement, if applicable.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which the statement period falls.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the statement period falls, used for financial reporting and period alignment.

attributes.name: invoice_count
attributes.description: The total number of invoices issued to the customer during the statement period.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the statement record was last modified in the system. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional remarks, special instructions, or contextual information related to the statement.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding accounts receivable balance at the beginning of the statement period. Represents carried-forward balance from prior period.

attributes.name: payment_count
attributes.description: The total number of payment transactions received from the customer during the statement period.

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The the source system document number associated with the statement generation or posting transaction in the financial system.

attributes.name: statement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statement was generated and issued to the customer. Represents the as-of date for all balances and transactions included.

attributes.name: statement_frequency
attributes.description: The periodic cadence at which this statement is generated for the customer account. Aligns with billing cycle configuration.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique statement reference number issued to the customer. Format: SOA-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: statement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the statement. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, customer acknowledgement, and closure.

attributes.name: total_credit_adjustments
attributes.description: The aggregate value of all credit notes, credit memos, and favorable adjustments applied to the customer account during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_debit_adjustments
attributes.description: The aggregate value of all debit notes, debit memos, and unfavorable adjustments applied to the customer account during the statement period.

attributes.name: total_invoices_raised
attributes.description: The aggregate value of all invoices issued to the customer during the statement period. Increases the receivable balance.

attributes.name: total_payments_received
attributes.description: The aggregate value of all payments received from the customer during the statement period. Reduces the receivable balance.

products.name: performance_obligation
products.description: Master reference table for performance_obligation. Referenced by performance_obligation_id.

attributes.name: performance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for performance_obligation

attributes.name: contract_agreement_id
attributes.description: add column contract_agreement_id (BIGINT) with FK to contract.agreement.agreement_id - performance obligations under IFRS 15 derive from contracts and must link to the originating agreement

attributes.name: customer_participant_account_id
attributes.description: add column customer_participant_account_id (BIGINT) with FK to customer.participant_account.participant_account_id - performance obligations are owed to a specific customer account

attributes.name: parent_performance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on performance_obligation (parent_performance_obligation_id)

attributes.name: performance_superseded_by_obligation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the performance obligation that supersedes this one when retired or deprecated. Null if current version or not superseded.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether special approval is required before this performance obligation can be included in customer contracts. True if approval required, False if standard.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Standard billing frequency for this performance obligation: immediate (upon service), daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annually, milestone-based, or upon completion.

attributes.name: constraint_estimation_method
attributes.description: Method used to estimate variable consideration constraint: expected value (probability-weighted), most likely amount (single best estimate), or not applicable for fixed obligations.

attributes.name: contract_asset_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code for contract asset when performance obligation is satisfied before payment is received. Represents conditional right to consideration.

attributes.name: contract_modification_impact
attributes.description: How contract modifications affect this performance obligation: separate contract (new distinct goods/services), prospective (forward-looking adjustment), cumulative catch-up (retrospective adjustment), or not applicable.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code in the source system direct costs for delivering this performance obligation are tracked. Used for cost allocation and variance analysis.

attributes.name: cost_of_service_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code for direct costs associated with delivering this performance obligation. Used for margin analysis and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this performance obligation master record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance obligation master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code for deferred revenue liability when payment is received before performance obligation is satisfied. Used for ASC 606 compliance.

attributes.name: distinct_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation is distinct and separately identifiable from other obligations in the contract per ASC 606 criteria. True if distinct, False if bundled.

attributes.name: ebitda_classification
attributes.description: Classification for EBITDA-level revenue reporting: operating revenue (core port services), non-operating revenue (one-time or non-core), or ancillary revenue (supplementary services).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this performance obligation definition is no longer effective. Null for open-ended obligations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this performance obligation definition becomes effective and can be used in contracts and billing.

attributes.name: invoice_timing
attributes.description: Timing of invoice generation relative to service delivery: advance (before service), concurrent (during service), or arrears (after service completion).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this performance obligation master record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance obligation master record was last modified.

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the performance obligation master record: active (in use), inactive (temporarily disabled), deprecated (being phased out), pending approval (awaiting activation), or retired (no longer used).

attributes.name: navis_n4_service_code
attributes.description: Service code in NAVIS N4 TOS that maps to this performance obligation. Used for invoice generation from terminal operations.

attributes.name: obligation_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the performance obligation, used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: obligation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the service or deliverable that constitutes the performance obligation under the contract.

attributes.name: obligation_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the performance obligation (e.g., Container Handling Service, Vessel Berthing, Storage Fee).

attributes.name: obligation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the performance obligation by nature: service (e.g., cargo handling), goods (e.g., equipment sale), license, access (e.g., berth access), or combined bundle.

attributes.name: performance_duration_days
attributes.description: Expected duration in days to satisfy this performance obligation. Null for point-in-time obligations. Used for over-time revenue recognition calculations.

attributes.name: price_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the standalone selling price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center code in the source system internal management reporting and profitability analysis. Typically represents terminal, business unit, or service line.

attributes.name: progress_measurement_method
attributes.description: Method for measuring progress toward satisfaction of over-time obligations: input method (costs incurred), output method (units delivered), time elapsed (straight-line), or not applicable for point-in-time.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_category
attributes.description: Category used for regulatory revenue reporting to port authorities, maritime regulators, or government agencies.

attributes.name: revenue_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in the source system where revenue for this performance obligation is posted. Maps to chart of accounts for financial reporting.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Method by which revenue is recognized for this performance obligation: point in time (upon completion), over time (duration-based), milestone-based (upon achievement), or usage-based (per transaction).

attributes.name: satisfaction_criteria
attributes.description: Business criteria that define when the performance obligation is considered satisfied (e.g., container loaded onto vessel, vessel departed berth, storage period completed).

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Maritime-specific service category for the performance obligation: container handling, vessel services (berthing, pilotage), storage (container yard), cargo operations, terminal access, or ancillary services.

attributes.name: standalone_selling_price
attributes.description: The price at which the entity would sell the promised good or service separately to a customer. Used for transaction price allocation in multi-element contracts.

attributes.name: standard_quantity
attributes.description: Standard or default quantity associated with this performance obligation when used in contracts (e.g., 1.0 for single container move, 24.0 for daily storage).

attributes.name: tariff_item_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the published port tariff item or rate card entry that defines pricing for this performance obligation. Used for regulatory compliance and customer transparency.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Specific tax category or jurisdiction code applicable to this performance obligation for VAT/GST/sales tax calculation.

attributes.name: tax_treatment_code
attributes.description: Tax treatment classification for this performance obligation: taxable (subject to VAT/GST), exempt (no tax), zero-rated (0% tax but input credit allowed), or out of scope.

attributes.name: transfer_control_indicator
attributes.description: Primary indicator used to determine when control transfers to the customer: customer acceptance, physical possession, legal title transfer, payment obligation created, or significant risks and rewards transferred.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for quantifying the performance obligation: TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit), FEU (Forty-foot Equivalent Unit), ton, cubic meter, hour, day, vessel call, transaction, or each.

attributes.name: variable_consideration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this performance obligation includes variable consideration such as volume discounts, performance bonuses, penalties, or usage-based pricing. True if variable, False if fixed.

attributes.name: variable_consideration_type
attributes.description: Type of variable consideration applicable: volume discount, performance bonus, penalty (e.g., demurrage), usage-based, time-based, or none if fixed pricing.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this performance obligation definition. Incremented when material changes are made to pricing, terms, or recognition criteria.

products.name: billing_cycle
products.description: Master reference table for billing_cycle. Referenced by billing_cycle_id.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Primary key for billing_cycle

attributes.name: billing_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this billing cycle record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: billing_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who closed and finalized this billing cycle. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: billing_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Modified By User Employee Id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this billing cycle record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

tag_set.value: Last Modified By User Employee Id

attributes.name: parent_billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent billing cycle if this is an adjustment or sub-cycle. Used to maintain hierarchical relationships between regular and adjustment cycles.

attributes.name: port_community_participant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity or business unit responsible for issuing invoices in this billing cycle. Used for multi-entity port operations.

attributes.name: primary_prior_billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on billing_cycle (prior_billing_cycle_id)

attributes.name: terminal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marine terminal or port facility for which this billing cycle applies. Links to terminal master data.

attributes.name: auto_invoice_generation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices for this billing cycle are generated automatically by the billing system or require manual review and approval.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing cycle record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary transactions in this billing cycle. Typically USD for international maritime trade.

attributes.name: cycle_closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing cycle was closed and finalized, preventing further transaction posting.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the billing cycle, used for external reference and reporting. Typically follows port authority naming conventions.

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the billing cycle, such as 'Monthly Container Services - January 2024' or 'Quarterly Vessel Operations Q1-2024'.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing cycle. Active cycles are open for transaction posting; closed cycles are finalized for revenue recognition.

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing cycle frequency. Determines the recurring pattern for invoice generation and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the billing cycle, including any special conditions, adjustments, or notes relevant to this cycle.

attributes.name: dispute_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date during which customers can raise billing disputes for invoices in this cycle. Typically 30-90 days.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the billing cycle period. All transactions with service dates on or before this date are eligible for inclusion in this cycle.

attributes.name: external_cycle_reference
attributes.description: External reference number or identifier used by upstream systems (NAVIS N4, the source system) to identify this billing cycle. Used for system integration and reconciliation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period number within the fiscal year (1-12 for monthly, 1-4 for quarterly). Used for period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter number (1-4) to which this billing cycle belongs, used for quarterly financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this billing cycle belongs, used for annual financial reporting and budget tracking.

attributes.name: gl_period
attributes.description: The general ledger accounting period in YYYYMM format to which this billing cycle is assigned for financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which financial transactions for this billing cycle are posted to the the source system ledger for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: integration_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which billing cycle data originates, typically NAVIS N4 TOS or the source system

attributes.name: invoice_generation_date
attributes.description: The date on which invoices for this billing cycle are generated and issued to customers. Typically occurs after the cycle end date.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing cycle record is currently active and available for use. Inactive cycles are retained for historical reference but not used in current operations.

attributes.name: is_adjustment_cycle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a special adjustment or correction cycle used to process chargebacks, credit memos, or billing corrections outside the regular billing schedule.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this billing cycle record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: late_fee_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether late payment fees are applicable for invoices in this billing cycle if payment is received after the due date.

attributes.name: late_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied to overdue invoice amounts as a late payment penalty. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 1.5 for 1.5% per month).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes for internal use, capturing operational comments, exceptions, or special handling instructions for this billing cycle.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment for invoices in this billing cycle must be received to avoid late fees or penalties. Calculated based on payment terms.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Standard number of days from invoice date to payment due date for this billing cycle. Common values are 30, 45, or 60 days.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which revenue for this billing cycle is recognized in the general ledger for financial reporting and EBITDA calculation.

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: The primary category of port services covered by this billing cycle. Used to segment revenue streams and align with Terminal Operating System (TOS) NAVIS N4 service classifications.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the billing cycle period. All transactions with service dates on or after this date are eligible for inclusion in this cycle.

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount billed across all invoices in this billing cycle, before adjustments or payments. Used for revenue forecasting and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: total_discount_amount
attributes.description: The total discount amount applied across all invoices in this billing cycle, including volume discounts, early payment discounts, and promotional adjustments.

attributes.name: total_invoice_count
attributes.description: The total number of invoices generated for this billing cycle. Used for cycle reconciliation and billing volume tracking.

attributes.name: total_net_amount
attributes.description: The total net amount due across all invoices in this billing cycle after applying discounts and taxes. Represents the actual revenue to be collected.

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount (VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes) included in all invoices for this billing cycle.

products.name: billing_run
products.description: Batch billing execution records capturing each scheduled or ad-hoc billing cycle run that generates invoices from NAVIS N4 TOS charge data. Captures billing run reference, run type (periodic/vessel-call/ad-hoc/final), billing period start and end dates, run date and time, total invoices generated, total invoice value, currency, run status (scheduled/in-progress/completed/failed/cancelled), operator ID, NAVIS N4 export batch reference, and the source system reference. Provides full audit trail of invoice generation cycles.
products.reference: NAVIS N4 - Billing Batch / SAP S/4HANA FI - Billing Run

attributes.name: billing_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing run batch execution record. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_cycle. Business justification: Each billing run executes for a specific billing cycle. The billing_cycle table defines the authoritative billing period. Adding billing_cycle_id allows JOIN to retrieve cycle configuration and remove

attributes.name: billing_run_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the finance manager or authorized approver who approved the billing run for release. Null if approval is not required or not yet granted.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Access Control and Audit Trail

attributes.name: billing_run_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that initiated or executed the billing run. For scheduled runs, this may be a system service account; for ad-hoc runs, this is the manual operator.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Access Control and Audit Trail

attributes.name: rerun_of_billing_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original billing run ID if this run is a rerun or correction of a previous failed or cancelled run. Null for original runs.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module - Rerun and Correction Procedures

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing run requires manual approval before invoices are released to customers. True for high-value or adjustment runs; false for routine periodic runs.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Controls - Billing Approval Policy

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the billing run was approved for invoice release. Null if approval is not required or not yet granted.

attributes.name: charge_source_system

attributes.name: run_type

attributes.name: sap_posting_batch_reference

attributes.name: scheduled_run_date

attributes.name: total_invoices_generated

domains.name: booking
domains.description: Handles booking requests, slot reservations, vessel call appointments, service order lifecycle, and pre-arrival coordination. Manages the commercial intake process from booking to service confirmation. SSOT for service booking and appointment data.

products.name: call_booking
products.description: Core master record for a vessel call booking request submitted by a shipping line or agent. Represents the commercial intake of a vessel visit to the port, capturing vessel identity (IMO number, vessel name), expected arrival/departure windows (ETA/ETD/ETB), requested berth, service requirements summary, voyage details (voyage number, service rotation, last/next port), booking status lifecycle (nominated, pending, confirmed, cancelled, completed), and pre-arrival coordination data. Central SSOT for all vessel call bookings — all other booking domain entities reference this record. Aligned with DCSA booking model concepts. Sourced from Port Community System (PCS) and NAVIS N4.

products.description: Transactional record for a specific port service request (pilotage, towage, mooring, stevedoring, crane allocation, bunkering, fresh water, waste reception) linked to a vessel call booking. attributes.name: nomination_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the voyage nomination. Tracks progression from initial nomination through acceptance or rejection by port authority.

attributes.name: oversized_count
attributes.description: Number of out-of-gauge or oversized containers (open-top, flat-rack, or containers with cargo exceeding standard dimensions) nominated for this call. Requires special yard slots and handling equipment.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: pilotage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether marine pilotage services are required for this vessel call. Drives pilot scheduling and marine services coordination.

attributes.name: reefer_count
attributes.description: Number of refrigerated containers (reefers) nominated for this call. Requires special yard planning for power plug availability and monitoring.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation for why the nomination was rejected (e.g., berth unavailable, vessel dimensions exceed berth capacity, insufficient advance notice). Null if nomination was accepted.

attributes.name: rejection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the nomination was rejected by the port authority. Null if nomination was accepted or is still pending.

attributes.name: restow_teu
attributes.description: Nominated volume of containers requiring restow operations (discharge and reload on same vessel for improved stowage). Impacts berth time and crane productivity.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: special_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling requirements, operational constraints, or service requests submitted with the nomination (e.g., 'Requires mobile crane for heavy lift', 'Priority berthing requested').

attributes.name: total_moves
attributes.description: Total number of container handling moves nominated for this vessel call (sum of all discharge and load operations). Key metric for crane hour estimation and berth productivity planning.

attributes.name: towage_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether tug boat assistance is required for berthing and unberthing operations. Drives towage resource planning.

attributes.name: transhipment_teu
attributes.description: Nominated volume of transhipment containers (discharge and reload) at this port, expressed in TEU. Represents containers moving between vessels without leaving port custody.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this voyage nomination record was last modified. Tracks data currency and change frequency for operational monitoring.

products.name: service_requirement
products.description: Declared service requirements submitted by a shipping line or cargo owner as part of a vessel call booking. Captures required service types (pilotage, towage, mooring, stevedoring, reefer monitoring, dangerous goods handling, OOG cargo handling), quantity, special handling instructions, equipment requirements (STS crane, MHC, RTG), compliance requirements (IMDG class, ISPS security level), and priority indicators. Acts as the demand signal that drives service_order creation and terminal resource planning. Distinct from service_order in that requirements represent declared needs before scheduling, while service_orders represent committed execution plans.

attributes.name: service_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service requirement record. Primary key for the service requirement entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Service requirements (pilotage, towage, special equipment) need operational approval by port duty managers before resource allocation. Tracks authorization for billing, safety compliance (ISPS/IMDG),

attributes.name: call_booking_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vessel call booking that this service requirement is part of. Links the service requirement to the overall booking context.

attributes.name: service_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.service_code. Business justification: service_type field exists. FK to service_code master enables service catalog validation, pricing lookup, billing integration, UOM standardization, and approval workflow routing for service requirement

attributes.name: service_vessel_call_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to booking.call_booking. Business justification: service_requirement has a polymorphic booking_id that can reference multiple booking entity types. Adding vessel_call_booking_id as a new nullable FK handles the most common case where service require

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service requirement was formally approved and authorized for service order creation. Marks the transition from demand signal to committed execution plan.

attributes.name: billing_reference
attributes.description: Customer-provided reference number for billing and invoicing purposes. Links the service requirement to the customer's internal purchase order or cost center for financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Financial Accounting Module

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the service requirement was cancelled by the requester or port authority. May cite vessel schedule changes, cargo plan modifications, or force majeure events. Populated only when requirement_status is cancelled.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Service Request Standards

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field documenting regulatory compliance considerations, customs requirements, or trade documentation needs associated with the service requirement. May reference SOLAS, MARPOL, or local port authority regulations.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) - Trade Compliance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service requirement record was first created in the system. Represents the initial capture of the demand signal, which may precede formal submission.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the estimated cost. Typically USD for international maritime transactions, but may vary based on port jurisdiction and customer agreement.

attributes.name: equipment_type_required
attributes.description: Specific type of terminal equipment required to fulfill the service. Critical for equipment dispatch planning and capacity validation. STS = Ship-to-Shore crane, MHC = Mobile Harbour Crane, RTG = Rubber Tyred Gantry, AGV = Automated Guided Vehicle.

attributes.name: estimated_cost
attributes.description: Preliminary cost estimate for the requested service based on tariff schedules and service parameters. Provided for customer budgeting and approval purposes prior to service order confirmation.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Billing Module - Tariff Management

attributes.name: estimated_duration_hours
attributes.description: Expected duration in hours for completing the requested service. Used for resource scheduling, berth planning, and service order timeline estimation.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier from the source system or customer system that originated this service requirement. Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation with external booking platforms or EDI messages.
attributes.references: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) - IFTMIN Message Standard

attributes.name: imdg_class
attributes.description: IMDG classification for dangerous goods handling requirements. Mandatory when service_type includes dangerous goods handling. Drives compliance protocols and specialized equipment allocation.
attributes.references: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code - IMO

attributes.name: isps_security_level
attributes.description: Required ISPS security level for the service execution. Level 1 = normal, Level 2 = heightened, Level 3 = exceptional. Determines access control, screening procedures, and security resource allocation.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service requirement record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the requirement for audit trail and data freshness purposes.

attributes.name: oog_cargo_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service requirement involves Out of Gauge cargo that exceeds standard container dimensions. Triggers specialized handling procedures and equipment requirements.
attributes.references: Terminal Operating System (TOS) - Cargo Classification Standards

attributes.name: oog_dimensions
attributes.description: Detailed dimensional specifications for OOG cargo in format Length x Width x Height (meters). Required when oog_cargo_flag is true for safe handling and stowage planning.
attributes.references: SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea) - Cargo Securing Manual

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority indicator for the service requirement. Influences scheduling sequence and resource allocation decisions in terminal operations.
attributes.references: Port Management Information System (PMIS) - Priority Classification

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the service quantity field. Defines how the service volume is quantified for billing and resource allocation purposes.

attributes.name: reefer_humidity_required
attributes.description: Target humidity level as percentage for refrigerated container monitoring. Applicable for specific cargo types requiring controlled atmosphere.
attributes.references: Container Freight Station (CFS) - Reefer Management Standards

attributes.name: reefer_temperature_required
attributes.description: Target temperature setting in Celsius for refrigerated container monitoring service. Critical for maintaining cold chain integrity for perishable cargo.
attributes.references: Container Freight Station (CFS) - Reefer Management Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the service requirement was rejected. May cite capacity constraints, regulatory non-compliance, incomplete information, or operational conflicts. Populated only when requirement_status is rejected.

attributes.name: requested_service_date
attributes.description: Target date when the service is required to be performed, typically aligned with vessel ETB (Estimated Time of Berthing) or cargo operation schedule.
attributes.references: Vessel Traffic Management System (VTMS) - Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: requested_service_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the service is required to commence, providing hour-level scheduling granularity for operational planning.

attributes.name: requester_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the requester contact person for service requirement communication and confirmation.

attributes.name: requester_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual submitting or responsible for the service requirement on behalf of the requester organization.

attributes.name: requester_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number of the requester contact person for urgent service coordination and operational communication.

attributes.name: requester_organization
attributes.description: Name of the shipping line, cargo owner, or freight forwarder organization submitting the service requirement. Acts as the commercial counterparty for the service request.

attributes.name: requirement_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the service requirement, typically formatted as SR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for external communication and tracking.
attributes.references: Port Community System (PCS) - Service Request Standards

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service requirement. Tracks progression from initial declaration through approval or rejection.

attributes.name: service_quantity
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of the service required, measured in service-specific units (e.g., number of tugs for towage, number of crane hours for stevedoring, number of containers for reefer monitoring).
attributes.references: Terminal Operating System (TOS) - Resource Planning Standards

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing specific operational instructions, safety requirements, or handling procedures that must be followed during service execution. May include temperature settings for reefer cargo, securing requirements for OOG (Out of Gauge) cargo, or IMDG class-specific protocols.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the service requirement was formally submitted by the shipping line or cargo owner for processing. Represents the official business event timestamp for requirement intake.

attributes.name: vessel_dwt
attributes.description: Deadweight Tonnage of the vessel, representing total carrying capacity. Used for berth allocation validation and service fee calculation. DWT = Deadweight Tonnage in metric tons.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Vessel Measurement Standards

attributes.name: vessel_loa
attributes.description: Length Overall of the vessel for which services are being requested. Critical for pilotage and towage resource planning. LOA = Length Overall, measured in meters.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Vessel Measurement Standards

products.name: booking_anchorage_booking
products.description: Manages booking and reservation of anchorage positions for vessels awaiting berth availability, tidal windows, customs clearance, or performing at-anchor operations (bunkering, STS transfer). Captures vessel identity, requested anchorage area or designated buoy, planned anchor drop and weigh anchor times, reason for anchorage, anchorage status (requested, confirmed, occupied, departed), and VTS coordination reference. Distinct from berth_reservation as anchorage has separate planning rules and capacity constraints. Sourced from VTMS.

attributes.name: anchorage_area_id

attributes.name: booking_berth_reservation_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.security_incident. attributes.name: vessel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel requesting anchorage. Links to the vessel master data.

products.name: confirmation

attributes.name: cancellation_policy

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

products.name: vessel_call_security_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of security personnel to vessel call bookings for ISPS compliance and port facility security operations. It captures the specific security role, shift timing, clearance requirements, and assignment lifecycle for each officer assigned to each vessel call. Each record links one vessel call booking to one security personnel member with attributes that exist only in the context of this security assignment relationship.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, vessel call bookings require multiple security personnel assigned across different roles (PFSO oversight, gate screening, berth patrol, CCTV monitoring) and shifts throughout the vessel's stay. Each security officer can be assigned to multiple vessel calls during their shift or across different shifts. The business actively manages these assignments for ISPS Code compliance, resource planning, and security incident tracking.

domains.name: contract
domains.description: SSOT for all commercial agreements between the port and its stakeholders including shipping line service agreements, stevedoring contracts, concession agreements, SLA definitions, and PIL (Port Infrastructure Levy) arrangements. Tracks contract lifecycle from negotiation to expiry.

products.name: agreement
products.description: Master record for all commercial agreements between the port authority and its stakeholders (shipping lines, stevedoring companies, terminal operators, concessionaires, PIL holders, freight forwarders, marine service providers). Serves as the single authoritative entity for every contract type including service agreements, concessions, stevedoring contracts, PIL arrangements, lease agreements, and marine services agreements. Captures full contract lifecycle from negotiation through execution to expiry/termination, including agreement type, contracting parties, effective and expiry dates, contract value, currency, governing law, jurisdiction, renewal terms (auto-renewal flag, notice period), contract status (draft, under_negotiation, active, suspended, expired, terminated), and originating system reference (the source system number, CRM opportunity ID). For concession-type agreements: concession area, term, MAGR, revenue share percentage, investment commitments. For stevedoring-type: licensed berths, equipment, productivity targets. For shipping-line-type: alliance membership, service strings, EDI requirements.

attributes.description: Number of days before expiry date by which either party must provide written notice to prevent auto-renewal. Typically 90, 180, or 365 days for maritime agreements.

attributes.description: For concession-type agreements: percentage of gross revenue above MAGR threshold that the concessionaire pays to the port authority. Typically ranges from 10% to 40%.

attributes.name: sap_contract_number
attributes.description: Source system contract identifier from the source system system. Used for financial integration and billing run generation.

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Refundable deposit held by the port authority as security against non-payment or breach of contract terms. Typically equivalent to 1-3 months of estimated charges.

attributes.name: service_strings
attributes.description: For shipping-line-type agreements: comma-separated list of vessel service routes the shipping line operates through this port (e.g., Asia-Europe Loop 1, Transpacific Express, Middle East Shuttle).

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the agreement was formally executed by both parties. May differ from effective_date if the agreement has a future commencement.

attributes.name: signed_by_counterparty
attributes.description: Name and title of the counterparty signatory who executed the agreement on behalf of the contracting organization.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the agreement was terminated before its natural expiry. Populated only for agreements with status = terminated. Null for active, expired, or suspended agreements.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for early termination of the agreement (e.g., breach of contract, mutual consent, force majeure, insolvency, regulatory change). Populated only when termination_date is not null.

products.name: agreement_party
products.description: Association entity capturing all parties bound by a commercial agreement, including the port authority itself, shipping lines, stevedoring contractors, concessionaires, and third-party guarantors. Records party role (port_authority, counterparty, guarantor, sub-contractor), party type (shipping_line, freight_forwarder, cargo_owner, stevedore, concessionaire, government_agency), signatory name, signatory title, signing date, and party status within the agreement. Supports multi-party agreements common in port concession and joint-venture arrangements.

attributes.name: agreement_party_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the agreement party association record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: access_credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to security.access_credential. Business justification: Agreement parties (shipping lines, terminal operators, service providers) receive facility access credentials upon contract execution. Credential lifecycle management requires linking to agreement par

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial agreement to which this party is bound. Links to the parent contract or service agreement.

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the port community participant account representing the party. Links to the master party entity in the customer domain.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: The number of formal amendments that have modified this partys terms, obligations, or status within the agreement. Incremented with each executed amendment affecting this party.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: authorized_representative_email
attributes.description: The email address of the authorized representative for operational communications and contract administration.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Standards

attributes.name: authorized_representative_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual authorized to act on behalf of this party for day-to-day contract administration and operational matters. May differ from the signatory.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: authorized_representative_phone
attributes.description: The telephone contact number for the authorized representative. Used for operational escalations and urgent contract matters.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 - International Telephone Numbering; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: compliance_certifications_required
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of compliance certifications this party must maintain as a condition of the agreement. Examples: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISPS certification, customs AEO status.
attributes.references: International Organization for Standardization (ISO); International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code; World Customs Organization (WCO) - AEO Programme

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: The primary telephone contact number for this party for operational and contractual matters. Includes country code and extension if applicable.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 - International Telephone Numbering; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this agreement party record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum credit exposure allowed for this party under the agreement. Applicable to counterparties receiving services on credit terms. Expressed in the agreement currency.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Credit Management Standards

attributes.name: credit_limit_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit limit amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The agreed method for resolving disputes involving this party. Negotiation is direct discussion, mediation uses neutral facilitator, arbitration is binding third-party decision, litigation is court proceedings, expert determination uses technical specialist.
attributes.references: United Nations Commission on International Trade Law (UNCITRAL) - Arbitration Rules; International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) - Dispute Resolution

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction whose laws govern this partys obligations under the agreement. Examples: Singapore, England and Wales, New York, Hong Kong.
attributes.references: United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG); International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: guarantee_amount
attributes.description: The financial guarantee or security amount provided by this party to secure performance. Applicable primarily to guarantor role. Expressed in the agreement currency.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards; Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club Standards

attributes.name: guarantee_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the guarantee amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD.

attributes.name: guarantee_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the financial guarantee expires and is no longer enforceable. Typically extends beyond the agreement end date to cover tail liabilities.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) - Uniform Rules for Demand Guarantees (URDG 758)

attributes.name: guarantee_instrument_type
attributes.description: The type of financial instrument used to secure the guarantee. Bank guarantee is issued by financial institution, letter of credit is trade finance instrument, performance bond is surety bond, parent company guarantee is corporate backing, cash deposit is held funds, insurance policy is underwritten coverage.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) - Uniform Rules for Demand Guarantees (URDG 758)

attributes.name: indemnity_scope
attributes.description: Textual description of the scope of indemnity obligations this party has agreed to. Defines what losses, damages, or claims this party will cover for other parties.
attributes.references: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club Standards; International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the insurance minimum coverage amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of required insurance coverage types. Examples: public liability, professional indemnity, marine cargo, hull and machinery, workers compensation, environmental liability.
attributes.references: Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club Standards; International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: insurance_minimum_coverage
attributes.description: The minimum insurance coverage amount this party must maintain. Expressed in the agreement currency. Null if no specific minimum is stipulated.

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is contractually required to maintain insurance coverage as a condition of the agreement. True if insurance is mandatory, false otherwise.
attributes.references: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code; Protection and Indemnity (P&I) Club Standards

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent amendment affecting this partys terms or status. Null if no amendments have been executed.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this agreement party record was most recently updated. Updated automatically on any field change.

attributes.name: liability_cap_amount
attributes.description: The maximum financial liability this party has agreed to under the contract terms. Expressed in the agreement currency. Null if unlimited liability or not applicable to this party role.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: liability_cap_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the liability cap amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD.

attributes.name: notification_address
attributes.description: The full postal address for sending formal legal notices and registered correspondence to this party. Required for contractual notice provisions.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: notification_email
attributes.description: The primary email address for sending contractual notices, amendments, and communications to this party. Must be monitored regularly per agreement terms.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Standards

attributes.name: party_entry_date
attributes.description: The date this party became bound by the agreement. May differ from signing date if the agreement has a deferred effective date or if the party was added via amendment.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: party_exit_date
attributes.description: The date this party ceased to be bound by the agreement. Populated when party status changes to terminated, novated, or released. Null for active parties.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: party_role
attributes.description: The functional role this party plays within the agreement. Port authority is the service provider, counterparty is the primary customer or contractor, guarantor provides financial backing, sub-contractor performs delegated work, co-signatory shares obligations, beneficiary receives rights without direct obligations.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this party within the agreement. Active means obligations are in force, suspended means temporary halt, terminated means party has exited, defaulted means breach of obligations, novated means replaced by another party, released means obligations discharged early.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: The business classification of the party entity. Shipping line operates vessels, freight forwarder arranges cargo movement, cargo owner holds title to goods, stevedore provides cargo handling services, concessionaire operates terminal facilities under lease, government agency represents regulatory or customs authority.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO) - Stakeholder Classification Framework

attributes.name: payment_terms_override
attributes.description: Party-specific payment terms that override the standard agreement payment terms. Examples: net 30 days, advance payment, milestone-based, letter of credit. Null if standard terms apply.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) - Incoterms; International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Billing Standards

attributes.name: performance_bond_amount
attributes.description: The value of the performance bond required from this party. Typically a percentage of the total contract value. Expressed in the agreement currency.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) - Uniform Rules for Demand Guarantees (URDG 758)

attributes.name: performance_bond_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the performance bond amount. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD.

attributes.name: performance_bond_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is required to provide a performance bond to guarantee fulfillment of contractual obligations. True if bond is mandatory, false otherwise.
attributes.references: International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) - Uniform Rules for Demand Guarantees (URDG 758)

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording additional notes, special conditions, or contextual information about this partys involvement in the agreement. Used for operational notes and audit trail.

attributes.name: signatory_authority_level
attributes.description: The hierarchical authority level of the signatory within their organization. Board level requires board resolution, executive is C-suite, senior management is VP or director level, middle management is department head, delegated is authorized representative with power of attorney.

attributes.name: signatory_name
attributes.description: The full legal name of the individual who signed the agreement on behalf of this party. Required for contract enforceability and audit trail.
attributes.references: International Labour Organization (ILO) - Maritime Labour Convention; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: signatory_title
attributes.description: The official job title or position of the signatory within their organization at the time of signing. Examples: Chief Executive Officer, Managing Director, Port Director, Operations Manager.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: signing_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this party executed the agreement. May differ across parties in multi-party agreements with sequential signing. Critical for determining contract formation and effective date.
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) - Contract Management Standards

attributes.name: signing_location
attributes.description: The city and country where the signatory executed the agreement. Relevant for determining governing law and jurisdiction in international contracts.
attributes.references: United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG)

products.name: service_scope
products.description: Defines the specific port services and operational scope covered under each commercial agreement. Each record represents a distinct service line item within a contract, capturing service type (pilotage, towage, stevedoring, container_handling, storage, reefer_monitoring, gate_operations, rail_operations), service description, applicable terminal or berth, volume commitments (TEU, DWT, vessel calls), throughput guarantees, service window (24/7, business_hours), and priority level. Enables granular tracking of what services are contracted versus what is delivered.

attributes.name: service_scope_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service scope line item within a commercial agreement. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent commercial agreement under which this service scope is defined. Links to the contract master data.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Service scope approval requires employee accountability for authorizing contractual service commitments and operational parameters in terminal operations.

attributes.name: commodity_code_id

attributes.name: compliance_hs_code_id

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Specific services (stevedoring, pilotage, towage, reefer) are delivered by operational cost centres. Required for service costing, cost allocation, and operational variance analysis by service type.

attributes.name: masterdata_container_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.container_type. Business justification: Service scope may specify container types handled (equipment_type_required field present). Container type restrictions (standard, reefer, OOG, hazmat) are common in terminal service agreements and aff

attributes.name: masterdata_vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Service scope often restricts vessel types eligible for contracted services (equipment_type_required field hints at this). Critical for vessel acceptance decisions and ensuring service delivery capabi

attributes.name: material_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.material_group. Business justification: Service scopes define cargo/service types handled (containers, bulk, liquid) which directly map to procurement material groups for required equipment, spare parts, consumables. Business process: procu

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Service scope defines WHERE contracted services are delivered. Terminal and berth codes denormalize port_location master data. Essential for berth allocation, operational planning, and service deliver

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Service lines are mapped to profit centres for margin analysis. Required for service line profitability reporting and strategic decisions on service portfolio optimization.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential number tracking amendments or revisions to this service scope line item. Increments with each modification to the scope terms.

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: billing_basis

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: crew_competency_required

attributes.name: customs_clearance_included

attributes.name: effective_from_date

attributes.name: effective_to_date

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_required

attributes.name: exclusions

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: performance_bonus_applicable

attributes.name: performance_penalty_applicable

attributes.name: service_status
