products.name: sla_definition
products.description: Master catalog of Service Level Agreement definitions associated with port commercial agreements. Captures SLA name, SLA category (vessel_turnaround, crane_productivity, gate_processing_time, berth_availability, reefer_uptime, documentation_turnaround), target metric, measurement unit (hours, moves_per_hour, percentage, TEU_per_day), target threshold, warning threshold, critical threshold, measurement frequency, measurement methodology, penalty applicability flag, and the applicable agreement reference. Serves as the authoritative SLA template library for port service contracts.

attributes.name: sla_definition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SLA definition record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial agreement (service agreement, concession, stevedoring contract) to which this SLA definition is attached. Links SLA to contractual context.

attributes.name: business_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: SLA ownership assignment requires employee reference for accountability in SLA performance monitoring and breach escalation processes.

attributes.name: service_scope_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.service_scope. Business justification: SLA definitions are often service-specific (e.g., vessel turnaround time SLA for container operations, cargo dwell time SLA for bulk terminal). This FK links the SLA definition to the service scope it

attributes.name: sla_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to tariff.sla_rate_card. Business justification: SLA definitions in agreements link to tariff-published SLA rate cards defining performance-based pricing. SLA rate cards specify premiums/penalties for performance levels. Critical for performance-bas

attributes.name: superseded_by_sla_definition_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Service Level Agreement (SLA) Definition Identifier
attributes.description: Reference to the SLA definition that replaces this one when a new version is created. Null if this is the current version.

tag_set.value: Superseded By Service Level Agreement (SLA) Definition Identifier

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who approved this SLA definition for active use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA definition was formally approved and activated.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory or industry compliance framework that mandates or influences this SLA (e.g., 'ISPS Code', 'ISO 28000', 'Port State Control (PSC)', 'IAPH Standards'). Null if SLA is purely commercial.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO); International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH); ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA definition record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_threshold
attributes.description: The threshold value at which performance is considered critically below acceptable levels, triggering escalation and potential penalty application.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: The customer segment or tier to which this SLA definition applies (e.g., 'Premium Shipping Lines', 'Standard Carriers', 'Occasional Users'). Allows differentiated service levels by customer importance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: premium|standard|occasional|strategic_partner|spot_customer|government|military — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system from which SLA performance data is sourced (e.g., 'NAVIS N4', 'VTMS', 'TOPS Expert', 'Port Community System (PCS)'). Ensures traceability of measurement data.

attributes.name: sla_definition_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the SLA definition, including business context, rationale, and any special conditions or exclusions.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this SLA definition becomes active and applicable to agreements.

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SLA definition expires or is superseded. Null indicates the SLA is open-ended.

attributes.name: escalation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether SLA breaches require formal escalation to management or customer relationship teams. True if escalation procedures are defined, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA definition record was last updated.

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the SLA metric is measured and evaluated: real_time (continuous monitoring), hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, per_transaction (each gate/cargo transaction), per_vessel_call (each vessel visit). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: real_time|hourly|daily|weekly|monthly|per_transaction|per_vessel_call — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Detailed description of how the SLA metric is calculated, including data sources, calculation formula, exclusions, and measurement boundaries. Ensures consistent interpretation between port and customer.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the SLA metric: hours, minutes, moves_per_hour (crane productivity), percentage (availability/uptime), teu_per_day (Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit throughput), documents_per_day (documentation processing), transactions_per_hour (gate processing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hours|minutes|moves_per_hour|percentage|teu_per_day|documents_per_day|transactions_per_hour — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: International System of Units (SI); Maritime Industry Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments for operational teams regarding the SLA definition, including implementation guidance, known issues, or historical context.

attributes.name: penalty_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial or service penalties apply when this SLA is breached. True if penalties are defined in the associated agreement, False if SLA is informational only.

attributes.name: penalty_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate penalties for SLA breaches: fixed_amount (flat fee), percentage_of_charge (percentage of service charge), tiered (escalating based on severity), per_unit_deviation (penalty per unit below target), service_credit (future service discount).

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which SLA performance reports are generated and delivered to stakeholders: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, on_demand (ad-hoc requests).

attributes.name: sla_category
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA by operational domain: vessel_turnaround (time from arrival to departure), crane_productivity (container moves per hour), gate_processing_time (truck processing duration), berth_availability (berth readiness percentage), reefer_uptime (refrigerated container power availability), documentation_turnaround (customs and trade document processing time).
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Performance Standards

attributes.name: sla_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the SLA definition, used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: sla_definition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SLA definition: draft (being developed), active (in use), suspended (temporarily inactive), retired (no longer applicable), under_review (being evaluated for changes).

attributes.name: sla_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the SLA definition describing the service commitment.

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Type of service level commitment: performance (operational efficiency), availability (uptime/readiness), response_time (speed of service), throughput (volume capacity), quality (accuracy/completeness), compliance (regulatory adherence).

attributes.name: target_metric_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific performance metric being measured for this SLA (e.g., 'Vessel Turnaround Time', 'Quay Crane (QC) Moves Per Hour', 'Gate Transaction Time').
attributes.references: International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Performance Standards

attributes.name: target_threshold
attributes.description: The committed target value that must be achieved to meet the SLA. Represents the contractual service level commitment.

attributes.name: threshold_operator
attributes.description: The comparison operator used to evaluate performance against thresholds: less_than (performance must be below target, e.g., turnaround time), greater_than (performance must exceed target, e.g., crane productivity), equal (exact match), between (range-based).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this SLA definition, incremented when the definition is revised. Supports SLA definition change tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: warning_threshold
attributes.description: The threshold value at which performance triggers a warning alert, indicating risk of SLA breach. Typically set between target and critical thresholds.

products.name: sla_measurement
products.description: Transactional records of actual performance measurements against all contracted service levels and volume commitments. Each record captures a single measurement event for a specific SLA definition or volume commitment within a measurement period. Stores measurement category (service_level, volume_throughput, crane_productivity, vessel_turnaround, gate_processing), measurement period (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual), measurement date, actual metric value, target/committed value, variance (absolute and percentage), performance status (met, breached, at_risk, on_track, shortfall, surplus), measurement source system (NAVIS N4, VTMS, TOS), vessel call reference, terminal reference, shortfall/surplus volume, calculated penalty or incentive amount, and breach notification trigger flag. Serves as the unified measurement entity for all contractual performance tracking — both SLA compliance and volume commitment performance. Feeds SLA breach detection, penalty/incentive calculations, volume shortfall assessments, and commercial performance review dashboards.

attributes.name: sla_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SLA measurement record. Primary key for the sla_measurement product.

attributes.name: agreement_id

attributes.name: last_measurement_date

attributes.name: measurement_basis

attributes.name: next_review_date

attributes.name: penalty_currency_code

attributes.name: penalty_rate

attributes.name: penalty_type

products.name: penalty_clause
products.description: Master catalog of contractual consequence clauses — penalties for underperformance and incentives for exceeding targets — embedded within port commercial agreements. Captures clause type (liquidated_damages, performance_penalty, shortfall_penalty, delay_penalty, incentive_bonus, rebate), trigger condition description, trigger metric (e.g., crane moves/hour below threshold, TEU shortfall vs commitment), trigger threshold, penalty/incentive calculation method (fixed_amount, per_unit, percentage_of_contract_value), penalty rate value, maximum penalty cap, incentive rate value, incentive cap, currency, applicable service scope reference, and clause status (active, suspended, waived). Distinct from rate_schedule (which defines service pricing) and from penalty_assessment (which records actual assessed amounts). This product owns the contractual 'if-then' logic: IF a trigger condition is met, THEN this financial consequence applies.

attributes.description: How often the penalty or incentive is calculated and assessed (e.g., per_occurrence for immediate assessment after each trigger event, monthly for aggregated monthly assessment, at_contract_end for final reconciliation).

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to compute the penalty or incentive amount: fixed_amount (flat fee), per_unit (rate multiplied by shortfall/excess units), percentage_of_contract_value (proportional to contract value), tiered_schedule (stepped rates based on severity).

attributes.name: clause_reference_number

attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the penalty or incentive clause: active (in force), suspended (temporarily not enforced), waived (permanently forgiven by mutual agreement), expired (no longer applicable).

attributes.name: clause_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consequence clause: liquidated_damages (pre-agreed compensation for breach), performance_penalty (underperformance charge), shortfall_penalty (volume/commitment shortfall), delay_penalty (time-based penalty), incentive_bonus (reward for exceeding targets), rebate (volume-based discount).

attributes.name: cumulative_trigger_flag

products.name: hs_code
products.description: Reference master for Harmonized System (HS) commodity classification codes as maintained by the World Customs Organization (WCO). Captures HS code (6-digit international + national extension), commodity description, chapter, heading, subheading, duty rate, VAT rate, prohibited/restricted flag, IMDG dangerous goods flag, CITES flag, dual-use flag, applicable trade controls, effective date, expiry date, and issuing authority. Used for customs declaration validation, duty calculation, and trade compliance screening across all cargo movements.

products.name: isps_facility_record
products.description: Comprehensive ISPS Code compliance product for port facilities encompassing facility security master data, Declarations of Security (DoS) with vessels, security alerts, threat notifications, and incident records at full operational granularity. Facility master captures facility name, type, ISPS reference number, approved Port Facility Security Plan (PFSP) version and approval date, current security level (1/2/3), PFSO name and contact details, CSO coordination records, and audit history. DoS records capture DoS reference number, vessel IMO number, DoS type (ship-to-port/ship-to-ship), activities covered, validity periods, signing officers (ship and port side), and signing timestamps. Security alert records capture alert reference, type (security_threat/suspicious_activity/unauthorized_access/cyber_incident/vessel_security_alert), source, severity, affected zone, response actions, escalation chain, and resolution details. SSOT for all ISPS security compliance at the port facility level including DoS lifecycle management, security incident response, MARSEC level changes, and national maritime security centre reporting.

products.name: marpol_record
products.description: Comprehensive MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention) compliance record for vessels and port reception facilities, covering all six MARPOL Annexes and the BWM Convention at full operational granularity. Annex I: oil record book entries and oily bilge water/sludge reception. Annex II: noxious liquid substance cargo residue records. Annex IV: sewage discharge records. Annex V: garbage management plans and garbage record book entries. Annex VI: air emissions (SOx, NOx, PM), EEDI/EEXI compliance, and CII ratings. BWM Convention: ballast water management method (exchange/treatment/retention), treatment system type and IMO type approval number, ballast water volume, source coordinates, exchange/treatment location, discharge details, and compliance status. Port waste reception: waste type, quantity received (m³/MT), reception facility operator, reception timestamp, waste manifest number, disposal method, disposal contractor, disposal certificate reference, and port authority endorsement. Captures vessel IMO number, operation type, quantities, officer signatures, port authority endorsement, compliance status, and associated PSC inspection reference. SSOT for all MARPOL, BWM Convention, and port waste reception compliance documentation at the port.
products.reference: MARPOL 73/78 Annexes I-VI / IMO MEPC Resolutions

products.name: declaration_screening
products.description: This association product represents the security screening events performed on customs declarations as part of the port clearance workflow. It captures the many-to-many relationship between customs declarations and screening records, where a single declaration may undergo multiple screening checks (document verification, cargo X-ray, physical inspection) at different checkpoints, and a single screening event may cover multiple declarations in a consolidated shipment. Each record links one customs declaration to one screening record with screening-specific attributes including timestamp, outcome, method, inspector, and anomaly flags that exist only in the context of this declaration-screening relationship.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, customs declarations undergo multiple security screening events at different checkpoints during the clearance workflow (document verification at gate, X-ray scanning at cargo terminal, physical inspection at customs examination area). Simultaneously, a single screening event (e.g., a radiation scan of a consolidated container) can cover multiple customs declarations for different consignments within that container. This is a true operational many-to-many relationship where security personnel actively create, track, and manage declaration-screening records with specific outcomes, methods, timestamps, and inspector assignments for each declaration-screening combination.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customs declaration being screened. Each screening event is performed on one specific declaration.

attributes.description: Identifier of the security officer or customs inspector who performed the screening on this declaration. Links to personnel or employee master data for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: screening_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the security screening record that examined this declaration. Each screening event may cover one or more declarations.

attributes.name: anomaly_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of any anomaly, discrepancy, or security concern identified during screening of this declaration. Includes nature of issue, items flagged, and initial assessment.

attributes.name: anomaly_detected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any anomaly, discrepancy, or alert was detected during the screening of this declaration. True: anomaly found requiring follow-up. False: no issues detected.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this declaration-screening association record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: follow_up_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of any follow-up action taken as a result of the screening outcome for this declaration. Documents operational response including secondary inspection, hold placement, or clearance authorization.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this declaration requires additional follow-up action based on screening results. True: secondary inspection, document verification, or escalation needed. False: screening complete with no further action.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this declaration-screening association record was last modified.

attributes.name: screening_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total time taken to complete the screening of this specific declaration, measured in seconds. Used for operational efficiency analysis and resource planning.

attributes.name: screening_method
attributes.description: The primary method or technology used to screen this declaration. Document_check: verification of customs paperwork. Xray_scan: non-intrusive cargo imaging. Physical_search: manual inspection. Radiation_detection: radiological scanning. Biometric_verification: identity confirmation. ANPR: Automatic Number Plate Recognition. Combined: multiple methods applied.

attributes.name: screening_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the screening check for this specific declaration. Cleared: passed all checks. Flagged: alert triggered requiring review. Denied: failed screening. Pending_review: awaiting secondary inspection.

attributes.name: screening_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this specific declaration was screened during the screening event. Captures the precise moment of screening for this declaration within the broader screening record.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: General ledger journal entry representing all financial postings including header metadata and detailed line items. Covers manual journals, system-generated postings (billing, payroll, asset accounting), intercompany entries, accruals, and tax-relevant postings (GST/VAT, withholding tax, port levies). Each entry contains document type, posting date, fiscal period, company code, and individual lines with debit/credit amounts, GL account, cost centre, profit centre, WBS element, tax code, tax amount, and assignment references. SSOT for all financial accounting transactions underpinning statutory reporting, management accounting, BAS/VAT returns, tax compliance, and audit trail. Sourced from the source system module.

attributes.description: The method by which payment is made or received (e.g., T=bank transfer, C=cheque, E=electronic funds transfer, D=direct debit). Used for payment processing and cash management.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the due date calculation and cash discount conditions (e.g., 0001=payable immediately, Z030=net 30 days). Used for accounts payable and receivable management.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. This is the principal business event timestamp that determines the fiscal period and affects financial statement balances.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry. Draft entries are not yet posted to the ledger; parked entries await approval; posted entries are final; cleared entries have been reconciled; reversed entries have been negated; cancelled entries are voided.

attributes.name: profit_centre
attributes.description: The profit centre responsible for the financial result of this entry. Used for management accounting, EBITDA analysis, and internal performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Profit Centre Accounting

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this journal entry to source documents such as invoice numbers, purchase order numbers, Bill of Lading (BOL) numbers, or customs declaration numbers. Critical for audit trail and reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previous entry. Used for accrual reversals and error corrections.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing the original entry (e.g., 01=error correction, 02=accrual reversal, 03=period adjustment). Used for audit and control reporting.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_date
attributes.description: The date used for tax reporting purposes, which may differ from posting date. Used for GST/VAT returns, Business Activity Statement (BAS) reporting, and withholding tax compliance.

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the intercompany trading partner when intercompany_indicator is true. Used for intercompany reconciliation and consolidation.

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: The the source system used to create or post the journal entry (e.g., FB01=post document, FB50=GL posting, F-02=general posting). Used for audit trail and process analysis.

attributes.name: user_name
attributes.description: The username of the person who created or posted the journal entry. Used for audit trail and segregation of duties monitoring.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The project work breakdown structure element for CAPEX tracking and project accounting. Used for capital expenditure management, port infrastructure development, and project-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: workflow_approval_status
attributes.description: The approval status of the journal entry within the workflow process. Used for manual journal approval controls and segregation of duties enforcement.

attributes.description: The baseline date for payment terms calculation. Used to determine due dates for accounts payable and receivable.

attributes.name: business_area_code

attributes.description: The date on which this line item was cleared through payment or offset. Null for open items.

attributes.description: The credit amount posted to the general ledger account in the functional currency. Represents decreases to asset and expense accounts or increases to liability, equity, and revenue accounts.

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: The debit amount posted to the general ledger account in the functional currency. Represents increases to asset and expense accounts or decreases to liability, equity, and revenue accounts.

attributes.description: The dunning block indicator preventing automatic dunning notice generation for this line item.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: The dunning level indicating the escalation stage for overdue receivables. Higher numbers represent more severe collection actions.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate used to convert the transaction currency amount to the functional currency amount.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: The functional area code for cost-of-sales accounting. Classifies the line item by business function such as production, administration, sales, or distribution.
attributes.references: SAP FI Functional Area, IAS 1 Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the functional currency in which the debit and credit amounts are recorded.

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Descriptive text providing additional context or explanation for this journal entry line item.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry. Determines the ordering and position of this line item in the entry.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The material or inventory item number when this line item relates to goods movement or inventory valuation.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this journal entry line item record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this journal entry line item record was last modified.

attributes.name: partner_profit_centre_code
attributes.description: The partner profit centre code for internal transfer pricing and intercompany profit elimination.

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: The payment block indicator preventing automatic payment processing. Used for items requiring manual review or approval.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the payment conditions and discount terms for this line item.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: The two-digit posting key that controls the posting characteristics such as debit/credit indicator, account type, and field status.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of goods or services associated with this line item for inventory or cost allocation purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this line item is a reversal of a previous entry. True if this is a reversal transaction.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original entry that this line item reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: The segment code for IFRS segment reporting. Represents an operating segment for external financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: The special GL indicator for alternative reconciliation accounts such as down payments, bills of exchange, or guarantees.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount associated with this line item in the functional currency.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code that determines the tax calculation procedure and tax rates applicable to this line item.
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Configuration, Local Tax Regulations

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: The trading partner code for intercompany transactions. Identifies the counterparty company code in consolidated group reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Trading Partner, IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The original transaction amount in the transaction currency before conversion to functional currency.
attributes.references: IAS 21 The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the original transaction currency before conversion to functional currency.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity field such as TEU, FEU, MT (metric tons), or CBM (cubic meters).
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units, UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The value date for cash management and liquidity planning. Represents the effective date for financial value calculation.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated withholding tax amount deducted from the payment in the functional currency.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_type
attributes.description: The withholding tax type code for statutory tax withholding requirements on payments to vendors or employees.

products.name: ap_invoice
products.description: Accounts Payable (AP) record representing the complete vendor payable lifecycle from invoice receipt through payment execution and clearing. Covers all vendor obligations including stevedoring subcontractors, equipment spare parts, marine fuel, pilotage services, dredging contractors, and infrastructure works. Captures invoice header (vendor, dates, payment terms, amounts), line items, payment execution details (payment method, bank clearing, EFT/SWIFT references, payment run ID), and clearing status. Tracks cash outflows for port operational expenditure and CAPEX payments. Sourced from the source system SSOT for all vendor payment obligations, disbursement tracking, and AP aging analysis.

attributes.name: clearing_date

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The financial document number generated during the clearing process that links the invoice to its payment transaction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this invoice record was first created in the financial system. Used for audit trails and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). All monetary amounts on this invoice are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The total discount amount applied to the invoice, including early payment discounts, volume discounts, or negotiated rebates.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The document date recorded in the financial system, typically matching the invoice date but may differ for backdated or forward-dated entries.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due to the vendor based on payment terms. Used for cash flow planning and to avoid late payment penalties.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: The dunning level or escalation stage for overdue invoices, indicating how many payment reminders have been sent. Used in collections management.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this invoice is recorded for financial reporting purposes, based on the posting date.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number confirming physical receipt of goods or completion of services. Used in three-way matching to validate invoice against delivery.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount of the invoice before any taxes, discounts, or adjustments. Represents the base value of goods or services provided by the vendor.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor issued the invoice. This is the principal business event timestamp for the invoice and is used for aging analysis and payment term calculations.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the invoice content, services rendered, or goods supplied. Provides business context for the payable obligation.

attributes.name: invoice_number

attributes.name: modified_by

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this invoice record was last modified in the financial system. Used for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount payable to the vendor after applying taxes, discounts, and all adjustments. This is the amount that will be paid.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance on the invoice. Calculated as net_amount minus paid_amount. Used for AP aging and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative amount that has been paid against this invoice to date. Used to track partial payments and calculate outstanding balance.

attributes.name: payment_block
attributes.description: A code indicating if payment is blocked for this invoice and the reason (e.g., pending approval, dispute, quality issue, missing documentation). Empty if no block exists.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date the payment was executed or the check was issued to the vendor. Used for cash flow reporting and payment performance analysis.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used to settle this invoice (Electronic Funds Transfer, wire transfer, check, ACH, SWIFT, SEPA, etc.). attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The external payment reference number or transaction ID from the bank or payment system (e.g., SWIFT reference, EFT confirmation number, check number).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed payment terms with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Defines the payment schedule and any early payment discounts available.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the general ledger in the financial accounting system. Used for period closing and financial reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number against which this invoice is being processed. Used for three-way matching (PO, goods receipt, invoice) in procurement workflows.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number such as delivery note, contract number, or work order that this invoice relates to. Used for cross-referencing and audit trails.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount charged on the invoice, including VAT, GST, or other applicable sales taxes based on jurisdiction and tax codes.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code applied to this invoice indicating the tax rate and tax type (VAT, GST, sales tax) based on jurisdiction and transaction nature.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of withholding tax deducted from the payment to the vendor as required by tax regulations. This amount is remitted directly to tax authorities.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the system user who created this invoice record in the financial system.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The arm's length pricing methodology applied to determine the intercompany transaction value for tax compliance (cost-plus, market price, negotiated rate, comparable uncontrolled price, resale-minus).
attributes.references: OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises

products.name: company_code
products.description: Legal entity master representing each company within the port authority corporate group. Covers the port operating company, terminal operating subsidiaries (container terminal JVs), stevedoring entities, property holding companies, and marine services subsidiaries. Captures legal name, country of incorporation, functional currency, fiscal year variant, chart of accounts assignment, tax registration numbers, and registered address. SSOT for legal entity structure used in statutory reporting, intercompany eliminations, consolidated financial statements, and multi-entity transaction processing.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the company code entity. Primary key. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE (legal entity master).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master Data

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this company code record. Used for audit trail and accountability in master data governance.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the company code was activated in the ERP system and became available for financial postings. Determines the earliest valid posting date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: business_area_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether business area assignment is mandatory for all financial postings. Used for cross-company code segment reporting and divisional analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area Configuration

attributes.name: business_registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number assigned by the corporate registry or chamber of commerce. Used for legal entity verification, trade documentation, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the chart of accounts assigned to this company code. Determines the general ledger (GL) account structure and financial statement mapping.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Chart of Accounts Configuration

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the legal entity within the corporate group. Used as the primary business identifier in the source system all financial transactions. Examples: PAUS (Port Authority US), TCSG (Terminal Container Singapore).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: consolidation_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the consolidation group or reporting segment to which this entity belongs. Used for segment reporting under IFRS 8 and management consolidation.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the controlling area for management accounting. Links company code to cost centers, profit centers, and internal orders for OPEX and CAPEX tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling Area Configuration

attributes.name: country_of_incorporation
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction where the legal entity is incorporated. Determines applicable tax law, statutory reporting requirements, and regulatory oversight.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this company code record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credit_control_area
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the credit control area for accounts receivable (AR) management. Determines credit limit checking, dunning procedures, and payment terms enforcement.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the company code was deactivated or closed in the ERP system. Null for active entities. Used for historical reporting and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: entity_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the legal entity. Active entities participate in financial consolidation; inactive entities are excluded from operational reporting but retained for historical analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity by its primary business function within the port authority corporate group. Determines consolidation treatment and reporting hierarchy.

attributes.name: financial_statement_version
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the financial statement version used for statutory reporting. Defines the mapping of GL accounts to balance sheet and income statement line items.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_start_month
attributes.description: Numeric month (1-12) when the fiscal year begins. Used for period calculations, budget planning cycles, and year-end close procedures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Configuration

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: Two-character code defining the fiscal year structure (calendar year, April-March, July-June, etc.) and number of posting periods. Determines period-end close schedules and financial reporting cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant Configuration

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary economic environment in which the entity operates. Used for local currency accounting and translation to group reporting currency.
attributes.references: IAS 21 - The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for consolidated financial statements at the corporate group level. All entity results are translated into this currency for consolidation.
attributes.references: IAS 21 - The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: incorporation_date
attributes.description: Date when the legal entity was officially incorporated or registered with the national corporate registry. Used for entity age calculations and historical analysis.

attributes.name: intercompany_clearing_account
attributes.description: Ten-digit GL account number used for intercompany receivables and payables. Used in consolidation eliminations and intercompany reconciliation processes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this company code record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: legal_entity_identifier
attributes.description: 20-character ISO 17442 Legal Entity Identifier used for global financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and counterparty identification in financial transactions.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the company as registered with the national corporate registry. Used in statutory financial statements, tax filings, and legal contracts.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or historical context about the legal entity. Used for audit documentation and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of equity ownership held by the parent entity. Determines consolidation method (full consolidation for >50%, equity method for 20-50%, cost method for <20%).

attributes.name: parent_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the immediate parent entity in the corporate hierarchy. Used for consolidation rollup, intercompany eliminations, and management reporting structures. Null for the ultimate parent entity.

attributes.name: profit_center_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether profit center assignment is mandatory for all financial postings in this company code. True enforces profit center-based segment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: registered_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the legal registered address as filed with the corporate registry. Used for statutory correspondence, legal notices, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: registered_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the legal registered address (suite, floor, building name). Optional field for additional address detail.

attributes.name: registered_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the legal registered address. Used for jurisdiction determination and tax domicile classification.

attributes.name: registered_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the legal registered address. May differ from country of incorporation for entities with cross-border registrations.

attributes.name: registered_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the legal registered address. Used for mail delivery and geographic classification.

attributes.name: registered_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the legal registered address. Used for sub-national tax reporting and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: retained_earnings_account
attributes.description: Ten-digit GL account number for retained earnings. Used in year-end close procedures to carry forward profit or loss to equity.

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name or trading name used in operational reports, internal communications, and management dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Master Data

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Primary tax identification number issued by the national tax authority. Used for corporate income tax filings, VAT/GST reporting, and withholding tax compliance.

attributes.name: valuation_area
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the valuation area for asset accounting and inventory valuation. Determines depreciation methods, useful life, and asset capitalization thresholds.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.description: VAT or GST registration number issued by the tax authority. Required for VAT invoicing, input tax credit claims, and periodic VAT returns.

products.description: Financial accrual record capturing period-end accruals and prepayments posted to ensure accurate matching of revenues and expenses within the correct fiscal period. Covers accruals for port service revenues not yet invoiced, vendor services received but not invoiced, demurrage (DMG) accruals, and employee entitlement provisions. Records accrual type, amount, GL account, cost centre, accrual period, and reversal date.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial accrual record. Primary key for the accrual entity.

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the invoice that this accrual is related to or will be settled against. Nullable for accruals not yet invoiced.

attributes.name: participant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the port community participant account associated with this accrual. Links the accrual to the customer, vendor, or partner entity.

attributes.name: service_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.service_code. Business justification: Accruals for unbilled revenue or deferred costs are tied to specific port services. Required for period-end revenue recognition by service, matching principle compliance, and service-level margin anal

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.wbs_element. Business justification: Accruals can be allocated to WBS elements for project cost tracking. New FK column wbs_element_id will be created to link to the WBS element master. The existing wbs_element_code STRING column can rem

attributes.name: accrual_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual is recognized for accounting purposes. Represents the business event date when the revenue or expense is deemed to have occurred.

attributes.name: accrual_type
attributes.description: Classification of the accrual entry indicating whether it represents revenue accrual, expense accrual, prepayment, deferred revenue, provision, or reversal.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the accrual entry in the transaction currency. Represents the gross amount before any adjustments or allocations.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual entry was approved by the authorized approver. Nullable if approval is pending or not required.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status indicating whether the accrual entry has been reviewed and approved by the authorized financial controller or manager.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business area code representing the line of business or operational division to which this accrual belongs. Used for cross-company code reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area Accounting

attributes.name: accrual_category
attributes.description: Business category of the accrual such as port service revenue, demurrage (DMG), wharfage (WHR), terminal handling charge (THC), vendor services, employee entitlements, or other operational categories.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who created the accrual record in the source system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the accrual record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the accrual amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique business document number assigned to the accrual entry in the financial system. Used for audit trail and reference purposes.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the local currency amount. Nullable if transaction and local currencies are the same.
attributes.references: IAS 21 - Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year to which this accrual is assigned. Typically ranges from 1 to 12 for monthly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this accrual belongs, used for annual financial reporting and budgeting alignment.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The username or identifier of the user who last modified the accrual record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the accrual record was last modified in the source system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The accrual amount converted to the local reporting currency of the company code. Used for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: IAS 21 - Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes or comments providing supplementary information about the accrual entry for audit, review, or operational purposes.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual entry was posted to the general ledger. Used for period-end closing and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Date Control

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the accrual entry indicating whether it is in draft, posted to the general ledger, reversed, or cancelled.

attributes.name: posting_text
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context and explanation for the accrual entry. Used for audit trail and user reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Text Standards

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason for creating the accrual, such as service rendered but not invoiced, goods received but not invoiced, or period-end matching requirement.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number such as a purchase order, delivery order (D/O), bill of lading (BOL), or service request number that provides business context for the accrual.

attributes.name: reference_key_1
attributes.description: First flexible reference field for capturing additional business identifiers such as vessel visit number, container number, or booking reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Field Standards

attributes.name: reference_key_2
attributes.description: Second flexible reference field for capturing supplementary business identifiers or cross-reference keys.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Field Standards

attributes.name: reference_key_3
attributes.description: Third flexible reference field for capturing tertiary business identifiers or cross-reference keys.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Field Standards

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual entry is scheduled to be automatically reversed in the subsequent accounting period. Nullable for accruals that do not require automatic reversal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accrual Reversal Logic

attributes.name: reversal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period in which the accrual is scheduled to be reversed. Used in conjunction with reversal_date for period-end automation.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accrual was fully settled or cleared against an actual transaction. Nullable for open accruals.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the accrual has been settled against an actual invoice or payment. Used to track the lifecycle from accrual to final settlement.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the accrued amount and the actual invoiced or settled amount. Used for variance analysis and accrual accuracy assessment.

products.name: lease_liability
products.description: IFRS 16 lease accounting record for port authority right-of-use assets including land leases, equipment leases, concession arrangements, and building leases. Captures lease term, discount rate, right-of-use asset value, lease liability balance, monthly amortisation schedule, and modification history. Critical for port authorities who hold extensive long-term land and infrastructure leases from government entities. SSOT for lease accounting compliance and balance sheet reporting.

attributes.name: lease_liability_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lease liability record. Primary key for IFRS 16 lease accounting entries.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Every lease liability belongs to a legal entity (company code). New FK column company_code_id will be created to properly link to the company_code master. The existing company_code STRING column can r

attributes.name: cost_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_centre. Business justification: Lease liabilities can be allocated to cost centres for cost accounting. New FK column cost_centre_id will be created to link to the cost centre master. The existing cost_center_code STRING column can

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: add column fixed_asset_id (BIGINT) with FK to finance.fixed_asset.fixed_asset_id - IFRS 16 lease liabilities correspond to right-of-use assets tracked as fixed assets

attributes.name: modified_lease_liability_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on lease_liability (modified_lease_liability_id)

attributes.name: profit_centre_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_centre. Business justification: Lease liabilities can be allocated to profit centres for profitability analysis. New FK column profit_centre_id will be created to link to the profit centre master. The existing profit_center_code STR

attributes.name: responsible_person_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Lease contracts (equipment leases, facility leases) require designated employee ownership for renewal tracking, payment authorization, compliance monitoring, and vendor relationship management in port

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lessor party in the master vendor or participant registry.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation charged against the right-of-use asset from commencement date to the reporting date.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 - Leases; IAS 16 - Property, Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: accumulated_interest_expense
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accumulated Interest Expense on Lease Liability
attributes.description: Total interest expense accrued on the lease liability from commencement to the reporting date. Interest is calculated on the outstanding liability balance each period.

tag_set.value: Accumulated Interest Expense on Lease Liability

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the right-of-use asset under lease. Examples include terminal land parcels, Rubber Tyred Gantry (RTG) cranes, Ship-to-Shore (STS) cranes, warehouse buildings, or administrative offices.

attributes.name: asset_location
attributes.description: Physical location or terminal where the leased asset is situated. Critical for port operations spanning multiple terminals and berths.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lease liability record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for lease payments and liability amounts. Port authorities may hold leases in multiple currencies depending on lessor jurisdiction.

attributes.name: current_lease_liability
attributes.description: Outstanding lease liability balance as of the reporting date. Reduced by lease payments and increased by interest accretion each period.

attributes.name: current_rou_asset_value
attributes.description: Current carrying amount of the right-of-use asset after accumulated depreciation and any impairment losses. Updated monthly as part of the depreciation schedule.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Method used to depreciate the right-of-use asset. Typically straight-line over the shorter of the lease term or the useful life of the asset.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 - Leases; IAS 16 - Property, Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Interest rate used to discount lease payments to present value. Represents the rate the lessee would pay to borrow funds to purchase a similar asset in a similar economic environment. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.50%).

attributes.name: extension_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease contract includes an option to extend the lease term beyond the initial period.

attributes.name: extension_option_years
attributes.description: Number of years available under the extension option if exercised. Nullable if no extension option exists.

attributes.name: gl_account_liability
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account for Lease Liability
attributes.description: General ledger account number where the lease liability balance is recorded. Separate accounts typically maintained for current and non-current portions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Financial Accounting; IFRS 16 - Leases

tag_set.value: General Ledger (GL) Account for Lease Liability

attributes.name: gl_account_rou_asset
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account for Right-of-Use (ROU) Asset
attributes.description: General ledger account number where the right-of-use asset is capitalized. Typically classified under property, plant, and equipment or a separate ROU asset category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Financial Accounting; IFRS 16 - Leases

tag_set.value: General Ledger (GL) Account for Right-of-Use (ROU) Asset

attributes.name: impairment_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether there are indicators that the right-of-use asset may be impaired and requires impairment testing under IAS 36.

attributes.name: impairment_loss
attributes.description: Cumulative impairment loss recognized against the right-of-use asset. Nullable if no impairment has been identified.

attributes.name: initial_lease_liability
attributes.description: Present value of lease payments at lease commencement, discounted using the incremental borrowing rate. Represents the initial obligation to make lease payments.

attributes.name: initial_rou_asset_value
attributes.description: Initial measurement of the right-of-use asset at lease commencement. Equals the initial lease liability plus any initial direct costs, lease payments made at or before commencement, and estimated restoration costs.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lease liability record was most recently updated. Tracks modifications to liability balances, asset values, or lease terms.

attributes.name: last_remeasurement_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease liability was last remeasured due to a change in lease term, discount rate, or lease payments.

attributes.name: lease_commencement_date
attributes.description: Date when the lessor makes the underlying asset available for use by the lessee. This is the effective start date for IFRS 16 lease accounting recognition.

attributes.name: lease_contract_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the lease agreement. Used for cross-referencing with legal documents and vendor communications.

attributes.name: lease_end_date
attributes.description: Contractual end date of the lease term. For port land leases, this may extend 25-99 years. Nullable for perpetual or indefinite concession arrangements.

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lease liability. Tracks whether the lease is currently in force, has been modified, or has ended.

attributes.name: lease_term_months
attributes.description: Total duration of the lease agreement expressed in months. Includes non-cancellable period plus any extension options reasonably certain to be exercised.

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease arrangement. Port authorities commonly hold land leases from government entities, equipment leases for terminal machinery, and building leases for administrative facilities.

attributes.name: lessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity providing the leased asset. For port authorities, commonly government entities, port land authorities, or equipment vendors.

attributes.name: long_term_liability_portion
attributes.description: Portion of the lease liability due beyond 12 months. Classified as non-current liability on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 - Leases; IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: modification_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent lease modification became effective. Nullable if no modifications have occurred.

attributes.name: modification_description
attributes.description: Description of the lease modification, including changes to payment terms, lease scope, or extension/termination of the lease term.

attributes.name: modification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease has been modified after initial recognition. Modifications include changes to scope, consideration, or term.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this lease liability record. Critical for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: monthly_lease_payment
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment amount due to the lessor. Excludes variable lease payments based on usage or performance.

attributes.name: next_payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the next lease payment is due to the lessor. Used for cash flow planning and accounts payable scheduling.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which lease payments are made to the lessor.

attributes.name: purchase_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease includes an option for the lessee to purchase the underlying asset at the end of the lease term.

attributes.name: remeasurement_trigger
attributes.description: Event that triggered remeasurement of the lease liability. Examples include change in lease term, change in assessment of purchase option, or change in amounts expected under residual value guarantee.

attributes.name: short_term_liability_portion
attributes.description: Portion of the lease liability due within the next 12 months. Classified as current liability on the balance sheet.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 - Leases; IAS 1 - Presentation of Financial Statements

attributes.name: termination_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lessee has the right to terminate the lease before the end of the contractual term.

attributes.name: variable_payment_basis
attributes.description: Description of the basis for variable lease payments. Examples include TEU throughput, revenue percentage, or inflation index adjustments.

attributes.name: variable_payment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease includes variable payments that depend on an index, rate, or usage metric (e.g., throughput-based concession fees).

attributes.name: contingent_liability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record also represents a contingent liability requiring disclosure. True when probability is possible but not probable, or when amount cannot be reliably measured.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the provision record in the system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the provision record was first created. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the provision amounts. Typically the functional currency of the company code.

attributes.name: current_provision_amount
attributes.description: Current carrying amount of the provision after remeasurements, discount unwinding, and partial settlements. Represents the best estimate of expenditure required to settle the present obligation at the reporting date.

attributes.name: disclosure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provision requires specific disclosure in the financial statement notes. Material provisions and contingent liabilities require detailed disclosure.

attributes.name: discount_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Pre-tax discount rate applied to future cash flows to calculate present value of the provision. Should reflect current market assessments of the time value of money and risks specific to the liability. Expressed as decimal (e.g., 0.0525 for 5.25%).

attributes.name: discount_unwinding_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of discount unwinding (accretion expense) recognized as the provision approaches settlement date. Represents the increase in provision due to passage of time.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: the source system number for the journal entry that created or last modified the provision. Links to the general ledger posting.

attributes.name: estimation_method
attributes.description: Method used to estimate the provision amount. Single best estimate for individual obligations; expected value (probability-weighted) for large populations; range midpoint when no single outcome is more likely; expert valuation for complex obligations.

attributes.name: expected_settlement_date
attributes.description: Best estimate of the date when the obligation is expected to be settled or discharged. Used for discounting calculations and current/non-current classification.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year. Used for monthly financial reporting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the provision was recognized or is being reported. Used for period-based reporting and analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense reporting. Examples: operations, administration, maintenance.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the provision record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the provision record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_reassessment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal reassessment of the provision amount, timing, and probability. Used to track compliance with reassessment requirements.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: Legal or regulatory basis for the provision. References to legislation, regulations, contracts, or constructive obligations that create the liability. Examples: MARPOL requirements, lease agreements, employment contracts.

attributes.name: maximum_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Upper bound of the estimated range of possible outcomes. Used for sensitivity analysis and risk assessment.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent measurement or remeasurement of the provision amount. Provisions must be reviewed at each reporting date and adjusted to reflect current best estimate.

attributes.name: minimum_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Lower bound of the estimated range of possible outcomes. Used when there is significant uncertainty in the provision measurement.

attributes.name: next_reassessment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal reassessment. Typically aligned with annual reporting cycle or significant project milestones.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, comments, or supporting documentation references for the provision. Used for audit trail and management commentary.

attributes.name: obligation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the nature of the obligation, the circumstances that gave rise to it, and the expected method of settlement. Critical for audit trail and disclosure notes.

attributes.name: original_provision_amount
attributes.description: Initial provision amount recognized at inception, before any remeasurements, settlements, or unwinding of discount. Recorded in functional currency.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: Remaining provision balance after settlements. Calculated as current provision amount minus settled amount.

attributes.name: probability_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the likelihood that an outflow of resources will be required to settle the obligation. Probable (>50%) triggers recognition; possible (5-50%) requires disclosure only; remote (<5%) requires no action.

attributes.name: provision_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique provision reference number used for tracking and reporting. Format: PRV-YYYYNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Document Numbering Standards

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provision. Recognized when initially recorded; remeasured after annual reassessment; partially settled when payments made; fully settled when obligation discharged; reversed when no longer required; written off when obligation extinguished.

attributes.name: provision_type
attributes.description: Classification of the provision based on the nature of the obligation. Environmental remediation includes dredge spoil disposal and contaminated land cleanup; employee entitlement covers long service leave and redundancy; legal claim provisions for litigation; asset decommissioning for infrastructure removal obligations.

attributes.name: reassessment_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency for reviewing and remeasuring the provision. Annual reassessment is mandatory; more frequent reviews may be required for volatile or material provisions.

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: Date when the provision was initially recognized in the financial statements. Represents the point when a present obligation arose from a past event and reliable estimate could be made.

attributes.name: reimbursement_amount
attributes.description: Expected reimbursement amount from third parties. Recognized as a separate asset when virtually certain, but cannot exceed the provision amount.

attributes.name: reimbursement_expected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity expects to receive reimbursement from a third party (e.g., insurance, indemnity, government grant) for some or all of the expenditure required to settle the provision.

attributes.name: reimbursement_source
attributes.description: Description of the third party or mechanism from which reimbursement is expected. Examples: insurance policy number, government grant program, contractual indemnity clause.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the provision was reversed. Populated only when reversal indicator is true.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provision has been reversed because the obligation no longer exists or is no longer probable. Reversed provisions are written back to income.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the provision was reversed. Examples: obligation no longer exists, settlement for less than provided amount, probability assessment changed to remote.

attributes.name: settled_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid or applied against the provision to date. Represents actual expenditures incurred in settling the obligation.

attributes.name: terminal_code
attributes.description: Port terminal or facility code where the provision obligation is located. Relevant for environmental remediation and asset decommissioning provisions tied to specific terminal infrastructure.

attributes.name: undiscounted_amount
attributes.description: Estimated future cash outflows required to settle the obligation without applying any discount rate. Used for disclosure and comparison with discounted carrying amount.

products.name: internal_order_gang_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of stevedore gangs to internal orders for cost tracking and resource planning. It captures the operational deployment of labour gangs against specific internal orders (maintenance campaigns, operational projects, CAPEX initiatives) with assignment-specific attributes including planned and actual hours, work type classification, cost rates, and assignment status. Each record links one internal order to one gang deployment with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship. SSOT for gang cost allocation to internal orders and labour resource utilization tracking.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, internal orders (representing maintenance campaigns, operational projects, or CAPEX initiatives) routinely require multiple stevedore gangs for execution, and stevedore gangs are deployed across multiple internal orders throughout their operational lifecycle. The business actively manages these assignments as operational records, tracking planned versus actual hours, work type classification, assignment-specific cost rates, and assignment status for both resource planning and cost control purposes.
