products.name: project_gang_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of stevedore gangs to capital project WBS elements for infrastructure construction and installation work. It captures the deployment of labour gangs to CAPEX projects such as berth construction, crane installation, and terminal expansion, tracking planned versus actual labour hours, assignment dates, work phases, and cost allocation for project labour costing and gang utilization analysis. Each record links one WBS element to one gang with attributes that exist only in the context of this project assignment.. Existence Justification: In maritime port capital projects, stevedore gangs are deployed to multiple WBS elements (project components) over the project lifecycle - a gang may work on berth construction, then crane installation, then terminal paving. Simultaneously, each WBS element requires multiple gangs with different specializations (hatch gangs for confined space work, crane gangs for heavy lifting, lashing gangs for securing). The business actively manages these assignments with planned vs actual hours, cost allocation percentages when gangs split time across projects, work phases, and assignment status tracking.

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Hierarchical organisational unit structure covering divisions, departments, terminals, and operational sections within the port. Includes unit code, unit type (terminal, department, gang, section), parent unit reference for hierarchy traversal, cost centre linkage for the source system and responsible manager. Also contains workforce planning and headcount data: budgeted headcount by planning period, actual headcount, vacancy count, attrition count, headcount variance by employment category (permanent, casual, contract), and CAPEX/OPEX labour budget allocations. Enables workforce reporting by terminal, department, and operational area, supports capacity planning for terminal throughput, and provides the organisational foundation for position management. Sourced from the source system Management (OM), the source system and the source system Workforce Planning. SSOT for organisational structure and workforce headcount planning.

attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management; ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006)

attributes.name: gang_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the stevedore gang. Active gangs are available for vessel call deployment; standby gangs are formed but not currently assigned; suspended gangs are temporarily unavailable; disbanded gangs are permanently decommissioned.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management; ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006)

attributes.name: gang_type
attributes.description: Classification of the stevedore gang by operational function. Hatch gangs work in vessel holds; crane gangs operate ship-to-shore (STS) or mobile harbour cranes (MHC); lashing gangs secure containers; RoRo gangs handle roll-on roll-off cargo; mooring gangs handle vessel mooring lines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hatch_gang|crane_gang|lashing_gang|roro_gang|general_gang|mooring_gang — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: International Labour Organization (ILO) Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System

attributes.name: imdg_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gang holds valid International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code certification, authorising them to handle hazardous cargo during vessel loading and discharge operations.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (International Maritime Dangerous Goods); SOLAS Chapter VII; IMO (International Maritime Organization)

attributes.name: is_multi_skilled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this gang is certified and qualified to perform multiple operation types (e.g., both crane operations and lashing), enabling flexible deployment across different vessel operation requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Talent Management; NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System

attributes.name: is_permanent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a permanent standing gang with a fixed composition (True) or a casual/ad-hoc gang assembled for specific vessel calls (False). Permanent gangs have fixed supervisor and core member assignments.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management; ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006)

attributes.name: isps_cleared
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Cleared
attributes.description: Indicates whether all members of this gang have current ISPS Code security clearance, permitting access to restricted port security zones and vessel operations areas.
attributes.references: ISPS Code (International Ship and Port Facility Security); IMO (International Maritime Organization); SOLAS Chapter XI-2

tag_set.value: International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Cleared

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to this gang master record. Used for change tracking, data synchronisation with NAVIS N4 and the source system audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management

attributes.name: max_complement
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers permitted in the stevedore gang for a single deployment, as defined by operational capacity, equipment constraints, and port labour agreements.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System

attributes.name: max_continuous_work_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of continuous hours this gang may work without a mandatory rest break, as prescribed by the applicable labour agreement and MLC 2006 rest hour requirements.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006) Regulation 2.3; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: min_complement
attributes.description: Minimum number of workers required to constitute a legally and operationally compliant stevedore gang for deployment. Defined by port labour agreements, union contracts, and safety regulations under MLC 2006 and OHS standards.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: mlc_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current MLC 2006 compliance status of this gang, reflecting whether rest hour requirements, minimum complement, pay conditions, and certification requirements are fully met under the Maritime Labour Convention.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: gang_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the stevedore gang used for display in operational reports, shift schedules, and terminal operating system interfaces.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management

attributes.name: navis_gang_code
attributes.description: The native gang identifier as recorded in the NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the workforce data product and NAVIS N4 gang assignment records.

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: The vessel cargo operation type this gang is configured to perform: loading (LoLo outbound), discharge (LoLo inbound), combined loading and discharge, lashing/securing of cargo, or container shifting within the vessel.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea); International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH)

attributes.name: pay_grade_code
attributes.description: The pay grade classification code applicable to this gang type, used in the source system processing to determine base wage rates, allowances, and overtime multipliers under the applicable labour agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Module; ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006)

attributes.name: productivity_target_moves_per_hour
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gang Productivity Target Moves Per Hour
attributes.description: The target number of container moves per hour (MPH) expected from this gang during vessel operations. Used as the KPI benchmark for gang performance measurement and SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH) Port Performance Indicators

tag_set.value: Gang Productivity Target Moves Per Hour

attributes.name: rest_period_hours
attributes.description: Minimum mandatory rest period in hours required between consecutive deployments for this gang, as mandated by MLC 2006 and the applicable port labour agreement.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006) Regulation 2.3; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: safety_induction_current
attributes.description: Indicates whether all current members of this gang have completed and hold valid safety induction certification as required by OHS regulations and port safety management systems.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; National Maritime Safety Authority; ISPS Code

attributes.name: sap_hr_gang_code
attributes.description: The gang or work group identifier as recorded in the source system module. Used for payroll processing, labour cost allocation, and time and attendance integration.

attributes.name: standard_complement
attributes.description: The standard or nominal number of workers typically deployed in this gang for routine vessel operations. Used as the default headcount for shift planning and labour cost estimation in the source system
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management; SAP S/4HANA HR Module

attributes.name: terminal_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the marine terminal to which this stevedore gang is permanently assigned. Aligns with terminal master data in NAVIS N4 and the Port Management Information System (PMIS).
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; International Association of Ports and Harbors (IAPH)

attributes.name: union_affiliation_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the maritime trade union or labour organisation to which this gang's members are affiliated. Determines applicable enterprise bargaining agreement, dispute resolution procedures, and industrial relations obligations.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006); SAP S/4HANA HR Module

products.name: gang_assignment
products.description: Transactional record of a stevedore gang being deployed to a specific vessel operation, shift, or work order. Captures deployment date and time, vessel call reference, berth, hatch or work area, gang complement at deployment, actual start and finish times, overtime hours, productivity metrics (moves per hour, TEU per gang hour), and deployment status (assigned, active, completed, cancelled). Links gang master data to actual operational execution and is the primary record for stevedoring productivity analysis. Sourced from NAVIS N4 gang assignment and TOS dispatch records.
products.reference: NAVIS N4 - Gang Assignment / TOPS Expert - Equipment Dispatch

attributes.name: gang_assignment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for gang_assignment

attributes.name: berth_id
attributes.description: Reference to the berth or wharf position where the vessel is moored and the gang is deployed. Used for berth productivity analysis and resource allocation planning.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Berth Planning; TOPS Expert TOS — Berth Planning

attributes.name: equipment_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.equipment_type. Business justification: Each gang deployment uses specific equipment types. FK enables type-level productivity analysis (moves per hour by equipment type), competency matching, maintenance coordination, and operational repor

attributes.name: gang_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stevedore gang master record being deployed. Identifies the specific gang unit (foreman, complement, and skill classification) assigned to this operation.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Gang Master; Oracle HCM Cloud — Workforce Management

attributes.name: port_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary crane (STS, MHC, or QC) assigned to support this gang deployment. A gang typically works in conjunction with a specific crane for container or breakbulk operations. STS = Ship-to-Shore; MHC = Mobile Harbour Crane; QC = Quay Crane.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — Equipment Dispatch; TOPS Expert TOS — Equipment Dispatch; Maximo Asset Management

attributes.name: primary_gang_foreman_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the gang foreman (leading hand) responsible for supervising this deployment. The foreman is accountable for safety, productivity, and sign-off of the gang's work record.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Employee Master; MLC 2006 — Supervisory Responsibilities; OHS — ISO 45001

attributes.name: rail_visit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to intermodal.rail_visit. Business justification: Stevedore gangs handle rail wagon loading/unloading operations at intermodal terminals. Gang deployment to rail visits is operationally parallel to vessel operations, required for labor costing, produ

attributes.name: shift_pattern_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shift schedule record during which this gang deployment occurs. Determines the shift window, shift type (day/night/swing), and associated shift allowances.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Time and Attendance; SAP HR — Shift Planning

attributes.name: tertiary_gang_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the operations supervisor or terminal manager who approved this gang deployment. Required for audit trail, payroll authorisation, and MLC compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Approval Workflow; MLC 2006 — Manning Compliance; ISO 45001

attributes.name: vessel_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vessel call (port visit) record for which this gang is deployed. Links the gang deployment to the specific vessel visit and associated cargo operations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Vessel Visit Module; VTMS Vessel Tracking

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stevedoring work order or cargo operation instruction that triggered this gang deployment. Links to the operational work order in the Terminal Operating System.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Work Order; SAP S/4HANA PM — Work Orders

attributes.name: actual_finish_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the gang completed work and was signed off the vessel operation. Used for hours-worked calculation, overtime determination, and productivity reporting.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Gang Dispatch; Oracle HCM Cloud — Time and Attendance; MLC 2006 — Maritime Labour Convention

attributes.name: actual_start_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the gang commenced work on the vessel operation. Captured from TOS dispatch records or foreman sign-on. Used for productivity measurement and payroll calculation.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Gang Dispatch; Oracle HCM Cloud — Time and Attendance; MLC 2006 — Maritime Labour Convention

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for cancellation when deployment_status = 'cancelled'. Captures operational context such as vessel departure, cargo plan change, or industrial action. Populated only for cancelled deployments.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — Cancellation Codes; Port Management Information System (PMIS)

attributes.name: cargo_type
attributes.description: Classification of cargo being handled by the gang. Determines applicable safety protocols, equipment type, and productivity benchmarks. RoRo = Roll-on Roll-off; LoLo = Lift-on Lift-off handled under container.
attributes.references: IMO — Cargo Classification; IMDG Code; NAVIS N4 TOS — Cargo Type

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gang deployment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time; NAVIS N4 TOS — Record Audit

attributes.name: deployment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the gang deployment. Used as the primary date dimension for daily productivity reporting, payroll date alignment, and operational KPI dashboards.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; SAP S/4HANA HR — Payroll

attributes.name: deployment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this gang deployment, used in operational communications, payroll references, and TOS dispatch records. Format: GD-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Gang Dispatch; Port Management Information System (PMIS)

attributes.name: deployment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the gang deployment. 'assigned' = gang allocated but not yet started; 'active' = gang currently working; 'completed' = work finished and signed off; 'cancelled' = deployment cancelled before commencement; 'suspended' = work temporarily halted (e.g., weather, safety hold).
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Gang Assignment Lifecycle; IMO SOLAS — Safe Working Practices

attributes.name: deployment_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp when the gang was formally deployed and dispatched to the vessel operation. Distinct from the scheduled start time and the actual work commencement time.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Gang Dispatch; Oracle HCM Cloud — Time and Attendance

attributes.name: gang_size_actual
attributes.description: Actual number of workers who reported and worked during this deployment. May differ from planned due to absenteeism, late arrivals, or safety stand-downs. Used for productivity normalisation and payroll.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Time and Attendance; MLC 2006 — Manning Standards; NAVIS N4 TOS

attributes.name: gang_size_planned
attributes.description: Number of workers planned/allocated to the gang for this deployment as per the gang complement schedule. Used for labour cost estimation and MLC compliance planning.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Workforce Management; MLC 2006 — Manning Standards; NAVIS N4 TOS — Gang Complement

attributes.name: gang_type
attributes.description: Classification of the gang by their primary function and skill set for this deployment. Determines applicable award rates, safety certifications required, and productivity benchmarks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stevedore|lashing|hatch|crane_operator|tally|forklift|general|rigging — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Job Classification; MLC 2006 — Seafarer Competency; ILO — Dock Work Convention

attributes.name: gross_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total elapsed hours from actual start to actual finish for this gang deployment, including meal breaks and stoppages. Used as the denominator for gross productivity rate calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Time and Attendance; MLC 2006 — Working Hours; SAP HR — Time Management

attributes.name: hatch_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the vessel hatch or hold to which the gang is assigned. Used for BAPLIE stowage plan alignment, hatch-level productivity tracking, and multi-gang coordination on a single vessel.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — BAPLIE/Stowage Plan; IMO — Vessel Hatch Identification

attributes.name: imdg_cargo_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Cargo Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the gang deployment involves handling of dangerous goods classified under the IMDG Code. Triggers mandatory dangerous goods handling protocols, additional safety briefings, and competency verification. IMDG = International Maritime Dangerous Goods.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code; SOLAS Chapter VII — Carriage of Dangerous Goods; ISPS Code

tag_set.value: International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Cargo Flag

attributes.name: is_overtime_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether overtime worked during this deployment has been formally approved by the operations supervisor. Required for payroll processing and MLC 2006 working hours compliance audit.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Payroll Approval; MLC 2006 — Hours of Work; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: is_safety_incident
attributes.description: Indicates whether a safety incident (injury, near-miss, or dangerous occurrence) was recorded during this gang deployment. Triggers mandatory incident reporting under ISO 45001 and OHS regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 — Occupational Health and Safety; ISPS Code; National Maritime Safety Authority — Incident Reporting

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this gang deployment record was last modified. Used for incremental data loading, change data capture, and audit trail in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time; Databricks Lakehouse — Silver Layer Change Data Capture

attributes.name: moves_completed
attributes.description: Total number of cargo moves (container lifts, unit moves, or equivalent) completed by the gang during this deployment. Primary raw productivity metric used to calculate moves per hour (MPH) KPI.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — Move Count; IAPH — Terminal Productivity Standards; KPI Framework

attributes.name: moves_per_hour
attributes.description: Gross productivity rate expressed as cargo moves per gross gang hour for this deployment. Calculated as moves_completed divided by gross_hours_worked. Stored as a captured operational metric from the TOS, not a derived aggregate — represents the TOS-recorded productivity figure for this specific deployment event.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — Productivity Metrics; IAPH — Terminal Productivity KPIs; KPI Framework

attributes.name: net_hours_worked
attributes.description: Productive working hours excluding meal breaks, safety stoppages, and non-productive time. Used as the denominator for net productivity rate (moves per net gang hour) calculations and MLC compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Time and Attendance; MLC 2006 — Rest Hours; SAP HR — Time Management

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cargo operation the gang is performing. Determines applicable productivity benchmarks, equipment requirements, and tariff rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discharge|load|shifting|lashing|unlashing|hatch_opening|hatch_closing|restow|survey — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Operation Types; IAPH — Port Operations Standards

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours worked by the gang beyond the standard shift duration. Drives overtime pay calculations in the source system is monitored for MLC 2006 maximum working hours compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Payroll; SAP S/4HANA HR — Payroll; MLC 2006 — Hours of Work and Rest

attributes.name: payroll_period_ref
attributes.description: Payroll period identifier (YYYY-MM) to which this gang deployment's hours and earnings are allocated. Used for payroll batch processing in the source system and the source system payroll runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR — Payroll; Oracle HCM Cloud — Payroll; MLC 2006 — Wage Payment

attributes.name: safety_incident_ref
attributes.description: Reference number of the safety incident report raised during this deployment, if applicable. Links to the safety incident management system for investigation and regulatory reporting. Populated only when is_safety_incident = TRUE.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 — OHS Management; National Maritime Safety Authority — Incident Reporting; SOLAS

attributes.name: scheduled_finish_time
attributes.description: Planned finish timestamp for the gang deployment based on the vessel operation schedule. Used for variance analysis and shift planning.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Vessel Planning; TOPS Expert TOS

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Planned start timestamp for the gang deployment as per the vessel operation schedule and berth plan. Used for variance analysis against actual start time.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Vessel Planning; TOPS Expert TOS — Berth Planning

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift period during which the gang is deployed. Determines applicable shift penalty rates, allowances, and MLC rest period compliance checks. Day/afternoon/night/swing shifts attract different award rates.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Shift Management; SAP HR — Shift Planning; MLC 2006 — Hours of Work and Rest

attributes.name: stoppage_hours
attributes.description: Total hours of non-productive stoppage during the deployment (e.g., weather delays, equipment breakdown, safety holds, industrial action). Used for demurrage claims, productivity analysis, and vessel delay reporting.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — Delay Codes; IAPH — Port Performance Indicators; Demurrage (DMG) Calculation

attributes.name: stoppage_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code identifying the primary reason for any work stoppage during this deployment (e.g., WEATHER, EQUIP_BREAKDOWN, SAFETY_HOLD, INDUSTRIAL). Used for delay analysis and demurrage dispute resolution.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — Delay Reason Codes; IAPH — Port Performance Indicators

attributes.name: teu_handled
attributes.description: Total TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units) handled by the gang during this deployment. FEU containers count as 2 TEU. Core metric for container terminal productivity benchmarking and billing. TEU = Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — TEU Count; IAPH — Container Terminal Productivity; ISO 668 — Container Dimensions

attributes.name: teu_per_gang_hour
attributes.description: Container productivity rate expressed as TEU handled per net gang hour. Captured from TOS dispatch records as the operational productivity figure for this deployment. TEU = Twenty-foot Equivalent Unit.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — Productivity Metrics; IAPH — Terminal Productivity KPIs; KPI Framework

attributes.name: tos_dispatch_ref
attributes.description: Source system dispatch reference number from NAVIS N4 or TOPS Expert TOS. Used for data lineage, reconciliation with the TOS, and audit trail back to the operational system of record. TOS = Terminal Operating System.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System — Gang Dispatch; TOPS Expert TOS — Equipment Dispatch

attributes.name: work_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific work area or zone on the terminal or vessel where the gang is deployed (e.g., quayside, hold, deck, CFS area). Used for spatial productivity analysis and safety zone management.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 TOS — Yard/Work Zone; ISPS Code — Port Facility Security Zones

products.name: shift_pattern
products.description: Defines shift patterns and schedules used across port operations including day, afternoon, night, and rotating shifts for terminal, marine, and security operations. Captures shift code, shift name, start time, end time, duration, break entitlements, shift type (regular, overtime, standby, call-out), applicable terminal or department, and MLC rest hour compliance parameters. Reference entity used by roster and time-attendance records. Sourced from the source system Work Schedules.
products.reference: Oracle HCM Cloud - Work Schedule / MLC 2006 Rest Hours

attributes.name: shift_pattern_id
attributes.description: Primary key for shift_pattern

attributes.name: port_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.port_location. Business justification: Shift patterns are location-specific (berth operations differ from yard operations in timing and fatigue risk). FK supports MLC rest hour compliance by location, fatigue management, and shift planning

attributes.name: applicable_department
attributes.description: Name or code of the port department or operational division to which this shift pattern applies (e.g., 'Terminal Operations', 'Marine Services', 'Security', 'Yard Operations', 'Gate Operations', 'Administration'). Supports department-level workforce planning and reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules; SAP S/4HANA HR Organisational Management

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of the shift pattern, particularly relevant for new or modified shift patterns requiring HR, union, or MLC compliance sign-off before activation. Supports governance and change management processes.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules; ILO Maritime Labour Convention; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the HR manager or authorised officer who approved this shift pattern for operational use. Supports audit trail requirements for MLC compliance and enterprise governance.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006; Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this shift pattern received final approval for operational use. Supports audit trail and MLC compliance documentation requirements.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006; Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules

attributes.name: break_count
attributes.description: Number of discrete break periods scheduled within the shift pattern. Supports detailed roster planning and MLC rest hour compliance verification where minimum break frequency is mandated.

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled break entitlement in minutes for the shift pattern. Includes all meal and rest breaks. Distinguishing paid vs unpaid breaks is captured in is_break_paid flag. Used for MLC rest hour compliance and payroll deduction calculations.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3; ILO Maritime Labour Convention

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift pattern record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security; Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules

attributes.name: days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days on which this shift pattern is scheduled (e.g., 'MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI' for weekdays; 'SAT,SUN' for weekends; 'MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT,SUN' for 7-day operations). Supports roster generation and weekend/public holiday penalty rate identification.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled duration of the shift in minutes, inclusive of paid breaks but exclusive of unpaid breaks. Represents the principal quantitative fact of the shift pattern. Used for payroll hours calculation, MLC maximum hours of work compliance, and workforce capacity planning.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3; Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this shift pattern is valid and available for roster assignment. Supports temporal versioning of shift patterns to accommodate enterprise award changes, MLC updates, or operational restructuring.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this shift pattern is no longer valid for new roster assignments. Null indicates the shift pattern is open-ended and currently active. Supports temporal versioning and historical roster analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled end time of the shift in HH:MM (24-hour) format, independent of date. For overnight shifts where end_time is earlier than start_time, the shift is understood to span midnight. Used in roster generation, time-attendance validation, and overtime calculation.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3

attributes.name: enterprise_award_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the enterprise bargaining agreement or industrial award under which this shift pattern is defined (e.g., 'MUA-EBA-2023', 'AMOU-AWARD-2022'). Ensures payroll and rostering compliance with applicable industrial instruments for maritime and port workers.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_index
attributes.description: Numeric fatigue risk score assigned to this shift pattern based on shift timing, duration, and rotation frequency. Higher values indicate greater fatigue risk. Used in MLC compliance monitoring, OHS risk management, and roster optimisation to minimise fatigue-related incidents in safety-critical port operations.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: hcm_work_schedule_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oracle Human Capital Management (HCM) Work Schedule ID
attributes.description: Source system identifier for the corresponding Work Schedule record in the source system Enables bi-directional traceability between the Silver Layer data product and the operational system of record for reconciliation and change management.

tag_set.value: Oracle Human Capital Management (HCM) Work Schedule ID

attributes.name: is_break_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scheduled break entitlement for this shift pattern is paid (True) or unpaid (False). Determines whether break_duration_minutes is deducted from paid_hours in payroll processing.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: is_overnight
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shift pattern spans midnight (True) or is contained within a single calendar day (False). Used in roster date calculations, night shift penalty rate application, and MLC rest hour tracking across calendar day boundaries.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3; Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules

attributes.name: is_public_holiday_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift pattern is scheduled to operate on public holidays (True) or is suspended on public holidays (False). Drives public holiday penalty rate application in payroll and supports port operational continuity planning for 24/7 terminal operations.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Work Schedules; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Workforce job family or occupational group for which this shift pattern is designed (e.g., 'Stevedore Gang', 'Equipment Operator', 'Marine Pilot', 'Security Officer', 'Crane Operator', 'Administrative'). Supports targeted roster assignment and competency-based scheduling.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management; ILO Maritime Labour Convention

attributes.name: max_crew_size
attributes.description: Maximum number of personnel that can be rostered under this shift pattern, constrained by equipment capacity, berth space, or operational safety limits. Used in workforce scheduling to prevent over-allocation and manage OPEX.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: min_crew_size
attributes.description: Minimum number of personnel required to be rostered under this shift pattern to meet safe operational standards and SLA commitments. Used in workforce capacity planning, gang allocation for stevedore operations, and OHS compliance validation.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety; National Maritime Safety Authority; Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management

attributes.name: mlc_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift pattern has been validated as compliant with all applicable Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 rest hour and maximum hours of work requirements (True) or has identified non-compliance issues (False). Supports MLC audit readiness and Port State Control (PSC) inspection preparation.

products.name: roster
products.description: Workforce rostering and shift management covering shift pattern definitions and planned employee assignments. Shift configuration: shift codes, names, start/end times, duration, break entitlements, shift types (regular, overtime, standby, call-out), applicable terminal or department, and MLC rest hour compliance parameters. Roster assignments: roster period (start and end dates), employee assignment to shift, position, terminal or berth area, gang assignment, roster status (draft, published, confirmed), and roster change reasons. Supports advance planning for vessel call labour requirements, ensures MLC minimum rest hour compliance, and provides the scheduling foundation for time and attendance recording. Sourced from the source system Scheduling, Work Schedules, and NAVIS N4 labour planning.

attributes.name: early_departure_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes the employee departed before the scheduled shift end time. Zero if departed on time or later. Used for attendance discipline tracking and payroll deduction calculation.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Time and Attendance; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll

attributes.name: entry_method
attributes.description: The method by which the clock-in/clock-out time was captured. RFID scan = automated badge reader; Biometric = fingerprint/facial recognition; Manual = supervisor or HR manual entry; Mobile app = employee self-service; Supervisor entry = entered by line manager.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Time and Attendance; ISPS Code

attributes.name: gate_entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the employee physically entered the port terminal through the security gate, captured from NAVIS N4 Gate Operations or ISPS-compliant access control system. May differ from clock_in_timestamp if the employee entered the terminal before clocking in.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 16; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations; IMO MSC/Circ.1192

attributes.name: gate_exit_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the employee physically exited the port terminal through the security gate. Used for ISPS security compliance, access duration tracking, and cross-referencing with clock-out data.
attributes.references: ISPS Code Part A Section 16; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations; IMO MSC/Circ.1192

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total net hours worked by the employee during the shift, calculated as (clock_out - clock_in) minus break_duration_minutes. Expressed in decimal hours. Feeds the source system calculation and MLC rest hour compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll

attributes.name: is_public_holiday
attributes.description: Indicates whether the attendance date falls on a public holiday. True = public holiday; False = regular working day. Drives public holiday pay rate multiplier application in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3; ILO

attributes.name: late_arrival_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes the employee arrived late relative to the scheduled shift start time. Zero if on time or early. Used for attendance discipline tracking, payroll deduction calculation, and KPI reporting on workforce punctuality.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Time and Attendance; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll

attributes.name: mlc_rest_hours_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) Rest Hours Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's rest hours between this shift and the previous shift meet the MLC 2006 minimum rest period requirements (minimum 10 hours rest in any 24-hour period; minimum 77 hours rest in any 7-day period). True = compliant; False = potential MLC violation requiring review.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3 Standard A2.3; IMO

tag_set.value: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) Rest Hours Compliance Flag

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond the standard shift duration, expressed in decimal hours. Used for overtime pay calculation in the source system and for MLC maximum hours of work compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll

attributes.name: pay_period_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the payroll period (e.g., 2024-W23, 2024-M06) to which this attendance record belongs. Used to group attendance records for payroll run processing in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll Module; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2

attributes.name: payroll_processed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this attendance record has been included in a payroll run and processed in the source system = included in payroll; False = pending payroll processing. Prevents double-counting in payroll runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll Module; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2

attributes.name: rest_hours_before_shift
attributes.description: Number of hours of rest the employee had between the end of their previous shift and the start of this shift. Critical for MLC 2006 Regulation 2.3 compliance monitoring — minimum 10 hours rest required in any 24-hour period.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Standard A2.3; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: rfid_badge_number
attributes.description: The unique RFID badge identifier used by the employee to clock in/out and access the terminal. Captured from RFID reader scan events. Used to verify identity and link physical access events to attendance records.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; ISO 18000 RFID Standards; NAVIS N4 Gate Operations

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The planned end time of the employee's shift as per the shift schedule. Used to calculate early departure and compare against actual clock-out time.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Time and Attendance; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned start time of the employee's shift as per the shift schedule. Used to calculate lateness and compare against actual clock-in time for attendance compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Time and Attendance; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift pattern worked by the employee. Port operations run 24/7 across day, afternoon, and night shifts. Used for shift differential pay calculation and MLC rest hour compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (the source system the source system NAVIS N4). Used for data lineage tracing, reconciliation, and deduplication in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud; SAP S/4HANA HR; NAVIS N4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this time and attendance record was last modified. Used to track amendments, corrections, and approval workflow updates for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud; SAP S/4HANA HR; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Employee leave applications and approvals covering annual leave, sick leave, maternity/paternity leave, compassionate leave, and MLC-mandated shore leave for seafarers. Captures leave type, requested start and end dates, approved dates, leave balance at time of request, approval workflow status, approver, and any operational impact flag (e.g., affects minimum gang complement). Sourced from the source system Absence Management.
products.reference: Oracle HCM Cloud - Absence Management / MLC 2006 Regulation 2.4

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each employee leave request record in the workforce management system. Primary key for the leave_request data product.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor responsible for approving or rejecting this leave request. Populated once the approval workflow reaches the approver step.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.org_unit. Business justification: Leave request is associated with an organizational unit (department). Currently denormalized with department_code. Adding org_unit_id FK enables proper normalization.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Leave request should capture the position at time of request (point-in-time snapshot). While employee has position_id, this ensures historical accuracy if employee changes positions. Removes redundant

attributes.name: primary_leave_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record in the source system and the source system
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: actual_return_date
attributes.description: The date the employee actually returned to work from leave. May differ from approved_end_date in cases of early return, extended sick leave, or compassionate leave extensions. Used for attendance reconciliation and payroll.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Time and Attendance; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the leave request through the approval lifecycle: draft (saved but not submitted), pending (awaiting approver action), approved, rejected, cancelled (by admin), or withdrawn (by employee).
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the approver made the final approval or rejection decision. Null if the request is still pending. Used for SLA compliance tracking of approval turnaround time.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: approved_days
attributes.description: Total number of working days approved, which may differ from requested_days if the approver modified the leave period. Used for payroll deduction and leave balance updates in the source system
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: approved_end_date
attributes.description: The actual approved end date of the leave, which may differ from the requested end date if the approver modified the dates to accommodate operational requirements.

attributes.name: approved_start_date
attributes.description: The actual approved start date of the leave, which may differ from the requested start date if the approver modified the dates to accommodate operational requirements such as minimum gang complement.

attributes.name: approver_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the approving manager when approving, rejecting, or modifying the leave request. Provides audit trail for approval decisions and communicates conditions or deferrals to the employee.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: the source system centre to which the employee's leave cost (paid leave) is charged. Enables financial reporting of leave liability and OPEX allocation across port operational divisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling; IAPH Port Finance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the leave request record was first created in the source system (the source system May differ from submission_timestamp if the employee saved a draft before submitting.

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments provided by the employee when submitting the leave request, providing additional context such as travel plans, medical circumstances, or operational handover notes.

attributes.name: gang_complement_affected
attributes.description: Specific flag indicating whether approving this leave would reduce the stevedore gang complement below the minimum safe working level required for cargo operations. Critical for vessel scheduling and STS/RTG crane operations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; IAPH Port Operations Standards; Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) Regulations

attributes.name: half_day_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave request is for a half-day (morning or afternoon session) rather than a full working day. Supports flexible leave management for port workers on rotating shift patterns.

attributes.name: half_day_session
attributes.description: Specifies whether the half-day leave applies to the morning or afternoon session. Only populated when half_day_flag is true. Relevant for shift scheduling and gang complement planning.

attributes.name: handover_completed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has completed the required operational handover to their substitute or team before commencing leave. Particularly important for marine pilots, crane operators, and security personnel.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; ISPS Code; ISO 45001 OHS

attributes.name: leave_balance_at_request
attributes.business_glossary_term: Leave Balance at Time of Request
attributes.description: The employee's available leave balance (in days) for the requested leave type at the time the request was submitted. Captured as a snapshot to support audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.4

tag_set.value: Leave Balance at Time of Request

attributes.name: leave_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave is fully paid, unpaid, or partially paid, which drives payroll processing in the source system and determines the financial impact on the employee's earnings.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: leave_loading_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is entitled to leave loading (an additional payment percentage on top of base pay during annual leave) as per the applicable enterprise agreement or MLC provisions.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Classification of the leave being requested. Shore leave is a Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006-mandated entitlement for seafarers and port workers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: annual|sick|maternity|paternity|compassionate|shore_leave|unpaid|study — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.4; Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management

attributes.name: leave_year
attributes.description: The leave entitlement year (e.g., 2024) against which this leave request is charged. Used for annual leave balance management, MLC compliance reporting, and year-end leave liability calculations in the source system
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; SAP S/4HANA HR; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: medical_certificate_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required medical certificate has been received and verified by HR. Relevant for sick leave compliance and MLC health-related absence management. Null when medical_certificate_required is false.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 4.1

attributes.name: medical_certificate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a medical certificate is required to support this leave request (typically for sick leave exceeding the threshold number of days defined in the enterprise leave policy or MLC requirements).
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 4.1; ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: mlc_shore_leave_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) Shore Leave Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request is an MLC 2006 Regulation 2.4-mandated shore leave entitlement for seafarers or port workers. MLC shore leave requests carry special compliance obligations and cannot be unreasonably denied.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.4; International Labour Organization (ILO)

tag_set.value: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) Shore Leave Flag

attributes.name: operational_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request has been flagged as having an operational impact on port operations, such as reducing a stevedore gang below the minimum complement required for vessel operations or crane operations.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; TOPS Expert TOS; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: payroll_period
attributes.description: The payroll processing period (YYYY-MM) in which this leave is processed for pay deduction or leave loading payment in the source system Ensures correct financial period allocation for leave costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll; Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for the leave request as defined in the source system Absence Management (e.g., ANNUAL_PLAN, MEDICAL_CERT, BEREAVEMENT, MLC_SHORE). Supports absence analytics and MLC compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Structured reason for rejection when approval_status is 'rejected'. Captures the business justification such as insufficient staffing, minimum gang complement not met, or peak operational period. Supports MLC compliance and grievance management.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.4

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number for the leave request, used in correspondence, approval workflows, and payroll integration. Format: LR-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: requested_days
attributes.description: Total number of working days requested by the employee, calculated from requested_start_date to requested_end_date excluding weekends and public holidays. Supports half-day precision.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: requested_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the leave period as requested by the employee. Combined with requested_start_date to determine the total requested leave duration.

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the leave period as requested by the employee. Used for scheduling, gang complement planning, and operational impact assessment.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: The employee's assigned shift pattern at the time of the leave request. Determines which operational shifts will be affected and informs gang complement impact assessment.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Time and Attendance; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.3

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the source system (the source system Absence Management transaction ID or the source system record key). Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the employee formally submitted the leave request into the the source system Absence Management system. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: terminal_code
attributes.description: The port terminal or operational area to which the employee is assigned (e.g., CT1, CT2, RoRo Terminal). Used to assess operational impact on terminal staffing levels and gang complement planning.
attributes.references: NAVIS N4 Terminal Operating System; TOPS Expert TOS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the leave request record, including status changes, date amendments, or comment additions. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

products.name: payroll_run
products.description: Payroll processing records covering payroll run execution and individual employee pay details (payslips). Header level: payroll period, pay group, total headcount processed, gross pay total, net pay total, total deductions, employer contributions, payroll status (draft, approved, posted), and the source system area reference. Line level (payslip): individual employee gross earnings, base pay, allowances (shift, danger, meal), overtime pay, deductions (tax, pension, union dues), net pay, year-to-date totals, payment date, payment method, and bank account reference. Each run represents a complete payroll cycle for a defined employee group with full detail down to individual pay records. Sourced from the source system (PY) module. SSOT for payroll execution, individual employee compensation records (payslips), financial reconciliation, and MLC wage statement compliance.
products.reference: SAP HR - Payroll Run (PY) / MLC 2006 Regulation 2.2

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payroll run record in the Databricks Silver layer. Primary key for the payroll_run data product.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: add column org_unit_id (BIGINT) with FK to workforce.org_unit.org_unit_id - payroll runs are executed per organizational unit for cost allocation

attributes.name: primary_payroll_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: the source system of the payroll manager or HR director who formally approved this payroll run for posting. Supports audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; ISO 9001; ILO MLC 2006

attributes.name: reversed_run_payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payroll_run_id that this run reverses or corrects. Populated only for correction or reversal run types, enabling audit chain traceability.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payroll run was formally approved by the authorised payroll manager or HR director, enabling progression to the posting stage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; ISO 9001

attributes.name: bank_file_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the bank payment file (e.g., ABA, BACS, SEPA file) generated for this payroll run and submitted to the port's banking institution for net pay disbursement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Banking Industry Standards

attributes.name: bank_submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the bank payment file was submitted to the financial institution for processing. Used for payment traceability and treasury reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Banking Industry Standards

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: the source system centre code to which the aggregate payroll costs for this run are posted. Enables labour cost allocation by port operational division (e.g., terminal operations, marine services, administration).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; IAPH Port Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll run record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll run (e.g., AUD, USD, SGD). All gross pay, deductions, and net pay figures are denominated in this currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IMO Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal accounting period (month number 1–12 or 1–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year to which payroll costs are posted in the source system

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this payroll run belongs, used for financial reporting, the source system allocation, and year-to-date payroll reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: the source system ledger account code used for posting payroll expenses in this run. Supports financial reconciliation between HR payroll and the port's financial accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IAPH Port Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: gross_pay_total
attributes.description: Total gross earnings for all employees processed in this payroll run before any deductions. Includes base pay, allowances, overtime, and all other earnings components. Used for financial reconciliation and the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2; ILO Convention

attributes.name: headcount_errors
attributes.description: Number of employee records that encountered processing errors during the payroll run and were excluded from the final payroll results. Used for quality control and exception management.

attributes.name: headcount_processed
attributes.description: Total number of employee records included and processed in this payroll run. Used for payroll reconciliation, workforce reporting, and KPI tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Oracle HCM Cloud

attributes.name: mlc_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll run meets all Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 wage payment requirements, including minimum wage, timely payment, and wage statement provision. Critical for port state control inspections and flag state compliance.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2; International Labour Organization (ILO); Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: net_pay_total
attributes.description: Total net pay disbursed to all employees in this payroll run after all deductions. This is the total bank transfer amount and is used for treasury cash management and bank file reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2

attributes.name: oracle_hcm_batch_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier from the source system for the corresponding workforce management batch that feeds time and attendance data into this the source system Supports cross-system reconciliation between the source system the source system
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud Workforce Management; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this payroll run is executed, determining the pay cycle length. Maritime port workforces may have weekly cycles for casual stevedores and monthly cycles for salaried staff.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2

attributes.name: pay_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the employee pay group processed in this run, used to segment workforce populations such as permanent, casual, maritime, or shore-based employees.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006

attributes.name: pay_group_description
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the pay group, e.g., 'Permanent Waterfront', 'Casual Stevedore', 'Marine Pilot', 'Port Security Officer'.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date on which net pay is disbursed to employees' bank accounts via bank transfer or other payment method. Must comply with MLC 2006 Regulation 2.2 wage payment timeliness requirements.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module

attributes.name: payroll_area_code

attributes.name: payroll_area_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the the source system such as 'Stevedore Gang - Waterfront', 'Marine Pilots', 'Port Security', or 'Administrative Staff'.

attributes.name: payroll_period_code
attributes.description: the source system identifier combining the period number and fiscal year (e.g., '01/2024', '26/2024' for fortnightly). Uniquely identifies the pay cycle within the payroll area.

attributes.name: payslips_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual employee payslips (wage statements) have been generated and made available for this payroll run. MLC 2006 Regulation 2.2 requires seafarers and maritime workers to receive a written wage statement.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the payroll period covered by this run. Defines the end of the pay cycle for time and attendance aggregation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the payroll period covered by this run. Defines the start of the pay cycle for time and attendance aggregation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 2.2

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when payroll results were posted to the the source system ledger and cost centres, completing the financial integration of the payroll run.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; SAP HR Payroll (PY) Module

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll run has been reversed. A reversed run requires a correction run to be executed. Used for audit trail and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; ISO 9001

attributes.name: run_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payroll calculation was initiated and executed in the source system This is the principal business event timestamp for the payroll run lifecycle.

attributes.name: run_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the payroll administrator documenting any exceptions, special processing instructions, or explanations for this payroll run (e.g., vessel arrival delays affecting overtime, industrial action adjustments).

attributes.name: run_status

attributes.name: run_type

attributes.name: total_allowances
attributes.description: Aggregate of all allowance payments across the payroll run, including shift allowances, danger allowances, meal allowances, and maritime-specific allowances such as port operations and hazardous cargo allowances.

attributes.name: total_base_pay
attributes.description: Aggregate base salary or wage component across all employees in this payroll run, excluding allowances and overtime. Used for compensation benchmarking and cost analysis.

attributes.name: total_deductions

attributes.name: total_employer_contributions

attributes.name: total_pension_deductions

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 4.5; ILO Social Security Convention

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; National Tax Authority Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: total_union_dues
