attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module; ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 Regulation 1.4

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll run record was last modified in the system. Used for incremental data loading, change tracking, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA HR Payroll (PY) Module

products.name: payslip
products.description: Individual employee payslip record for a given pay period including gross earnings, base pay, allowances (shift allowance, danger allowance, meal allowance), overtime pay, deductions (tax, pension, union dues), net pay, and year-to-date totals. Captures pay period, payment date, payment method, and bank account reference. Sourced from the source system (PY). SSOT for individual employee compensation records and MLC wage statement compliance.
products.reference: SAP HR - Payroll Result / MLC 2006 Standard A2.2

attributes.name: payslip_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual payslip record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the payslip data product. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll (PY) Module — Remuneration Statement Object

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee for whom this payslip is generated. Links to the workforce employee master record in the source system / the source system category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud — Person Record; SAP HR Infotype 0001

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run batch that generated this payslip. Links to the payroll run control record in the source system (PY). Enables traceability of payslip to its originating payroll processing cycle.
attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll (PY) — Payroll Run Control

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.position. Business justification: Payslip should capture the position at time of payment (point-in-time snapshot). While employee has position_id, the employee's position may change over time. Payslip needs its own position_id for his

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Masked or tokenised reference to the employee's nominated bank account for net pay disbursement. Full account details are stored in the secure payroll system (the source system 0009). Only the last 4 digits or a token is stored here for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: PCI DSS — Payment Data Security; SAP HR Infotype 0009 — Bank Details; MLC 2006 Standard A2.2

attributes.name: base_pay
attributes.description: Gross base salary or wage earned by the employee for the pay period before any allowances, overtime, or deductions. Calculated from the employee's pay grade and contracted hours. MONETARY_TRIPLET gross-base component per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Infotype 0008 — Basic Pay; ILO Minimum Wage Convention

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: the source system cost centre to which the employee's payroll costs are allocated for the pay period. Enables financial reporting, OPEX tracking, and departmental cost management. May differ from department_code for cross-charged employees.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Cost Centre Accounting; IAPH Port Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payslip record was first created in the data platform (Databricks Silver Layer). RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this payslip are denominated (e.g., USD, AUD, SGD, EUR). Required for multi-currency port operations and MLC wage statement compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll Currency

attributes.name: danger_allowance
attributes.description: Hazard or danger allowance paid to employees working in high-risk port environments such as IMDG cargo handling, confined space operations, or heavy lift operations. Mandated under OHS regulations and enterprise agreements.
attributes.references: ISO 45001 — Occupational Health and Safety; MLC 2006 Standard A4.3; SAP HR Wage Type

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organisational department code to which the employee is assigned during the pay period (e.g., Terminal Operations, Marine Services, Port Security, Finance). Used for cost allocation and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0001 — Organisational Unit; SAP CO Cost Centre

attributes.name: employee_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the employee as printed on the payslip. Required for MLC wage statement compliance and employee identification. Sourced from the source system 0002 / the source system Person record.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; GDPR Article 4; SAP HR Infotype 0002

attributes.name: employer_pension_contribution
attributes.description: Employer's superannuation or pension contribution for the employee for the pay period, calculated as a percentage of ordinary time earnings. Shown on payslip for MLC social security transparency. Not deducted from employee pay.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Regulation 4.5 — Social Security; National Superannuation Legislation; SAP HR Payroll Employer Contribution

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's employment arrangement. Port workforces typically include permanent staff, casual stevedore gangs, contracted marine pilots, and fixed-term project staff. Affects entitlements, allowances, and MLC applicability.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Regulation 2.1; ILO Convention 158; SAP HR Infotype 0001 — Employee Group

attributes.name: gross_pay
attributes.description: Total gross earnings for the pay period before any deductions, comprising base pay plus all allowances and overtime pay. MONETARY_TRIPLET gross-base amount per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Printed on MLC wage statement.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll Gross Amount; ILO Minimum Wage Convention

attributes.name: income_tax_deduction
attributes.description: Amount of income tax withheld from the employee's gross pay for the pay period in accordance with applicable national tax legislation. Calculated based on the employee's tax code, residency status, and gross earnings.
attributes.references: National Tax Authority Regulations; SAP HR Payroll Tax Calculation; ILO MLC 2006

attributes.name: is_mlc_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payslip meets all Maritime Labour Convention 2006 wage statement requirements, including minimum wage, deduction limits, and payment method compliance. Set by the payroll compliance validation process. Critical for Port State Control (PSC) inspections.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; Port State Control (PSC) Inspection Requirements; ISPS Code

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payslip was formally issued and made available to the employee (via employee self-service portal, email, or physical distribution). BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (precise issuance time) per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll Remuneration Statement; Oracle HCM Cloud Payslip Distribution

attributes.name: leave_hours_taken
attributes.description: Total hours of approved leave (annual leave, sick leave, personal leave) taken by the employee during the pay period. Used to reconcile leave balances and verify leave pay calculations.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Regulation 2.4 — Entitlement to Leave; Oracle HCM Cloud Absence Management; SAP HR Infotype 2001

attributes.name: leave_loading_pay
attributes.description: Additional leave loading payment (typically 17.5% of base pay) paid when the employee takes annual leave, as mandated by enterprise agreements common in Australian and Asia-Pacific port operations. Zero if no leave was taken in the period.
attributes.references: Port Enterprise Agreement; Fair Work Act (Australia); SAP HR Wage Type Leave Loading

attributes.name: meal_allowance
attributes.description: Meal or subsistence allowance paid to employees for extended shifts, overtime, or remote port assignments. Typically defined in enterprise agreements for stevedore gangs and marine service personnel.
attributes.references: Port Enterprise Agreement / Collective Bargaining Agreement; SAP HR Wage Type; MLC 2006 Standard A3.2

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., national ID, tax file number, social security number) of the employee. Required for tax authority reporting, payroll tax calculations, and regulatory compliance. Stored in encrypted form.
attributes.references: ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006; National Tax Authority Regulations; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: net_pay
attributes.description: Final amount payable to the employee after all deductions have been applied (gross_pay minus total_deductions). MONETARY_TRIPLET net total per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. The amount actually disbursed to the employee's bank account.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll Net Pay; ILO Protection of Wages Convention No. 95

attributes.name: ordinary_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total ordinary (non-overtime) hours worked by the employee during the pay period. Used to verify base pay calculations, monitor MLC rest hour compliance, and support workforce productivity analytics. Sourced from the source system Time and Attendance.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.3 — Hours of Work and Rest; ILO Hours of Work Convention; Oracle HCM Cloud Time and Attendance

attributes.name: other_deductions
attributes.description: Aggregate of all other authorised deductions not separately itemised (e.g., salary advance repayments, equipment damage levies, voluntary savings). MLC 2006 restricts deductions to those authorised by law or collective agreement.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2 — Deductions; SAP HR Payroll Other Deductions Wage Type

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period. Used to verify overtime pay calculations, monitor MLC rest hour compliance, and support workforce planning analytics.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.3 — Hours of Work and Rest; ILO Hours of Work Convention No. 180; SAP HR Time Evaluation

attributes.name: overtime_pay
attributes.description: Total overtime earnings for the pay period, calculated from overtime hours worked multiplied by the applicable overtime rate. Critical for port operations where vessel turnaround requirements drive significant overtime for stevedore and crane operator workforces.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; ILO Hours of Work Convention; SAP HR Wage Type OT

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the employee is paid, determining the pay period cycle. Port workforce may include weekly-paid stevedore gangs, fortnightly-paid equipment operators, and monthly-paid administrative staff.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll — Pay Frequency

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Salary grade or pay band assigned to the employee's position, determining the base pay range. Sourced from the source system 0008 (Basic Pay). Confidential as it reveals compensation structure.
attributes.references: SAP HR Infotype 0008 — Basic Pay; Oracle HCM Cloud Grade; ILO Equal Remuneration Convention

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the pay period covered by this payslip. Defines the end boundary of the earnings and deductions calculation window. Together with pay_period_start_date, fully identifies the pay period.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll (PY) Period Parameters

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the pay period covered by this payslip. Defines the start boundary of the earnings and deductions calculation window. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category (date precision) per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll (PY) Period Parameters

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which net pay was or is scheduled to be disbursed to the employee's nominated bank account or via the designated payment method. Critical for MLC wage payment timeliness compliance and cash flow management.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll (PY) Payment Run

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. Bank transfer is the predominant method for port workforces; cash may apply for casual stevedore gangs in some jurisdictions. MLC 2006 requires payment in legal tender or by bank transfer.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; ILO Protection of Wages Convention No. 95; SAP HR Payroll Payment Method

attributes.name: payroll_area
attributes.description: the source system area code grouping employees processed together in the same payroll run cycle (e.g., stevedores, marine pilots, administrative staff, security). Determines pay frequency and payroll calendar. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product as payroll areas vary by port organisation]

attributes.name: payslip_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the payslip, formatted as PS-YYYY-MM-EMPREF. Used for employee reference, MLC wage statement compliance, and audit trail. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Maritime Labour Convention (MLC) 2006 — Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll (PY) Remuneration Statement

attributes.name: payslip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payslip document. 'draft' indicates payroll is being processed; 'generated' means the payslip has been computed; 'issued' means it has been delivered to the employee; 'cancelled' means it was voided; 'reissued' means a corrected version was produced. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP HR Payroll (PY) — Payroll Status; MLC 2006 Standard A2.2

attributes.name: pension_deduction
attributes.description: Employee contribution to pension, superannuation, or provident fund deducted from gross pay for the pay period. Mandatory under national pension legislation and MLC 2006 social security provisions.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Regulation 4.5 — Social Security; ILO Social Security Convention; SAP HR Wage Type Pension

attributes.name: shift_allowance
attributes.description: Additional allowance paid to employees working non-standard shifts (night shifts, weekend shifts, rotating shifts) in port terminal operations. Common for stevedore gangs, crane operators, and vessel traffic service staff operating 24/7.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; Port Enterprise Agreement / Collective Bargaining Agreement; SAP HR Wage Type

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Employee's tax withholding code or tax category assigned by the national tax authority, determining the applicable income tax rate and withholding calculation method. Sourced from the source system 0161 / the source system Tax Card.
attributes.references: National Tax Authority Regulations; SAP HR Infotype 0161 — Tax Data; Oracle HCM Cloud Tax Card

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions applied in the pay period (income tax + pension + union dues + other deductions). MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Printed on MLC wage statement for transparency.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll Total Deductions

attributes.name: union_dues_deduction
attributes.description: Trade union membership dues deducted from the employee's pay per authorisation. Relevant for port workforces with high union membership rates (e.g., International Longshoremen's Association, maritime unions). Requires employee written authorisation.
attributes.references: ILO Freedom of Association Convention No. 87; MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Wage Type Union

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payslip record was last modified in the data platform (e.g., following a payroll correction or reissue). RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for change tracking and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Requirements; SAP HR Payroll Correction Run

attributes.name: ytd_gross_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay earned by the employee from the start of the financial/tax year to the end of the current pay period. Required for annual tax reporting, payment summaries, and MLC wage record compliance.
attributes.references: National Tax Authority Annual Reporting Requirements; MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll YTD Cumulation

attributes.name: ytd_net_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative net pay disbursed to the employee from the start of the financial/tax year to the end of the current pay period. Supports annual earnings verification, MLC wage record compliance, and employee financial planning.
attributes.references: MLC 2006 Standard A2.2; SAP HR Payroll YTD Net Cumulation; National Tax Authority

attributes.name: ytd_tax_deduction
attributes.description: Cumulative income tax withheld from the employee from the start of the financial/tax year to the end of the current pay period. Required for annual tax reconciliation and payment summary generation.
attributes.references: National Tax Authority Annual Reporting Requirements; SAP HR Payroll YTD Tax Cumulation

products.name: competency
products.description: Master catalogue of competencies, qualifications, and certifications required for port workforce roles. Includes competency code, competency name, competency type (operational licence, safety certification, regulatory certificate, trade qualification), issuing authority (IMO, national maritime authority, port authority), validity period in months, renewal requirements, and whether the competency is mandatory under STCW, ISPS, or MLC. Reference entity used by employee certification and training records.
products.reference: STCW Convention / ISPS Code / IMO Model Courses

attributes.name: competency_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each competency record in the master catalogue. Primary key for the competency data product.

attributes.name: equipment_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.equipment_type. Business justification: Competencies authorize operation of specific equipment types (crane operator, RTG driver). FK enables competency-equipment matching for deployment, certification tracking, workforce capability plannin

attributes.name: imdg_class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.imdg_class. Business justification: Dangerous goods competencies are IMDG class-specific (Class 1 explosives, Class 2 gases). FK enables DG handling authorization, gang assignment validation for hazmat cargo, and IMDG Code compliance tr

attributes.name: vessel_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to masterdata.vessel_type. Business justification: Competencies apply to vessel types (STCW endorsements, pilot licenses for specific vessel classes). FK enables crew qualification verification, pilot dispatch validation, and maritime training complia

attributes.name: applicable_job_family
attributes.description: Port workforce job family or occupational group for which this competency is relevant (e.g., 'Marine Pilot', 'Stevedore', 'Equipment Operator', 'Port Security Officer', 'Harbour Master'). Supports role-based competency gap analysis and workforce planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marine_pilot|stevedore|equipment_operator|port_security_officer|harbour_master|customs_officer|maintenance_technician|administrative — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Job Families; ILO MLC 2006; IAPH Workforce Standards

attributes.name: approved_training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the approved training institution or provider authorised by the issuing authority to deliver training for this competency (e.g., 'Australian Maritime College', 'Port Authority Training Centre'). Ensures workforce training is conducted through recognised providers.
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; National Maritime Safety Authority; Oracle HCM Cloud - Learning Management

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to assess and award this competency. Determines the training and assessment pathway required for workforce members to obtain the qualification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: written_exam|practical_assessment|simulator|on_the_job|portfolio|medical_examination|observation|combined — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; Oracle HCM Cloud - Learning Management; ISO 45001

attributes.name: competency_category
attributes.description: Functional grouping of the competency for workforce planning and reporting purposes (e.g., 'Marine Operations', 'Container Handling Equipment', 'Security', 'Health and Safety', 'Trade Compliance', 'Leadership'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marine_operations|container_handling|security|health_safety|trade_compliance|leadership|environmental|administrative — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; IAPH Workforce Standards

attributes.name: competency_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the competency within the port authority and the source system competency catalogue. Used for cross-system referencing and EDI exchanges.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; IMO Model Course Catalogue

attributes.name: competency_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the competency record in the master catalogue. 'active' indicates the competency is currently in use; 'superseded' indicates it has been replaced by a newer version; 'draft' indicates it is pending approval for inclusion.

attributes.name: competency_type
attributes.description: Classification of the competency into its primary category: operational_licence (equipment or vessel operating licence), safety_certification (safety-related training certificate), regulatory_certificate (mandatory regulatory compliance certificate), trade_qualification (vocational or trade qualification), medical_certificate (seafarer or port worker medical fitness certificate).
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; ISPS Code; MLC 2006; ISO 45001

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_to_obtain amount (e.g., 'AUD', 'USD', 'SGD'). Supports multi-currency port operations and the source system reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI - Financial Accounting

attributes.name: cost_to_obtain
attributes.description: Standard cost (in local currency) for a workforce member to obtain this competency through the approved training and assessment pathway. Used for workforce training budget planning and OPEX forecasting in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Controlling; Oracle HCM Cloud - Learning Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this competency record was first created in the master catalogue. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and the source system synchronisation tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: competency_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the competency, including the knowledge, skills, and abilities it certifies, the scope of work it authorises, and any specific conditions or limitations on its application in port operations.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; IMO STCW Convention

attributes.name: digital_certificate_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issuing authority supports digital or electronic certificates for this competency, enabling integration with port access control systems and ISPS security checks via RFID or digital verification.
attributes.references: ISPS Code; IMO; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this competency definition became or becomes effective in the master catalogue. Used to manage competency version transitions and ensure workforce records reference the correct version.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; IMO STCW Convention

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this competency definition ceases to be effective (nullable for open-ended active competencies). When populated, indicates the competency has been superseded or retired from the catalogue.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; IMO STCW Convention

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number or code assigned by the issuing authority (e.g., IMO Model Course number, STCW regulation reference such as 'STCW Reg VI/1', national certificate code). Enables direct cross-referencing with regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; National Maritime Safety Authority; ISPS Code

attributes.name: imo_model_course_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Model Course Number
attributes.description: IMO Model Course number associated with the training programme for this competency (e.g., '1.21' for Personal Safety and Social Responsibilities, '3.12' for Ship Security Officer). Used to align port training programmes with IMO-approved curricula.
attributes.references: IMO Model Course Catalogue; IMO STCW Convention

tag_set.value: International Maritime Organization (IMO) Model Course Number

attributes.name: is_mandatory_isps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Mandatory under International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competency is mandatory under the ISPS Code for port facility security personnel, Port Facility Security Officers (PFSOs), and security-designated roles.

tag_set.value: Is Mandatory under International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code

attributes.name: is_mandatory_mlc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Mandatory under Maritime Labour Convention (MLC)
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competency is mandatory under the ILO Maritime Labour Convention (MLC 2006) for seafarers and port workers covered by the convention's scope.

tag_set.value: Is Mandatory under Maritime Labour Convention (MLC)

attributes.name: is_mandatory_stcw
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Mandatory under Standards of Training Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW)
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competency is mandatory under the IMO Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW) Convention. True for all STCW-mandated certificates required for seafarers and port workers with shipboard duties.
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention (as amended by Manila Amendments 2010)

tag_set.value: Is Mandatory under Standards of Training Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW)

attributes.name: is_renewable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the competency requires periodic renewal upon expiry. True for time-limited certificates (e.g., STCW refresher, medical fitness); False for lifetime qualifications (e.g., trade certificates).
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; ILO MLC 2006; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the body responsible for issuing or recognising this competency (e.g., 'International Maritime Organization (IMO)', 'Australian Maritime Safety Authority (AMSA)', 'Port Authority', 'National Maritime Safety Authority'). Determines the regulatory weight and mutual recognition applicability.
attributes.references: IMO; National Maritime Safety Authority; ISPS Code Administration; ILO MLC 2006

attributes.name: issuing_authority_type
attributes.description: Classification of the issuing authority to support regulatory hierarchy and mutual recognition logic. 'imo' for IMO-mandated certificates, 'national_maritime_authority' for flag/port state certificates, 'port_authority' for port-specific licences, 'industry_body' for industry association qualifications, 'vocational_body' for trade/vocational qualifications, 'internal' for port-issued internal certifications.
attributes.references: IMO; National Maritime Safety Authority; ISPS Code; ILO MLC 2006

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction under which the competency is issued or recognised (e.g., 'AUS', 'SGP', 'GBR'). Used for Port State Control (PSC) compliance checks and mutual recognition assessments.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; IMO STCW Convention; Port State Control (PSC) Authorities

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this competency record was most recently modified in the master catalogue. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer ingestion pipeline and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; SAP S/4HANA HR

attributes.name: level_descriptor
attributes.description: STCW-aligned functional level descriptor indicating the operational tier at which this competency applies: 'management_level' (officer in charge), 'operational_level' (watchkeeping officer), 'support_level' (rating), 'awareness_level' (general port worker). Aligns with STCW Table A-II/1 through A-VI/6.
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: medical_standard_ref
attributes.description: Reference to the applicable medical fitness standard required for this competency (e.g., 'ILO/IMO Guidelines on Medical Examinations', 'ENG1 Medical Standard', 'ML5 Medical Standard'). Applicable to competencies with a medical fitness prerequisite under MLC 2006.
attributes.references: ILO MLC 2006; IMO; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: minimum_proficiency_level
attributes.description: The minimum proficiency level required for a workforce member to be considered competent for role assignment. Expressed in terms of the competency's proficiency scale (e.g., '3' for a 1-5 scale, 'working' for a maturity scale, 'pass' for pass/fail).
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; IMO STCW Convention

attributes.name: mutual_recognition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competency is subject to international mutual recognition agreements between maritime administrations, allowing certificates issued in one jurisdiction to be accepted in another without re-examination.
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; National Maritime Safety Authority; IAPH

attributes.name: competency_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the competency, qualification, or certification as recognised by the issuing authority (e.g., 'Basic Safety Training', 'ISPS Port Facility Security Officer', 'Quay Crane Operator Licence').
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; ISPS Code; MLC 2006

attributes.name: prerequisite_competency_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of competency codes that must be held by a workforce member before they can undertake training or assessment for this competency. Supports competency pathway sequencing in the source system learning plans.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; IMO STCW Convention

attributes.name: proficiency_scale
attributes.description: Proficiency measurement scale applied to this competency. 'pass_fail' for binary certification outcomes; 'level_1_5' for graded proficiency levels; 'awareness', 'working', 'practitioner', 'expert' for capability maturity levels used in the source system competency profiles.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; IAPH Workforce Standards

attributes.name: psc_recognised
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competency certificate is recognised and accepted by Port State Control (PSC) authorities during vessel and port facility inspections. Critical for compliance with PSC detention avoidance.
attributes.references: Port State Control (PSC) Authorities; IMO STCW Convention; ISPS Code

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Primary regulatory or compliance framework under which this competency is mandated or recognised. STCW (Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping), ISPS (International Ship and Port Facility Security), MLC (Maritime Labour Convention), SOLAS (Safety of Life at Sea), MARPOL (Marine Pollution Convention), IMDG (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code), ISO standards, national legislation, or internal port policy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stcw|isps|mlc|solas|marpol|imdg|iso_45001|iso_14001|national|internal — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; ISPS Code; ILO MLC 2006; SOLAS; MARPOL; IMDG Code; ISO 45001; ISO 14001

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiry that a renewal notification should be triggered for workforce planning and compliance management. Enables proactive scheduling of refresher training or re-certification before the competency lapses.
attributes.references: Oracle HCM Cloud - Competency Framework; IMO STCW Convention

attributes.name: renewal_requirements
attributes.description: Textual description of the conditions and prerequisites required to renew this competency, including refresher training hours, re-examination requirements, sea service evidence, or medical fitness re-assessment as mandated by the issuing authority.
attributes.references: IMO STCW Convention; ILO MLC 2006; National Maritime Safety Authority

attributes.name: revalidation_sea_service_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days of approved sea service or port operational service required as evidence for revalidation of this competency under STCW or national maritime authority requirements.

products.name: employee_certification
products.description: Comprehensive certification, competency, and licence management for all port workforce personnel. Includes: (1) Master competency catalogue — all qualifications, licences, and certifications required for port roles with competency codes, types (operational licence, safety certification, regulatory certificate, trade qualification, medical fitness), issuing authorities (IMO, national maritime authority, port authority), validity periods, renewal requirements, and mandatory flags (STCW, ISPS, MLC). products.name: disciplinary_case

attributes.description: Indicates whether the pilot holds specific endorsement to pilot LNG carriers. LNG vessels require specialized training due to cargo hazards and vessel handling characteristics.

attributes.description: Maximum vessel Deadweight Tonnage in metric tonnes that the pilot is authorised to pilot. DWT is the total weight a vessel can safely carry including cargo, fuel, crew, provisions. Key limitation for pilotage operations.

attributes.description: Maximum vessel Gross Registered Tonnage that the pilot is authorised to pilot. GRT is a measure of the overall internal volume of a vessel. Used in some jurisdictions as an alternative to DWT for licence restrictions.

products.name: position_competency_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the competency requirements defined for each authorised position within the port organisational structure. It captures the mandatory and recommended competencies, certifications, and qualifications that must be held by any employee occupying a specific position. Each record links one position to one competency with attributes that define the requirement level, proficiency expectations, and compliance tracking. This is actively managed by HR and operations teams during organisational design, recruitment, compliance audits, and workforce planning.. Existence Justification: Position competency requirements represent a genuine operational M:N relationship actively managed by HR and operations teams. A position requires multiple competencies (e.g., a Quay Crane Operator position requires ISPS clearance, crane operator licence, safety induction, and medical fitness), and a competency is required by multiple positions (e.g., ISPS security clearance is required by Port Security Officer, Berth Gang Supervisor, and Marine Pilot positions). This relationship is managed during organisational design, recruitment, compliance audits, training planning, and competency change management.

attributes.description: Date from which this competency requirement became effective for the position. Supports requirement change management and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this competency requirement ceases to be applicable for the position. Null for ongoing requirements. Supports requirement lifecycle management.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competency is mandatory (must-have) or recommended (nice-to-have) for the position. Mandatory competencies block position assignment if not held.

attributes.name: minimum_proficiency_level
attributes.description: The minimum proficiency level required for this competency in the context of this specific position. Determines assessment thresholds and training targets.

[Moved from position: This comma-separated string in position is a denormalized representation of the M:N relationship. Moving to the association table enables structured queries, individual requirement tracking, and proper relationship data (mandatory_flag, proficiency_level, effective_date) for each position-competency pair.]
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO), International Labour Organization (ILO) - Maritime Labour Convention

Moving to the association table enables structured queries, gap analysis, and proper relationship data management for each position-competency requirement.]

attributes.description: The date the invoice document was received by the port organization. Used for tracking invoice processing cycle time.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the verification and payment workflow. Parked invoices are saved but not posted; blocked invoices require approval; cleared invoices are approved for payment; posted invoices are in accounts payable; cancelled or reversed invoices are voided.

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. Standard invoices are for goods/services delivered; credit memos reduce amounts owed; debit memos increase amounts owed; prepayment and down payment invoices are advance payments; final invoices settle the remaining balance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this invoice record was last modified. Record audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the invoice is blocked for payment pending resolution of discrepancies or approval. Empty if not blocked.

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the invoice is blocked for payment. May include quantity variance, price variance, or missing approvals.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date payment was made to the vendor. Null if invoice is not yet paid.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with payment terms. Calculated from invoice date and payment terms.
attributes.references: SAP MM Payment Due Date Calculation

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which payment will be made to the vendor. Determines payment processing workflow and bank account selection.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned when payment is executed. Links the invoice to the actual payment transaction for reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code defining the due date calculation and any early payment discount conditions. Examples include Net 30, 2/10 Net 30.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the financial accounting system. Determines the fiscal period for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: price_variance
attributes.description: The difference between invoiced price and purchase order price. Used to identify pricing discrepancies requiring approval or vendor correction.

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: The difference between invoiced quantity and goods receipt quantity. Positive values indicate over-invoicing; negative values indicate under-invoicing.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was reversed or cancelled. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this invoice has been reversed or cancelled. True if reversed; false otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the invoice was reversed. May include duplicate invoice, incorrect amount, or vendor request.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice. May include VAT, GST, sales tax, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction.
attributes.references: SAP MM Invoice Verification Tax Calculation

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code applied to the invoice determining the tax rate and tax type. Configured per jurisdiction and material/service category.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way matching process comparing purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice. Matched indicates all three documents align within tolerance; variances indicate discrepancies requiring resolution.

attributes.name: vendor_reference_number
attributes.description: Additional reference number provided by the vendor for their internal tracking or delivery note reference. May include packing slip number or vendor order number.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was verified and approved for payment. Marks completion of three-way matching and approval workflow.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who verified and approved the invoice for payment.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount withheld from vendor payment as required by tax regulations. Remitted directly to tax authorities on behalf of the vendor.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the type and rate of withholding tax applied to the invoice.

products.name: supplier_contract
products.description: Long-term procurement contracts and framework agreements established with vendors for recurring supply of materials or services, including blanket purchase orders, scheduling agreements, and outline agreements. Captures contract header and line-item details including contract number, vendor, contract type, validity period, total contract value, commodity scope, payment terms, penalty clauses, renewal terms, and per-line material/service lines, agreed quantities, target values, pricing conditions, and release order history. Supports contract utilisation tracking, release order management, and contract compliance monitoring. Sourced from the source system Agreement (EKKO/EKPO - Doc Types MK, WK, LP, LPA).

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier contract record. Primary key.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor party with whom this contract is established.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of amendments or change orders issued against this contract since its inception.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract received final approval and authorization for execution.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status indicating whether the contract has been reviewed and authorized by appropriate authorities.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized person who approved this contract for execution.

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Classification code identifying the primary commodity or material group covered by this contract (e.g., spare parts, fuel, services).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code within the enterprise that holds financial accountability for this contract.

attributes.name: compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Regulatory, safety, environmental, or quality compliance standards that the vendor must adhere to under this contract (e.g., ISO certifications, ISPS, MARPOL).

attributes.name: confidentiality_clause
attributes.description: Non-disclosure and confidentiality obligations binding the vendor regarding proprietary information, trade secrets, and business data.

attributes.name: contract_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the contract scope, materials, services, and special terms covered by this agreement.

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the signed contract document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the procurement contract. Used in the source system the outline agreement number (EKKO-EBELN).

attributes.name: contract_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the procurement manager or contract administrator responsible for this agreement.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supplier contract indicating its operational state and validity.

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the procurement contract type. Maps to the source system types: MK (Quantity Contract), WK (Value Contract), LP (Scheduling Agreement), LPA (Framework Agreement).

attributes.name: contract_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the contract representing the maximum commitment or target spend over the contract period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value and pricing (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Named location or address where goods or services under this contract are to be delivered.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Agreed mechanism for resolving disputes arising from the contract, including jurisdiction and arbitration clauses.

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and governing law under which the contract is executed and disputes are resolved.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the responsibilities, costs, and risks between buyer and seller for delivery of goods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: insurance_requirements
attributes.description: Mandatory insurance coverage and liability protection that the vendor must maintain during the contract period.

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or modification made to the contract terms.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this contract record in the system.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms and conditions agreed with the vendor, including net due days and discount terms (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: penalty_clause
attributes.description: Contractual penalties and liquidated damages applicable for non-performance, late delivery, or quality failures by the vendor.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The port facility, terminal, or plant location where materials or services under this contract will be delivered or performed.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: The buyer group or procurement team responsible for operational management of this contract.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: The organizational unit responsible for negotiating and managing this contract within the enterprise structure.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target quantity (e.g., EA for each, TON for metric tons, CBM for cubic meters).

attributes.name: released_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of materials or services released through purchase orders against this contract to date.

attributes.name: released_value
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value of all release orders or call-offs issued against this contract to date.

attributes.name: renewal_terms
attributes.description: Conditions and provisions for contract renewal, including automatic renewal clauses, notice periods, and renewal pricing adjustments.

attributes.name: risk_classification
attributes.description: Risk level assigned to this contract based on vendor reliability, commodity criticality, and supply chain exposure.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement
attributes.description: Defined service level commitments, performance metrics, and quality standards that the vendor must meet under this contract.

attributes.name: target_quantity
attributes.description: Planned or target quantity of materials or services to be procured over the contract period. Applicable for quantity contracts.

attributes.name: termination_clause
attributes.description: Legal provisions and conditions under which either party may terminate the contract, including notice periods and penalties.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of contract value or quantity that has been utilized through release orders, calculated as (released / target) * 100.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date from which the contract becomes legally binding and operationally effective.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date until which the contract remains valid. Nullable for open-ended contracts.

attributes.name: vendor_performance_rating
attributes.description: Overall performance rating of the vendor under this contract based on delivery, quality, and service metrics.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this contract record in the system.

products.name: supplier_contract_item
products.description: Line-item detail of supplier contracts and framework agreements, capturing individual material or service lines with agreed quantities, target values, pricing conditions, and release order history. Supports contract utilisation tracking and release order management. Sourced from the source system Agreement Item (EKPO).
products.reference: SAP MM EKPO - Outline Agreement Item

attributes.name: supplier_contract_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier contract line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material or spare part being procured under this contract line. Links to the master material catalog.

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent supplier contract or framework agreement header. Links this line item to the master contract.

attributes.name: blocking_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this contract line is temporarily blocked from use in release orders. Used for quality holds or contractual disputes.

attributes.name: contract_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the contract document. Used for ordering and referencing specific contract lines.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract line item record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the contract line pricing. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, SGD.

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this contract line item is marked for deletion. When true, the line is logically deleted but retained for audit purposes.

attributes.name: delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard number of calendar days from release order placement to expected delivery at the destination. Used for planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated discount percentage applied to the net price for this contract line. Used for pricing calculations on release orders.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a goods receipt must be posted for materials ordered against this contract line. Controls inventory management integration.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk between supplier and buyer. Examples: FOB (Free On Board), CIF (Cost Insurance Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms clause where risk and cost transfer occurs. Examples: Port of Singapore, Supplier Warehouse.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether invoice verification is required for orders against this contract line. Controls accounts payable integration.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Classification of the contract line item type. Determines procurement behavior and release order processing rules.

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contract line item. Controls whether the line can be used for release orders and tracks utilization state.

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent goods receipt was posted for materials ordered against this contract line. Tracks fulfillment activity.

attributes.name: last_release_order_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent release order was created against this contract line. Used for contract activity monitoring.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer part number for the contracted material. Used for precise material identification and cross-referencing.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material or service being contracted. Provides human-readable context for the line item.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Material group classification code for procurement categorization and reporting. Groups similar materials for analysis.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered per release against this contract line. Enforces capacity or contractual constraints.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered per release against this contract line. Enforces supplier minimum order requirements.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this contract line item record. Part of audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract line item record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit purposes.

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Agreed unit price for the material or service excluding taxes and surcharges. Base price used for release order valuation.

attributes.name: order_quantity_multiple
attributes.description: Quantity increment or rounding value for release orders. Orders must be placed in multiples of this value (e.g., multiples of 10 units).

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code defining the payment schedule and discount conditions for this contract line. Examples: Net 30, 2/10 Net 30.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Port facility or plant code where the contracted material or service will be delivered or performed. Links to organizational structure.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Number of units to which the net price applies. For example, price per 100 units would have price_unit = 100.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or purchasing group responsible for managing this contract line. Used for workload distribution and accountability.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether incoming materials must undergo quality inspection before acceptance. Triggers quality management workflows.

attributes.name: released_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity already released against this contract line through purchase orders or release orders. Used for contract utilization tracking.

attributes.name: released_value
attributes.description: Cumulative monetary value already released against this contract line through purchase orders. Tracks spend against target value.

attributes.name: remaining_quantity
attributes.description: Remaining quantity available for release under this contract line. Calculated as target_quantity minus released_quantity.

attributes.name: remaining_value
attributes.description: Remaining monetary value available for release under this contract line. Calculated as target_value minus released_value.

attributes.name: service_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the service being contracted when the line item represents a service rather than a material. Used for service-based contracts.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage location or warehouse within the plant where materials will be received. Used for inventory management integration.

attributes.name: target_quantity
attributes.description: Planned or target quantity of material or service units to be procured under this contract line over the contract period. Used for contract utilization tracking.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Total planned monetary value for this contract line over the contract period. Calculated as target_quantity multiplied by net_price, adjusted for price_unit.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code determining applicable tax rates and treatment for this contract line. Used for tax calculation on release orders.

attributes.name: technical_specification_reference
attributes.description: Reference to technical specification document or standard that the contracted material or service must meet. Examples: ISO standard, IMO regulation, port technical specification.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the contracted quantity. Examples: EA (each), KG (kilogram), M (meter), HR (hour), CBM (cubic meter).

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this contract line item expires and can no longer be used for release orders. Defines the contract line validity period.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this contract line item becomes effective and can be used for release orders. Part of the contract line validity period.

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for which the supplier provides warranty coverage for materials or services under this contract line.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this contract line item record. Part of audit trail for accountability.

products.name: vendor_evaluation
products.description: Periodic performance evaluation of vendors across key criteria including on-time delivery, quality compliance, price competitiveness, responsiveness, and HSSE (Health, Safety, Security, Environment) compliance. Captures evaluation period, overall score, sub-scores by criterion, evaluator, evaluation date, and recommended vendor tier adjustment. Supports vendor qualification, preferred vendor lists, and sourcing decisions. Sourced from the source system Evaluation (ME61/LFM1).

attributes.name: vendor_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor evaluation record. Primary key for the vendor evaluation entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who conducted the vendor evaluation. Links to workforce master data.

attributes.name: kpi_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_kpi. Business justification: Vendor HSSE performance scores (contractor incident rates, environmental compliance, safety audit results) are formal evaluation criteria. Safety KPI linkage enables quantitative vendor scoring, perfo

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being evaluated. Links to the vendor master data in the procurement domain.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor evaluation was formally approved by management. Represents the point at which evaluation results become official and actionable.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name of the manager or procurement director who approved the vendor evaluation. Captures approval authority for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Description of the corrective actions required from the vendor. Details specific performance improvements, process changes, or compliance measures that must be implemented.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the vendor must complete required corrective actions. Used to track vendor response and follow-up evaluation scheduling.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the vendor is required to implement corrective actions based on evaluation findings. True if performance deficiencies require formal remediation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor evaluation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total purchase value. Indicates the currency in which vendor transactions were conducted during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: current_vendor_tier
attributes.description: Current classification tier of the vendor prior to this evaluation. Preferred vendors receive priority in sourcing, approved vendors meet minimum standards, conditional vendors have restrictions, probation vendors are under performance improvement plans, and blocked vendors are suspended from new business.

attributes.name: documentation_compliance_score
attributes.description: Performance score for vendor adherence to documentation requirements including certificates, test reports, material safety data sheets, customs documentation, and trade compliance paperwork during the evaluation period.
attributes.references: SAP MM Vendor Evaluation (ME61), World Customs Organization (WCO)

attributes.name: documentation_compliance_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor applied to the documentation compliance score in the overall score calculation. Expressed as a percentage or decimal fraction.

attributes.name: evaluation_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments and observations from the evaluator. Captures qualitative feedback, notable incidents, improvement areas, and strengths observed during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the vendor evaluation was conducted and finalized. Represents the business event timestamp for the evaluation activity.

attributes.name: evaluation_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the vendor evaluation. Human-readable reference number used in procurement documentation and vendor communications.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this vendor evaluation. Defines the conclusion of the performance measurement window.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this vendor evaluation. Defines the beginning of the performance measurement window.

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor evaluation. Tracks the evaluation through its workflow from initial draft to final completion.

attributes.name: evaluation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the evaluation based on its trigger and purpose. Periodic evaluations occur on a regular schedule, ad-hoc evaluations are triggered by specific events, contract renewal evaluations support sourcing decisions, incident-driven evaluations follow quality or delivery issues, and qualification/requalification evaluations determine vendor eligibility.

attributes.name: evaluator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee who conducted the vendor evaluation. Captured for audit trail and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: hsse_compliance_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health, Safety, Security, Environment (HSSE) Compliance Score
attributes.description: Performance score for vendor adherence to health, safety, security, and environmental standards. Evaluates compliance with ISPS Code, SOLAS, MARPOL, ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), and port-specific HSSE requirements during the evaluation period.
attributes.references: International Maritime Organization (IMO), International Ship and Port Facility Security (ISPS) Code, SOLAS, MARPOL, ISO 45001, ISO 14001

tag_set.value: Health, Safety, Security, Environment (HSSE) Compliance Score

attributes.name: hsse_compliance_weight
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health, Safety, Security, Environment (HSSE) Compliance Weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor applied to the HSSE compliance score in the overall score calculation. Expressed as a percentage or decimal fraction.

tag_set.value: Health, Safety, Security, Environment (HSSE) Compliance Weight

attributes.name: late_deliveries
attributes.description: Number of purchase orders delivered after the requested delivery date during the evaluation period. Used to calculate the on-time delivery score.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the system user who last modified the vendor evaluation record. Audit trail field for accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor evaluation record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking.

attributes.name: next_evaluation_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next vendor evaluation. May be accelerated for vendors on probation or extended for preferred vendors based on evaluation results.

attributes.name: on_time_deliveries
attributes.description: Number of purchase orders delivered on or before the requested delivery date during the evaluation period. Used to calculate the on-time delivery score.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_score
attributes.description: Performance score for vendor adherence to delivery schedules. Measures the percentage of purchase orders delivered on or before the requested delivery date during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor applied to the on-time delivery score in the overall score calculation. Expressed as a percentage or decimal fraction.

attributes.name: overall_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating band derived from the overall score. Provides a business-friendly classification of vendor performance for reporting and decision-making.

attributes.name: overall_score
attributes.description: Composite vendor performance score calculated from weighted sub-criteria scores. Typically expressed as a percentage or on a 0-100 scale. Used for vendor ranking and qualification decisions.

attributes.name: price_competitiveness_score
attributes.description: Performance score for vendor pricing relative to market benchmarks and competing suppliers. Evaluates cost-effectiveness and value for money during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: price_competitiveness_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor applied to the price competitiveness score in the overall score calculation. Expressed as a percentage or decimal fraction.

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of goods receipts accepted without quality issues during the evaluation period. Calculated as (total receipts - rejections) / total receipts * 100.

attributes.name: quality_compliance_score
attributes.description: Performance score for vendor adherence to quality specifications and standards. Measures defect rates, rejection rates, and compliance with quality requirements during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: quality_compliance_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor applied to the quality compliance score in the overall score calculation. Expressed as a percentage or decimal fraction.

attributes.name: quality_rejections
attributes.description: Number of goods receipts rejected due to quality defects during the evaluation period. Used to calculate the quality compliance score.

attributes.name: recommended_vendor_tier
attributes.description: Recommended classification tier for the vendor based on this evaluation. May differ from current tier if performance warrants upgrade or downgrade.

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Performance score for vendor communication, inquiry response time, and flexibility in addressing urgent requirements or changes during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: responsiveness_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor applied to the responsiveness score in the overall score calculation. Expressed as a percentage or decimal fraction.

attributes.name: tier_change_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for recommending a change in vendor tier classification. Captures the rationale for upgrade or downgrade decisions.

attributes.name: total_purchase_orders
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders issued to the vendor during the evaluation period. Provides context for the evaluation sample size.

attributes.name: total_purchase_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of purchases from the vendor during the evaluation period. Expressed in the base currency of the port authority.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the system user who created the vendor evaluation record. Audit trail field for accountability.

attributes.name: certification_requirements

attributes.name: geographic_scope

products.name: vendor_service_rate_card
products.description: This association product represents the commercial agreement between a vendor and a port service code. It captures negotiated pricing, payment terms, service level agreements, and validity periods for procurement and billing operations. Each record links one vendor to one service code with rate-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this vendor-service relationship. SSOT for vendor-specific service pricing used by procurement for RFQ evaluation and by commercial/billing for rate application.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, vendors provide multiple types of services (stevedoring, lashing, fumigation, customs brokerage, pilotage, towage, etc.) and each service type can be provided by multiple qualified vendors. Ports maintain vendor-service rate cards with negotiated pricing, payment terms, SLAs, and validity periods as part of procurement contract management and billing operations. This is an operational business entity actively managed by procurement during vendor qualification, rate negotiation, and contract lifecycle management.

products.name: vendor_commodity_approval
products.description: This association product represents the approval relationship between vendors and commodity codes they are authorized to supply to the port. It captures vendor qualification, certification, and performance tracking for specific commodity types. Each record links one vendor to one commodity code with approval status, certification details, quality ratings, and supply history that exist only in the context of this vendor-commodity pairing.. Existence Justification: In maritime port operations, vendors are approved to supply specific commodity codes based on certifications, quality standards, and regulatory compliance requirements. A single vendor (e.g., a chemical supplier) may be approved for multiple HS commodity codes (various chemical types), and each commodity code can be sourced from multiple qualified vendors to ensure supply chain resilience and competitive pricing. The port's procurement team actively manages these vendor-commodity approvals as a strategic sourcing function, tracking certifications, quality ratings, and preferred vendor designations for each pairing.

domains.name: masterdata
domains.description: Governs enterprise-wide reference and master data including vessel types, container types, cargo classifications, equipment codes, port codes, UN/LOCODE location references, commodity codes, currency tables, unit-of-measure standards (TEU, FEU, CBM, DWT), calendar data, RFID/EDI partner identifiers, and standardized code lists. SSOT for all shared reference data used across operational and business domains.

products.name: vessel_master

Includes effectivity dating (valid_from/valid_to) for vessel name changes and ownership transfers. attributes.name: iso_type_code

attributes.description: Minimum operating temperature in Celsius for refrigerated containers. Typically ranges from -35°C to -25°C for frozen cargo. Null for non-reefer types.

attributes.name: size_code
attributes.description: Nominal length of the container in feet. Standard values are 20, 40, and 45 feet.

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg

attributes.description: External width of the container in millimeters. Standard ISO containers are 2438mm wide.

attributes.name: yard_block_preference

products.name: port_location

products.name: edi_partner
products.description: Master record for all EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) trading partners connected to the port's PCS (Port Community System) and TOS. Captures EDI partner code, partner name, EDI standard (EDIFACT, X12, XML, NAVIS EDI, API/JSON), supported message types (COPARN, BAPLIE, IFTMIN, COARRI, CUSCAR, CUSRES, CODECO, IFTMBC), communication protocol (AS2, SFTP, VAN, API gateway), port community participant reference, onboarding date, last successful transmission date, connection status (active/suspended/decommissioned), and SLA response time. Data steward: IT / Port Community Systems. SSOT for EDI partner identity used across cargo, customs, vessel operations, and intermodal domains.
